title: Master Studies Mobility (M1/M2) - French Embassy to Malaysia
synthese: This scholarship is dedicated to students who will apply to enroll in M1 in 2024-2025 (program starting in September 2024)
description: This scholarship is dedicated to students who will apply to enroll in M1 in 2024-2025 (program starting in September 2024)
montant: The support takes the form of a monthly allowance of around 700€ to cover living expenses (including the cost of housing). As French government scholarship holders, the selected candidates will also benefit from a social security coverage, the coverage of their tuition fees (up to a maximum of € 5,000) and, subject to availabilities, will have access to university housing. Finally, the scholarship also includes fee waivers for the “Etudes en France” application and the student visa.
duree: 12 months
age: The call is open to Malaysian citizens under 28 years of age by 31 December 2024, from all higher education and research institutions in Malaysia from the private and public sector.
maitriseLangue: Knowledge of French is not mandatory. Language requirements are left to the discretion of the host institution.
conditions: - University term must start in September 2024. - Attribution of the scholarship is subject to acceptation of the applicant in the M1 - A final report must be submitted to the Embassy no later than 28 February 2025. - Selected candidates must make sure they have a passport with an adequate validity period and must agree to be recorded in the Campus France Alumni database
inscription: Deadline: candidates are requested to send their application to: scac.kuala-lumpur-amba@diplomatie.gouv.fr with cc to : sylvain.letailleur@diplomatie.gouv.fr before March 15, 2024 at 23:59 Malaysia time.
pieces: Applications must be submitted through a UNIQUE FILE (<5Mo) including all the documents in order: - SECTION A (candidate's information) ▪ a completed administrative form (to be downloaded on the website) ▪ a brief CV (1 page MAX) ▪ A cover letter (2 pages MAX) indicating the motivations of the candidate to do a Master and study in France and describing his/her subsequent studies or career plans. ▪ copy of valid ID or passport, ▪ application made for an M1 program in France, ▪ acceptance letter from the M1 program in France (if available), ▪ previous diplomas (SPM, Bachelor)/ ▪ academic transcripts from the previous year of study, - Unique application file (<5Mo) - The unique file's name should be based on your surname and name following the format: Master studies in France: MASTER-SURNAME-Name.pdf - The object of the e-mail should be: Master studies in France: MASTER GRANT - Surname
selection: The evaluation criteria are the following: - Excellence of academic record and competencies of the candidate - Quality and relevance of the selected studies - Added value of the training to be performed in France - Targeted institution - Future professional perspectives/project Applications will be assessed by an internal committee set up by the Embassy, including experts from relevant fields. Please note that all selection processes are guided by gender equality and nondiscrimination principles.
domainNote: These calls target all areas of study and research, including science, technology, engineering, humanities, social sciences, etc. French as a Foreign Language is the only exception: if you are interested in this area, please contact Ms. Anaïs Deschamps, Attachée for French Language and Education (anais.deschamps@diplomatie.gouv.fr).
levelNote: The call is open to Malaysian citizens who wish to pursue their entire Master Degree in France (M1/M2). The grant awarded may be extended in M2 provided that (1) the student is accepted in M2 and (2) his/her academic results are satisfactory.

title: PhD research mobility - French Embassy in Malaysia
synthese: The scholarship is dedicated to PhD students wishing to perform a research stay in France in 2024 (3-6months)
description: The scholarship is dedicated to PhD students wishing to perform a research stay in France in 2024 (3-6months). Priority will be given to students engaged in a PhD programme in cotutelle (joint or double degree) or codirection with a French institution / Ecole Doctorale. Students involved in a cotutelle programme may apply for recurrent funding (maximum 12 months) Applications will be assessed by an internal committee set up by the Embassy, including experts from relevant fields. We particularly encourage applications: - including some levels of co-funding by a Malaysian institution - leading way to a new bilateral collaboration Please note that all selection processes are guided by gender equality and nondiscrimination principles.
montant: The support takes the form of a monthly allowance and in certain cases covers the cost of the trip to France. As French government scholarship holders, the selected candidates will also benefit from a social security coverage and, subject to availabilities, will have access to university housing. Please note that the support provided concerns solely the selected applicant: no arrangements will be made for any dependents or family members.
duree: 3 to 6 months
age: The call is open to Malaysian citizens who are under 35 years of age in 2024.
maitriseLangue: Knowledge of French is not mandatory. Language requirements are left to the discretion of the host institution.
conditions: - A final report must be submitted to the Embassy no later than one month after the day of end of the scholarship. - Selected candidates must make sure they have a passport with an adequate validity period and must be registered in the Campus France Alumni database
inscription: Deadline: applications should be sent to valerie.barbosa@diplomatie.gouv.fr with cc: scac.kuala-lumpur-amba@diplomatie.gouv.fr before March 15th, 2024 Malaysia time All the documents must be sent via a unique PDF file (<5Mo), including all documents in the order detailed below. The file's name and object of the email must follow the format: Application PhD 2023 SURNAME-Name
pieces: Applications must include: - a completed administrative form (download) - copy of valid ID or passport - a brief CV (2 pages MAXIMUM) - a cover letter (2 pages MAXIMUM) providing detailed information on (1) the candidate's motivation (2) the added value of the research stay in France, (3) the existing cooperation between the French and Malaysian teams (if any) and (4) the candidate's future career plans - A summary of the research project that will be developed in France: state-of-the art, hypothesis, methodology, expected results, expected impact - Support letters :  from the PhD director in Malaysia,  from the PhD director in France (codirection or cotutelle) or, if no cotutelle or codirection is in place, an acceptance letter from the host institution in France, - copy of previous diplomas (SPM, Bachelor, BSc and Master degrees), and - academic transcripts from the previous year of study
selection: The evaluation criteria are the following: - Excellence of academic record and competencies - Quality and relevance of the PhD project to the bilateral collaboration - Targeted institution(s) - Future professional perspectives / project - Added value of the research performed in France Applications will be assessed by an internal committee set up by the Embassy, including experts from relevant fields.
countryNote: The call is open to Malaysian citizens who have been accepted or are already enrolled in: - a PhD programme in France and in Malaysia (cotutelle/joint degree) or - a PhD programme in Malaysia (ex. codirection) and can provide an official acceptance letter from his host institution in France
domainNote: These calls target all areas of study and research, including science, technology, engineering, humanities, social sciences, etc. French as a Foreign Language is the only exception.
levelNote: The call is open: - new PhD students enrolled in a programme starting no later than September 2024. - current PhD students engaged in the 1st or 2nd year (semester 1-4) of their programme. - The mobility period may only take place during semesters 1-5.

title: CHATEAUBRIAND FELLOWSHIPS
synthese: Grants from the French Government for Israeli researchers (PhD or post-doc)
description: Since 1988, the French government has been funding the Chateaubriand Research Fellowships Program. Those fellowships are aimed at encouraging and supporting mobility and exchanges of Israeli students and young researchers to France. Thanks to this program, more than 400 Israeli students and scientists had the opportunity to pursue research in France. Far from being simple grant holders, Chateaubriand fellows benefit from many advantages: social security, access to university restaurants, lodgings on campus and more.  Eligible fields : Exact and life Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences (medical and specialization internships in French hospitals and clinics are not included in this program).  Duration : For a period of minimum 4 months and up to 6 months during 2024 only. They are non-renewable and non splittable.  Location : The research will be carried out in a French University, a School of Engineering or a Public Research Laboratory.  Eligibility: Israeli scientists, who are currently studying for a Ph.D. in Israel or who have completed their Ph.D. The 2024 Chateaubriand Research Fellowships Call for Proposals is open for applying online from September 18th 2023 until November 18th, 2023 at midnight ! Application deadline extended to 02/18/2024 !
montant: For students who are currently studying for a Ph.D in an Israeli university and want to carry out research in France for a period of 4 to 6 months , the monthly fellowships amount is 1704 €. Once the researcher arrives to France, Campus France (French organization that takes care of your stay in France and your allowance) will take care of the payment as well as of a health insurance for the whole period of the fellowships. For PhD students, candidate should be born after March 1, 1989. For young researchers (who are up to 5 years after their Ph.D graduation) who want to carry out research in France for a period of 4 to 6 months , the monthly fellowships amount is 1704 €. For researchers (who are more than 5 years after their Ph.D graduation) and want to carry out research in France for a period of 4 to 6 months , the monthly fellowships amount is 2055 €.
duree: These training research fellowships are for a period of minimum 4 months and up to 6 months during 2024 only. They are non-renewable and non splittable.
age: For PhD. students, candidates should be born after March 1, 1989. For Researchers, candidates should be born after March 1, 1984.
maitriseLangue: Optional
conditions: All details are available on our website www.france-israel-fellows.com
inscription: Further information https://institutfrancais-israel.com/fr/bourses-et-etudes/
pieces: All details are available on our website www.france-israel-fellows.com
selection: Additional Information : The monthly allowance is payable in France and is not taxable. Lastly, at the end of your fellowships period in France, a report to the French Embassy in Israel is required regarding your stay in France: Scientific significance, probable future developments, comments on the reception/hospitality, etc. This document should be sent before the end of your fellowship.
countryNote: Once the researcher arrives to France, Campus France (French organization that takes care of your stay in France and your allowance) will take care of the payment as well as of a health insurance for the whole period of the fellowships.
domainNote: All field of studies
levelNote: Eligible disciplines : Exact sciences, life sciences, humanities and social sciences (medical and specialization internships in French hospitals and clinics are not included in this program). Must have Israeli citizenship. Dual French-Israeli citizenship owners are not eligible to apply. Have been accepted or invited by a French university, laboratory or research institute. Should be able to provide a valid employment contract or a fellowship attestation within an Israeli research institution.

title: Excellence scholarship Master - French Embassy in Laos
synthese: The Excellence Master scholarship rewards the best student graduated from Bachelor degree to pursue a Master Degree in France. The scholarship lasts 2 years.
description: The Master scholarship from the French Government (BGF) is given by the French Embassy in Laos for 2 years. This scholarship only concerns Lao students graduated at least with a Bachelor's degree. Enrollment is accepted for the following diplomas : Master, Grandes Écoles.
montant: In the majority of cases, is given : A living grant allowing you to meet your needs in France A return flight ticket Laos-France Registration fees in the French higher education establishment (up to 5000 euros) Social security (medical expenses reimbursed in the event of illness)

title: Researchers and lecturers mobility to develop joint collaboration programmes - French Embassy in Malaysia
synthese: This financial support is dedicated to researchers and lecturers wishing to perform one-month stays in France to launch a new research or training collaboration programme - or develop an existing programme in a significant way.
description: The financial support for travel and 1-month stay in France is intended for junior and senior scientists who aim at launching a new research or academic collaboration or to develop and expand an existing collaboration program with a French institution. Stays should combine different types of activities: research, teaching, development of student exchange programs, transfer of knowledge (conferences, workshops, etc.). Priority will be given to: - Applicants aiming at developing a dual degree or assimilated academic program. - Applications that benefit from co-funding from a Malaysian institution, especially if it allows to extend the initial stay period. Please note that all selection processes are guided by gender equality and nondiscrimination principles.
montant: Financial support for travel and 1-month stay in France
duree: 1 month
age: The call is open to researchers of any nationality under 55 years of age in 2023.
maitriseLangue: Knowledge of French is not mandatory. Language requirements are left to the discretion of the host institution.
conditions: - Selected candidates must make sure they have a passport with an adequate validity period and must register in the Campus France Alumni database. - A final report must be submitted to the Embassy no later than one month upon the date of return to Malaysia.
inscription: Deadline: applications should be sent to valerie.barbosa@diplomatie.gouv.fr with cc: scac.kuala-lumpur-amba@diplomatie.gouv.fr before February 5th at 23:59 Malaysia time - Applications must be sent via a unique PDF file (<5Mo) including all documents in the order detailed under - The file's name and email object must follow the format: Academic mobility 2024 SURNAME-Name
pieces: Applications must include: - a completed administrative form (download) - copy of valid ID or passport - a brief CV (2 pages MAXIMUM) - a cover letter (2 pages MAXIMUM) providing detailed information on the collaboration with the French researcher or research institution - A summary of the research project (2 pages MAXIMUM) that will be developed in France: state-of-the art, hypothesis, methodology, expected results, expected impact - If a double-degree program is under development: -- a draft of the project of 2 pages MAXIMUM (name, complementarity between the syllabus from both institutions, target public, provisional calendar, resources available) -- official letters from both institutions indicating their support for the development of the above-mentioned program - A letter of acceptance from the host institution in France
selection: - Excellence of the record and competencies of the candidate - Quality of the submitted research project and perspectives in term of scientific production (publications, outreach programme, etc.) - Relevance and potential impact of the project in terms of the collaboration in research and training (student mobility) between France and Malaysia - Targeted institution - The evaluation process of eligible applications will be conducted by experts from the Ministère de la Recherche et de l'Enseignement Supérieur (MESR – French Ministry of Research and Higher Education)
countryNote: This call is open to researchers of any nationality : - working full-time in a Malaysian institution. - who are in contact with another / other researcher(s) or lecturer(s) in France and/or already involved in an active collaboration between two research units in France and in Malaysia.
domainNote: This call targets all areas of research, including science, technology, engineering, humanities, social sciences, etc.
levelNote: Junior and senior scientists, researchers and lecturers

title: High Level Scientific Fellowship
synthese: The High Level Scientific fellowship programme is open to PhD students or post-doc in their early career (PhD defended after 2019) working in any university in Canada (outside of Quebec) in one of the topics mentioned hereafter.
description: The Embassy of France in Canada has partnered with Campus France to offer scholarships to PhD students or post-docs working in a Canadian university for a 2-month research mobility to France. The aim of this programme is to facilitate and strengthen collaboration with academic researchers in scientific fields that are priorities for France and Canada, as defined at the first Joint Committee on Science, Technology and Innovation between France and Canada in 2023. The call for applications is open to the following themes: - Emerging Technologies: AI, quantum, etc. - Health: One health, public health policy, genomics, etc. - Ocean and polar sciences: oceanography, biodiversity, marine ecology, etc. - Energy: renewable energy, net zero transition, sustainability, etc. Researchers working in the humanities and social sciences in connection with these themes are invited to apply.
montant: The scholarship includes : - International flight (round trip from Canada to France in economy class) - 1700 euros/month - Health insurance (including liability insurance) Laureates who require a visa to enter France are responsible for the procedures and costs involved in obtaining this visa. As visa applications can take 2-3 months, laureates must begin the process as soon as the results are announced. They must update the French Embassy in Canada on the progress of their application.
duree: Period of the stay: 2 months, anytime in 2024 with the exception of the months of July and August.
age: The High Level Scientific fellowship programme is open to PhD students or post-doc in their early career (PhD defended after 2019) working in any university in Canada (outside of Quebec) in one of the topics mentioned previously. The candidates must not hold French citizenship.
inscription: https://francecanadaculture.org/high-level-scientific-fellowship/
pieces: Applications must be submitted by sending all the documents listed below to the Embassy of France in Canada electronically in the form of a single PDF document to the address: science@consulfrance-vancouver.org - An Application-Form-High-Level-Scientists-Fellowship-2024 (visit France Canada Culture website to download the application form) - 1-page cover letter explaining your research project in France - Letter of support from your PhD or post-doc supervisor - Invitation letter from the researcher in France - Copy of your passport (If you do not have a Canadian citizenship, you may need a visa to go to France. Visit France Visas website).
selection: When submitting your application, please state explicitly in the subject line of the e-mail: First name LAST NAME – Application SSHN 2024 Your application will be processed once you have received an e-mail confirming receipt. If you have any questions about this programme, please contact: science@consulfrance-vancouver.org
domainNote: - Emerging Technologies: AI, quantum, etc. - Health: One health, public health policy, genomics, etc. - Ocean and polar sciences: oceanography, biodiversity, marine ecology, etc. - Energy: renewable energy, net zero transition, sustainability, etc. Researchers working in the humanities and social sciences in connection with these themes are invited to apply.

title: French + Sciences
synthese: Every year, the French Embassy provides scholarships for students to participate in summer schools, offering a unique opportunity for students to go to France during the summer holidays.
description: Developed by Campus France in partnership with French as a Foreign Language (FLE) Centres, French+Sciences is a program of short language and scientific stays in cutting-edge technological sectors. French+Sciences has been designed for English-speaking international students enrolled in a science and technology university who may be completely new to French. The scientific content is 100% taught in English. The French+Sciences programme offers 3- to 4-week stays organised by FLE Centres that have been awarded the “Qualité FLE” label. The programs take place in different cities in France. Following the success of the French + Sciences program, Campus France is collaborating with the Fauchon School and the French in Normandy FLE center to launch French + Gastronomy in 2024. This short 3-week program will allow students to explore the world of gastronomy (top chefs, pastry chefs, chocolate makers, etc.) while learning French.
montant: The scholarship includes : - The cost for the program - Accommodation (University housing) - International flight (round trip Canada / France) - Living allowance (amount to be determined) - Insurance (including liability insurance)
duree: 3 weeks (in June / July)
age: -18 years old minimum - To be enrolled at a Canadian university / college (outside of Quebec) - To be an undergraduate student
maitriseLangue: No French proficiency required.
inscription: https://francecanadaculture.org/frenchsciences-program/
pieces: - ENG_Application-Form-FrenchScience-2024 (visit the France Canada Culture website to download the application form) - 1-page cover letter, - Reference letter from one of your teacher, - Latest transcript – report card - Copy of your passport (If you do not have a Canadian citizenship, you may need a visa to go to France? Visit France Visas website).
selection: Send to science@consulfrance-vancouver.org your application in 1 single PDF file before February 4th, 2024 at 23h59 (PST).
domainNote: Sciences and technology fields of study, or gastronomy.

title: French Government grants from the French Embassy in Cambodia
synthese: The Embassy of France in Cambodia devotes an annual budget of about 600 000 euros to merit-based scholarships for Cambodian students wishing to pursue Master or Doctorate studies or doing an internship in France.
description: The Embassy of France in Cambodia offers scholarship to Cambodian students willing to follow studies in France, at the level of Master or Doctorate in the following fields of studies: - Sciences - Law, economy, public management - Education, Linguistic and literature, journalism and tourism - Heritage and culture Grant holder will be provided with: - a living allocation depending on the level of studies - a round trip - tuition fee exoneration - social security - grant holder student statute facilitating the access to students public accommodation - Repatriation insurance
montant: ⮚ The social protection scholarship It only covers tuition fees and social security during the stay in France. No allowance is given to the student; ⮚ The full scholarship covers the followings : - Your daily expenses thanks to a monthly allowance (around 860 € in Master and 1 588 € in Ph. D.);
duree: One renewable year
maitriseLangue: The student who does not have a diploma in French will have to provide a certification of French such as DELF/DALF or TCF.
conditions: Eligibility criteria for French Government Scholarships are : 1. to be a Cambodian student from a Cambodian university or school ; 2. to have a bachelor level Cambodian diploma at the moment of departure for France ; 3. to have a very sound knowledge and practice of French language (official diploma such as DELF is an asset) ; 4. to have a academic project at master and doctorate level ; 5. to have initiated registration process in a selected French university or school on the Etudes en France platform; 6. to be applicant in one of the priority fields of studies of the French-Cambodian cooperation: Engineering sciences, fundamental sciences, agronomy, medicine, law, economic s and management, educational studies, linguistics and literature, journalism, tourism, heritage, cultural and audiovisual activities ; 7. to have a professional project in Cambodia ; 8. to have an agreement from hierarchy for civil servants
inscription: For the 2024-2025 campaign, candidates must download their application file from the website www.cambodge.campusfrance.org in the “BOURSES DU GOUVERNEMENT FRANÇAIS 2024-2025 - APPEL À CANDIDATURES / CALL FOR APPLICATIONS” section. The application file shall be returned at campusfrance@institutfrancais-cambodge.com.
pieces: The application file is composed of : - Application form - Curriculum Vitae - Letter presenting motivations, academic and professional projects, and possible funding sources - Letter explaining the registration procedure in a French university * - Translated and certified copies of diplomas and school reports since high school - Written proof of French A-level - For civil servants, a certified agreement from hierarchy - For a doctorate application: research project and agreement from thesis director * two possible cases : - You hold a French diploma or benefit from a cooperation agreement between your Cambodian university and French university. Consequently, you attach to your file a certificate from your university. - There is no cooperation agreement with your Cambodian university, hence you apply individually for a programme in a French university. Consequently, you attach to your file certificates/ written proof that your registration procedures are on-going. A pre-registration is not compulsorily requested, as it is not necessary in all cases.
selection: Application files are assessed by technical assistants from French Cooperation. The scholarship selection is made by a jury chaired by the Counselor for Cooperation and Cultural Action.
countryNote: Being a Cambodian national
levelNote: Master or Doctorate

title: French Government scholarship 2024 - 2025
synthese: The French government awards scholarships at Masters, PhD and Post-Doc level each year to students from Bosnia and Herzegovina with excellent academic standing.
description: Each year, the French government allocates scholarships at Masters level (1 and 2) and Doctorate under joint supervision to students from Bosnia and Herzegovina who can prove an excellent academic level. The procedure for scholarships was launched in November of the previous year by the SCAC by disseminating information on various media and networks (the website of the French Embassy www.ba.ambafrance.org, the website of the French Institute www.institutfrancais.ba and on the Facebook pages of the Embassy and Campus France Bosnia-Herzegovina)
montant: Master (10 months): 850 euros/month Joint PhD (6- 10 months/3 years): 1.580 euros/months
duree: Master (10 months) Joint PhD (6- 10 months/3 years) Shot research stay (15 days)
age: Under 26 years for Master degree Excellent academic score
maitriseLangue: It is important to have a sufficient language level in order to be able to follow the planned training (level B2 of the common European framework of reference for languages, in French or in English).
inscription: stipendije2022@institutfrancais.ba
pieces: - Compulsory form - Copy of passport - Cover letter (in French or in English) - Curriculum vitae (in French or in English) - Copy of the transcripts of the studies followed during the last two university years followed (in Bosnian) and translation of these transcripts into French or English (it is not necessary to resort to a sworn translation) - Copy of the last diploma obtained and translation of the diploma obtained in French or English - Copy of language level certificates, if applicable - Proposition of thesis subject (for the Doctorate) on 2 pages maximum
selection: All applicants will be informed of the results by the French Embassy. A main list and a complementary list will be established. Candidates must then, and no later than ten days after the publication of the results, confirm their interest in the scholarship. This will become effective after written confirmation of admission to the Master 1 or 2 study program by a high-level French establishment, before July 15 (and subject to the prior agreement of the Embassy as to the amount of the fees. registration of the training chosen). The final award of the scholarship is conditional on admission to a Master's program before 15/07. No postponement for a subsequent academic year can be accepted.
levelNote: The scholarships are reserved for masters or doctoral research.

title: France Excellence scholarships - French Embassy in Vietnam
synthese: The Embassy of France in Vietnam provides scholarships worth 700 euros/month for the Master 2 level and 1 588 euros/month for the PhD level.
description: The Embassy of France in Vietnam invites Vietnamese students to submit applications to its France Excellence Scholarships' program for the Master 2 or PhD level.
montant: The laureates of the France Excellence scholarships program receive a monthly allowance of 700 euros for the Master 2 level and 1 588 euros for the PhD level; they will be also offered a direct membership to a health and personal insurance coverage. The awardees will benefit from the French government's scholarship holder statute and therefore will be exonerated from the visa fees, registration fees and the CVEC fees. Upon arrival in France, they will be offered a CROUS student housing by Campus France, fully or partially paid. For doctoral students only, the Embassy of France in Vietnam sets up an international roundtrip ticket
duree: The scholarship is awarded for a period of : 12 months maximum for the master 2 level 30 months maximum for the PhD level
age: The applicants must be under 35 by the time of the application.
maitriseLangue: For a training program in French, a B2 level is required For a training program in English, a B2 level is required
conditions: Applications from every province of Vietnam, from civil society, from public institutions and private sectors are encouraged.
inscription: Go to the website of the French Embassy in Vietnam: https://vn.ambafrance.org/Appel-a-candidatures-2023-Programme-de-Bourses-France-Excellence Online applications only.
pieces: The application file must include : - the application form , completed and signed; - an updated curriculum vitae; - a motivation letter; - a certified translation of the university diplomas or the transcripts of the last two years of study; - a certified translation of the baccalaureate diploma; For candidates in master 2 : - a description of the professional project for the Master 2 For candidates in PhD level : - a detailed summary of the research project including a brief state-of-the-art, a primer of the problematic and a brief presentation of the methods/data (2 to 3 pages) - a certificate signed by the PhD supervisor, who undertakes to supervise the thesis in France - if apllicable, certificate signed by PhD supervisors, French and Vietnamese, who undertake to supervise the thesis in France and Vietnam - if applicable, document certifying that the project is part of a cooperation project between France and Vietnam To these documents may be added : - a document to certify joint funding; - a copy of the registration certificate and emails exchanged with the host institution; - academic and / or professional letters of recommendation; - any document attesting proficiency in French language (TCF, DELF, DALF, etc.) and / or in English (TOEFL, IELTS etc.).
selection: The candidates are first evaluated based on their academic background, and in a second time through an interview for shortlisted applicants. The final selection belongs to the Embassy of France, in accordance with the regulations of entry and residence for foreigners in France.
domainNote: An indicative list of the areas for study follows: - Fundamental sciences - Engineering sciences - Economy, management, trade - Law and politics - Medicine, pharmacy and health - Social sciences and humanities - Sustainability sciences
levelNote: Master 2 and PhD levels

title: Val d'Oise International Scholarship (BIVO) - for the Japanese students only
synthese: The "BIVO" scholarship program is supported by the Council of Val d'Oise, in collaboration with the French Embassy in Tokyo and the partners Higher education institutions located in the Val d'Oise department (CY Cergy Paris Université, EISTI, EBI, ESSEC, ENSEA et ENSAPC).
description: The BIVO scholarship is for Japanese students only and it offers a unique academic experience to them. Dedicated to supporting international mobility and promoting partnership with more than 30 years of collaboration with Japan, this scholarship program aims to select the Japanese students, based on their academic excellency, and help them to study in France (from 6 to 10 months) at the partner Higher education institutions in the best conditions possible. The deadline for the application 2023-2024 is June 23, 2023. Next call for application 2024-2025 will be in spring 2024. For further information : https://jp.ambafrance.org/BIVO
montant: ● Monthly living fee paid by CY foundation : 600 € per month ● French lessons (FLE) offered by the host institution ● Exemptions : cost of visa, university fees, social security, support of procedure + fees “Etudes en France” ● Airplane round-trip ticket (Japan-France) ● Reservation of student housing (CROUS) by Campus France (under conditions)
duree: From 1 semester (6 months) to 10 months max.
maitriseLangue: The level of the language proficiency (French or English) depends on the program that the candidate will take part in. Candidates are invited to check the required language level. . For those who wish to study “law”, the level “B2” for French is mandatory.
conditions: The candidates have to register in the following institutions from 1 semester to 1 year (1 university year) : ● CY Cergy Paris Université ● l'ESSEC ● l'ENSAPC
inscription: Send by e-mail and by mail Direction du développement international, Europe et Enseignement supérieur Conseil départemental du Val d'Oise Campus | 2, avenue du Parc CS 20201 CERGY 95032 Cergy-Pontoise Cedex Contact : mathias.janse@valdoise.fr
pieces: ● Latest score report ● Resume ● Motivation letter (in French or in English),explaining the choice for study domain, the host institution selected and the study/ research project in France ● Application form et attestation of inscription of the host institution ● Passport and the picture of the candidate
selection: Selection by the application documents
countryNote: This scholarship program is for candidates holding Japanese nationality only.
domainNote: This scholarship is available to those who wish to study in a program of the domain of Human and Social Sciences only and in a partner academic institution located in the Val d'Oise department.
levelNote: Candidates can apply in Licence 2, Licence 3, Master 1 and Master 2 (according to the host institutions).

title: French+Sciences

description: This program is meant for English-speaking students enrolled in science and technology universities, and who can be complete beginners in French: the courses offered as part of French + Sciences aim to promote the French technological know-how and the excellence of the scientific training. Participants will be involved in the program as future engineers, working within world-class firms and research organizations.
montant: Variable.
duree: From 3 to 4 weeks.
maitriseLangue: French beginners. English-speaking students.

title: Bourses France Excellence - Ambassade de France au Chili
synthese: Ce programme cofinance entre l'Ambassade de France au Chili par l'intermédiaire du service de coopération scientifique et universitaire de l'Institut français du Chili et ses partenaires, universités et entités chiliennes, des bourses de courts séjours de recherche et/ou formation en licence, master et doctorat.
description: L'Institut français du Chili met en œuvre ce programme via des accords de coopération annuels et pluriannuels avec une dizaine d'universités et entités chiliennes à Santiago avec les universités du Chili, de Santiago de Chile et Adolfo Ibáñez et en région avec les universités de Concepción, de La Frontera à Temuco, de Magallanes à Punta Arenas, de Talca, et de O'Higgins à Rancagua. Le programme vise à encourager le déploiement de projets de recherche structurants et le développement de mobilités en programmes d'échanges avec les universités françaises partenaires des universités chiliennes. Les thématiques sont ouvertes à tous les domaines de la connaissance avec une priorité donnée pour les thématiques suivantes : ingénierie (hydrogène vert, IA, océan), environnement (transition énergétique, changement climatique, développement durable), SHS (genre et inégalités). Ce programme permet également le développement de mobilités courtes d'observation dans le domaine de la santé publique (virologie, maladies neurodégénératives, cancérologie) pour des jeunes professionnels en partenariat et cofinancement avec différents organismes : Corporación Profesional Alzheimer y otras Demencias (COPRAD), Fundación Arturo López Pérez (FALP), Faculté de Médecine de la Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, Hopital Salvador de l'Universidad de Chile.
funder: French government, Foreign organisations, Higher Education Institutions
montant: Le programme est fondé sur la réciprocité financière : l'Institut français s'engage à verser une allocation mensuelle équivalente à 860 euros par mois et l'université chilienne s'engage, selon ses moyens, à prendre en charge le billet d'avion et/ou l'assurance santé.
duree: Courte durée
age: Il n'y a pas de critère d'âge
maitriseLangue: Selon organisme français d'accueil
conditions: Être inscrit dans un programme d'étude des partenaires chiliens.
inscription: Chaque appel à candidature organisé par le partenaire et détaillant les spécificités de chaque bourse est diffusé en temps voulu sur le site de l'Institut français du Chili.
countryNote: Toutes les nationalités - les candidats doivent avoir un permis de résidence au Chili en vigueur.
domainNote: Tous les domaines d'étude
levelNote: Licence - Master - Doctorat
web1: Institut français du Chili / Campus France Chili

title: Bourse de l'Ambassade de France au Pérou - Campus France (niveau M1 ou M2)
synthese: Bourse de couverture sociale (BCS) offerte par l'Ambassade de France au Pérou pour une période d'un an.
description: Cette bourse de couverture sociale est destinée aux étudiants péruviens ayant reçu une acceptation pour une formation préparant à un diplôme de Master (M1 ou M2) dans une université publique française ou à un titre d'ingénieur dans une école d'ingénieurs publique. Les candidats à cette bourse doivent impérativement avoir postulé à la formation à travers la plateforme Études en France.
montant: Les boursiers bénéficieront du statut de boursiers du gouvernement français (BGF) qui implique les avantages suivants : - Gratuité du visa étudiant de long séjour ; - Exonération des droits d'inscription dans une université publique ; - Soutien de Campus France Paris pour obtenir un logement dans une résidence étudiante. - Sécurité sociale et complémentaire
duree: La bourse est valable un an et n'est pas renouvelable.
age: - Excellence académique - Motivation pour étudier en France - Cohérence du projet académique de l'étudiant - Niveau de français B2 recommandé - Avoir postulé à la formation à travers de la plateforme Etudes en France
maitriseLangue: Niveau de français B2 recommandé

title: Programme de bourses SAINT EXUPERY - Cotutelle ou codirection de thèse
synthese: Programme commun de l'Ambassade de France et du Ministerio de Educación argentin. Il finance des courts séjours de recherche dans le cadre d'une formation doctorale en cotutelle ou codirection de thèse dans des établissements français.
description: L'Ambassade de France et le Ministerio de Educación argentin organisent et cofinancent ce programme qui a pour but de faciliter la mobilité des chercheurs des universités publiques argentines pour la réalisation de recherches doctorales (dans le cadre de programmes de doctorats en cotutelle ou en codirection) au sein d'un établissement français.
montant: Bourse mensuelle par boursier/ère, aide pour les billets d'avion.
duree: Séjour maximum de 4 mois .
maitriseLangue: Certificat de niveau d'anglais ou de français exigé
conditions: - Être citoyen/enne argentin/e (sont exclus les citoyens argentins dotés de la nationalité française); - Résider en Argentine au moment de la candidature; - Avoir obtenu l'acceptation de l'université ou institution française où se réalisera le doctorat en cotutelle ou le stage postdoctoral; - S'engager à revenir dans son pays d'origine au terme de la bourse; - Pour les cas de cotutelle, avoir répondu aux exigences académiques de la première année du doctorat.
inscription: La date limite de candidature pour 2024 n'est pas encore confirmée.
levelNote: Bac + 6 minimum. Les chercheurs devront être inscrits en doctorat dans une université argentine ayant un programme de cotutelle ou codirection de thèse. Ils devront avoir répondu aux exigences académiques de leur première année de doctorat. Les chercheurs en post-doctorat devront être professeurs universitaires ou chercheurs dans une université de gestion publique et être présentés par le recteur ou le doyen de leur Institution.

montant: The monthly scholarship of 860 euros covers the costs of accommodation, food, etc. This grant is accompanied by an additional services including the payment of the Costs of social security and supplementary mutual insurance.
duree: from 36 to 46 months
inscription: Application submission between July 17 and August 14, 2023: details of the procedure in the "Pièces à fournir" section

title: Partenariat Hubert Curien (PHC SIAM) - Commission for Higher Education of the Thai Ministry of Education / MEAE - MESR
synthese: The Partenariat Hubert Curien (PHC) SIAM is implemented in Thailand by the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MEHSI) and universities, and in France by the Ministries of Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) and of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (MESR).
description: The call for applications is open to researchers from research laboratories attached to higher education institutions or research organisations. Each project must be submitted by at least one Thai and one French partner. Each partner must nominate a project leader (the Thai project leader must be a researcher working regularly in a university or a faculty member who already has experience in leading research). Projects must be innovative. Only applications co-submitted by the partner researchers to the authorities responsible for the programme in their respective countries will be declared admissible. French researchers must check with their partner. Teams that have already received funding from the PHC SIAM programme are eligible, provided that the project is completely new and the old one completed before the application. The active participation and mobility of young researchers, in particular doctoral and post-doctoral students, is a priority factor in the assessment of the project. Researchers are strongly encouraged to continue the project after the two years of funding by the Siam PHC programme.
funder: French government, Foreign organisations, International and bilateral organisations, Research bodies
montant: 1) The means granted by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) will cover the mobility expenses linked to the project for a maximum amount of 12,000 euros per project and per year. 2) Financial contributions from partners involved in the project Host organizations are required to cover expenses related to hosting and research work associated with the presented project. In France, the partners will cover the costs linked to the reception and research work of teachers, and senior and junior Thai researchers.The partners in Thailand will provide accommodation for French researchers and payment of subsistence allowances. 3) Contributions from other Thai research agencies Other financial contributions may be made by Thai research organizations or agencies.
duree: Funding is granted on an annual basis for two consecutive years.
maitriseLangue: An excellent level of English or French.
conditions: Each proposal must include : The precise identification of the partners (research organisations, laboratories, universities, etc.) and a precise list of researchers who will participate in the project with their level of involvement; a project leader will be designated as coordinator. (only researchers in active positions within the partner institutions are eligible); A scientific presentation of the project; A timetable for the implementation of the work; A detailed budget; (see operating procedures); An official authorisation specifying the commitment of each partner institution. The partners must submit the same project in France and in Thailand. On the French side, proposals must be submitted by the French project leader online at www.campusfrance.org/fr/siam . An English version of the same project must be submitted by the Thai project leader to the Thai Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MHESI). The deadline for submission of projects is July 1st, 2025 .
inscription: The evaluation of projects will take into account the following criteria: The scientific quality of the project and the teams An active participation of young researchers, in particular doctoral or post-doctoral students. The interest of cooperation and complementarity of French and foreign teams The prospects for structuring or enhancing the project. The network projects with a European opening in particular will be considered a priority.
pieces: Each proposal should include: The precise identification of partners (research organizations, laboratories, universities, etc.) and a precise list of researchers who will participate in the project with their level of involvement; a project manager will be appointed as coordinator. (only researchers in a position of activity within partner institutions are eligible) ; A scientific presentation of the project ; A schedule for the implementation of the work ; A detailed budget (see operating procedures) ; An official authorization specifying the commitment of each partner institution. The partners will have to submit the same project in France and Thailand. On the French side, proposals must be submitted by the French project manager online at www.campusfrance.org/fr/siam. An English version of the same project should be submitted by the Thai project manager to the Thai Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation (MHESI). The deadline for submitting projects is July 1st, 2025.

countryNote: The countries concerned are France and Thailand.
domainNote: The proposal must be in one of the following 10 areas of cooperation : 1 - Mathematics, 2 - Physics, 3 - Marine, Earth, Planet Sciences, 4 - Chemistry, 5 - Biology and Health Sciences, 6 - Humanities, 7 - Social Sciences, 8 - Engineering Sciences, 9 - Information and Communication, Science and Technology, 10 - Agriculture, Food Science, Environment, Biodiversity. The project proposal in the area of Humanities, Social Sciences and Innovation is highly encouraged. It is to support the Year of Innovation and policies of the Thai Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, Thailand and French Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation.
levelNote: The evaluation of the projects will take into account the following criteria : A scientific quality of the project and the teams An active participation of young researchers, in particular doctoral or post-doctoral students. The interest of the cooperation and complementarity of the French and foreign teams The prospects for structuring or developing the project. Networked projects with a European opening will be considered as a priority.

description: Since 2017, the SAAFE program has facilitated the conduct of research and fostered research collaborations between France and Australia, in nuclear science and engineering, in the research areas of Health, Environment, and Nuclear Technologies. The SAAFE program supports Early Career Researchers at PhD and postdoctoral levels to travel from Australia or New Zealand to France – and from France to Australia – to initiate sustainable research networks and linkages.

title: EXCELLENCE SCHOLARSHIP - EUR DS4H
synthese: The Graduate School and Research Digital Systems for Humans (EUR DS4H) offers scholarships and non-financial support to top-performing international Master's students. Discover our specialized programs and our unique catalog of minors and projects!
description: The Graduate School and Research Digital Systems for Humans (EUR DS4H) is one of the eight thematic Schools at Université Côte d'Azur. By bringing together academic experts, leading research laboratories, and industrial partners, EUR DS4H trains a new generation of researchers and professionals capable of addressing the challenges of the digital world. At the Master's level, EUR DS4H offers five core Master's programs corresponding to five different specializations (Computer Science, Economics, Electronics, Law, Management, and Telecommunications), along with a unique catalog of optional minors and projects that allow students to tailor their curriculum throughout their studies. As part of this dynamic, EUR DS4H offers the WINGS scholarship to support outstanding international students who wish to enroll in one of its Master's programs. Applicants must also: – Commit to completing their final internship during the second year of the Master's program (or potentially the first year) in one of EUR DS4H's partner research laboratories (15 labs in the fields of digital technologies and social sciences) – Demonstrate a strong interest in pursuing a PhD after graduation
montant: Two types of grants: – Full scholarship of €8,000 – Partial scholarship of €4,000 The WINGS scholarship amount is determined by the program director. It is paid in two installments (50% in the first semester, 50% in the second semester), subject to successful completion of the first semester. The internship stipend during the second year of the Master's program will be added to the WINGS scholarship amount. The scholarship is awarded regardless of the student's or their parents' income. It can be combined with other scholarships, up to a maximum of €8,000 in total financial aid per academic year. Note: Tuition fees are not covered by the scholarship. Selected students will also receive non-financial support, including events, networking opportunities, and internship possibilities in one of our partner laboratories.
duree: The scholarship is awarded for one academic year (Master 1 or Master 2). It may be renewed for the following year, for students continuing into Master 2, subject to strong academic performance (a minimum average grade of 14/20).
age: Be under 25 years old at the time of application.
maitriseLangue: A C1 level is required in the language of instruction (French and/or English).
inscription: Applicants must apply to one of the eligible Master's programs (see list above) : https://ds4h.univ-cotedazur.eu/education/masters The applicant must indicate their interest in the WINGS scholarship in their motivation letter at the time of application.
pieces: Students selected to receive a WINGS scholarship will be contacted by the EUR teams during the summer. They will need to provide: A bank account statement from a French or European bank. The bank statement must be in the student's name. A copy of an identity document The signed scholarship award notification The completed information sheet
selection: The program directors of each Master's program select the students who will receive the WINGS scholarship and inform them of the award. The scholarship is granted if the student completes their enrollment in the Master's program. The scholarship is only paid after the start of the academic year and once the WINGS scholarship recipient has submitted their documents and attended classes.
countryNote: Not hold French nationality and be enrolled in a program abroad at the time of application. Applicants with dual nationality, including French nationality, are not eligible.

title: Master double-diploma scholarship - French embassy in Morocco
synthese: The double-diploma master's scholarship program is aimed at master's-level students of Moroccan nationality only, enrolled in a public Moroccan university or a university set up through a public-private partnership (UIR, UM6P, UEMF, etc.).
description: This program grants scholarships to Moroccan students enrolled in a Moroccan university wishing to pursue a double-diploma course in a French higher education establishment with which the Moroccan university has a double-diploma agreement, recognizing mobility in France as an integral part of the student's curriculum. The scholarship is awarded for a period of 10 months. At the end of the program, students are expected to receive a Master's degree in Morocco and a Master's 2 in France. There is no scholarship to cover the compulsory internship period. This French government grant cannot be combined with any other grant.
montant: - Scholarship of €860/month for the duration of the 2nd year of the Master's program in France (approximately 10 months) - Free visa - Reimbursement of fees for the Campus France procedure - Social security coverage for the duration of the stay in France - Exemption from tuition fees for establishments under the authority of the MESR - Assistance in finding accommodation in CROUS halls of residence.
conditions: - Be of Moroccan nationality - Be enrolled in the 1st year of a master's program at a Moroccan university (public or public-private) - Obtain a double-diploma after the mobility program in France - Excellent academic record - Priority fields of study
selection: Each double-diploma master's program coordinator can submit the application of one of his or her students on the following principle: one agreement = one application. Each university can submit a maximum of 3 applications. Selection criteria are based on : - the student's academic excellence (the third year of the bachelor's degree and the first semester of the master's degree will be considered) - the training specialization: this must be one of the specializations likely to meet the needs of the Moroccan job market and the main thrusts of bilateral cooperation; - the award of a double degree: the cooperation agreement between the two establishments will be analyzed to determine whether it provides for the award of Moroccan and French master's degrees.

synthese: The Manutech-SLEIGHT Graduate School offers attractiveness scholarships for students integrating one of the Master's tracks proposed by the Graduate School. These attractiveness scholarships are intended to very good students.

With almost 300 master students including more than 50% of international students, Manutech-SLEIGHT is the best place to train through research, get access to cutting-edge training and research facilities and develop your career. The 9 master tracks focus on a cross-disciplinary approach in the fields of optics, image, vision, multimedia, computer science and health engineering . The master programs rely on the research activities of the Hubert Curien Laboratory and the SAINBIOSE Laboratory , two laboratories at the forefront of international research in these domains. title: Nicolas Baudin Travel Grant
synthese: The Nicolas Baudin Travel Grant encourages students to undertake studies in France. The grant corresponds to a return ticket between Australia and France.
description: The Nicolas Baudin travel grant is designed to encourage students to undertake a part of their studies in France. The grant corresponds to a return ticket between Australia and France. Three options are possible: 1, Exchange or Study Abroad Programs, for students enrolled at an Australian university taking part in an exchange program / study abroad at a French establishment. As of 2025, any length of program is accepted for this grant. 2, Full Degree, for students from Australia who are pursuing a degree at a French university (Undergraduate, Masters, Diploma) 3, Internships, for students enrolled at an Australian university undertaking an internship in France that they either find themselves or that is organised through their university.
montant: The grant corresponds to a return ticket between Australia and France of up to 2500$AUD reimbursed to students upon presentation of their plane tickets and receipt. Student recipients also have their visa fees (99€) waived at the Consulate.
maitriseLangue: A proof of proficiency in French will be required for students enrolling in programs which are taught in French.
conditions: The Nicolas Baudin Grant can only be awarded once.
inscription: Students must complete the form and provide the required documents before the deadline. Any application sent after this date will be refused. The form and information can be found on the website indicated below. Applicants for the grant should demonstrate a seriousness in pursuing their studies in France.
pieces: 1. The application form, correctly completed and sent in PDF format. 2. An up-to-date curriculum vitae. 3. Copies of your transcripts and/or diplomas. 4. Letter of recommendation 5. proof of enrolment at a French university All documents must be in PDF format and marked "NOM_FIRST NAME_Application Form", "NOM_FIRST NAME_CV", "NOM_FIRST NAME_Support letter", etc.
selection: The selection process is enacted by a selection panel overseen by the Embassy of France and the Australian Society for French Studies. The selection criteria are based on a wide range of factors including financial need, academic merit or passion for France.
countryNote: Australian citizens and international students enrolled in Australian universities are eligible to apply. French citizens are not eligible.
domainNote: Students from all fields and disciplines are eligible to apply.
levelNote: Students enrolled in Undergraduate, Honours, Masters programs are eligible to apply for the general stream.

title: Excellence Scholarships of the Graduate School of Mathematics & Computer Science - PNGS M&CS
synthese: The Graduate School M&CS is a high-level international program designed for Master's and PhD students. It highlights the interactions and complementarity of mathematics and computer science in order to promote interdisciplinary teaching and research.
description: The Graduate School M&CS, also name EUR M&CS, is a high-level international program designed for Master's and PhD students. It is based on three local Master's programs: Mathematics , Computer Science , and Engineering and Innovation in Images and Networks , whose courses broadly cover the fields in question. In terms of research, three laboratories at Sorbonne Paris Nord University actively participate in this EUR: the LAGA mathematics laboratory, the LIPN computer science laboratory, and the L2TI laboratory, which focuses on the analysis and processing of visual information and networks. These laboratories form the MathSTIC research federation, which supports and encourages their interdisciplinary research. The last decade has seen a significant increase in the need for skills across a wide range of disciplines in order to address an ever-growing number of fields: big data, quantum computing, learning, continuous and discrete optimization, and complexity theory. Students enrolled in this EUR will have the opportunity to take courses from different master's programs, supplemented by specific courses. The link with research will be continuous throughout the program: students will complete short internships in laboratories, attend locally organized research seminars or conferences, and work on open problems in a theoretical and experimental manner. Finally, the industrial world will be involved in this EUR through conferences, internships, and CIFRE thesis contracts. These relationships will be based on collaborations that the laboratories are developing with numerous companies and with regional competitiveness clusters linked to digital technology.
funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies
montant: Benefits for PNGS M&CS students: Obtain a scholarship - selection based on criteria; Obtain funding for an assignment abroad (in M2); Receive personal support throughout your academic career; À la carte training; Interact with international partners and industry professionals through events and meetings. For international students: Have a round-trip ticket to your family home financed; Have access to housing (CROUS). Students enrolled at USPN all pay the same tuition fees (€243/year plus €91/year for student life contributions). The best candidates will be offered a scholarship of €600/month, supplemented by €400/month for those who need housing assistance. In addition, EUR will finance a round-trip ticket between home and university.
duree: It is for a period of 12 months for M1 students and 10 months for M2 students. Students who obtain thesis funding join the Galilée Doctoral School and continue their studies for three years at the PNGS-M&CS.
age: These scholarships are open to all students, whether French or foreign, of any nationality. Selection is based on criteria of academic excellence and motivation.
maitriseLangue: Courses and course materials are provided in English. You must have a sufficient level of English to follow the courses. French courses will also be offered.
conditions: The Graduate School PNGS-M&CS assists students with administrative procedures (pre-registration and registration for master's programs, visa application procedures, access to housing, insurance, banking, etc.). It also provides them with educational and scientific support: assignment of a tutor from one of the School's laboratories, regular contact with the master's and School management team, information meetings, support in finding internships and supervisors. Finally, it facilitates the integration of students into their class (back-to-school meeting, specific activities bringing together students from the PNGS-M&CS School at all levels of study).
inscription: Candidates for a scholarship from the PNGS-M&CS School must submit an online application on the School's website and, at the same time, apply for one of the Master's programs at the Institut Galilée included in the School's scope via the Études en France or ParcoursSup procedure.
pieces: Curriculum Vitae Transcripts from the first year of university Two email addresses of references willing to provide letters of recommendation A cover letter, also detailing the training project Copy of an identity document Information on language proficiency in French and English (some courses may be taught in French, but with written material in English). Once an account has been created on the application website, the application can be completed in several steps. Applicants are responsible for ensuring that their application is complete by the closing date. Incomplete applications after this date will not be considered.
selection: All applications received will be reviewed. The selection of successful candidates is made by the Scientific Committee of the PNGS-M&CS School; it is based on criteria of academic excellence and motivation, taking into account the consistency of the training project. The PNGS-M&CS applies a policy of equal opportunity in the treatment of candidates during the selection process. Female applicants are encouraged to apply.
levelNote: Applicants for an M1 scholarship: applicants must have obtained a bachelor's degree or equivalent by August 31 of the current academic year. Applicants for an M2 scholarship: applicants must have successfully completed the first year of a master's degree by August 31 of the current academic year.

title: Incoming mobility grant of the Manutech - SLEIGHT Graduate School (Master' interships)
synthese: The Manutech-SLEIGHT Graduate School offers incoming mobility grants for masters' students (M1 and M2) who wish to carry out an internship project (M1 or M2) in a Manutech-SLEIGHT's laboratory in Saint-Etienne.
description: The Manutech SLEIGHT Graduate School provides an international integrated MSc/PhD programme of excellence in the domains of Surfaces-Light engineering with applications to health, energy or security. The training program is multidisciplinary with a strong international dimension and relies on internationally recognized research laboratories. Manutech-SLEIGHT is located in France (Saint-Etienne and Lyon) and brings together: - 8 research laboratories: about 200 researchers and over 100 PhD students. - A graduate program with 3 master programs with 9 courses including 4 Erasmus Mundus Joint Master Degrees carried by the University Jean Monnet ( Faculty of Science and Technology and Faculty of Medicine): about 300 master students including more than 50% international students. Research curricula of 2 engineering schools are also involved in the Graduate School - the I nstitut d'Optique Graduate School (IOGS) in Saint-Etienne and at INSA Lyon - , and two doctoral schools (ED SIS and ED MEGA) . The Graduate School, thanks to the financial support of Université Jean Monnet, offers incoming mobility grants for international students (M1 or M2) who wish to do an internship (4 - 6 months) in one of the fields of Manutech-SLEIGHT within one of these laboratories supervised by Université Jean Monnet or based in Saint-Etienne(France).
funder: Higher Education Institutions, Regions and cities
montant: Amount of the incoming mobility Grant: The laureate, selected by the Graduate School, will receive a mobility grant contributing to their travel expenses (round trip home university to laboratory in Saint-Etienne or Lyon) : 500€ maximum if the student comes from a member country of the Council of Europe 1 000€ maximum if the student comes from a country outside the Council of Europe. Amount of the stipend : The payment of a stipend of approximately 650€ / month is made directly by the laboratory.
duree: Intership duration : few weeks to 6-month internship.
maitriseLangue: Master students must have a sufficient level of English: equivalent to TOEFL with at least 213 points (computer-based) / 550 points (paper-based) / 82 points on the Internet IELTS at grade 6.5 Cambridge Proficiency Certificate of English at least at grade B2.
conditions: The internship should be implemented in one of these Graduate Shool's laboratories: - Lab. Hubert Curien (UJM, CNRS, IOGS) : https://laboratoirehubertcurien.univ-st-etienne.fr/en/ - Lab. SAINBIOSE (UJM, INSERM, Mines Saint-Etienne) : https://www.univ-st-etienne.fr/fr/sainbiose.html - Lab. BIIO (UJM) : https://www.univ-st-etienne.fr/fr/biio.html - Laboratoire Georges Friedel (Mine St Etienne, CNRS) : - Lab. MATEIS (INSA Lyon, CNRS, Lyon 1) : https://mateis.insa-lyon.fr/en - Lab. CREATIS (INSA, UCBL, CNRS, INSERM, UJM) : https://www.creatis.insa-lyon.fr/site/en - Lab LAMCOS (INSA Lyon, CNRS) : http://lamcos.insa-lyon.fr/?L=2 - LTDS (ECL, CNRS) : https://ltds.ec-lyon.fr/spip/
inscription: Master students must first contact the laboratory to find an intership's project.The internship supervisor will propose the application for the mobility grant to the Graduate School Manutech-SLEIGHT. Process: 1/ Apply for an internship with one of the Graduate School laboratories 2/ Once the internship's project has been defined, the internship supervisor proposes the application for a mobility grant to the Graduate School Manutech-SLEIGHT. 3/ After analysis of the application by the Graduate School, the laureate is notified by email.
pieces: - A Curriculum Vitae in English. - A dated and signed cover letter written in English describing specific motivations for the internship. - One to two dated and signed letters of recommendation written in English on the letterhead of the signatory's organisation. - Copy of valid passport - Copies of transcripts or other academic records documenting undergraduate and master's degree studies, including credits and grades earned in each subject.
selection: Applications for mobility grants are validated by the Graduate School Manutech-SLEIGHT. The final answers are given througout the year. The payment of the mobility grant is made in two instalments under certain conditions. The first payment is only made when the student arrives on site in Saint-Etiennen, and after presentation of the internship agreement signed by the parties.
countryNote: All countries are concerned by this grant.
domainNote: The internship must fit into the research fields of Manutech-SLEIGHT: Optics Photonics Laser engineering Surface engineering Image Vision Multimedia Micro-nano technology Security ; Computer science Data sciences ; Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Bioengineering and Medicine
levelNote: International students must be enrolled in a master's level degree program in one of the following fields: Optics; Photonics; Imaging; Vision; Multimedia; Laser; Micro-nano technology; Security; Computer Science; Data Science; Artificial Intelligence; Machine Learning; Bioengineering

title: IRMIA++ Mobil'ITI Master Grant
synthese: Mobil'ITI program of University of Strasbourg offers Master 1 and Master 2 grants for students in Mathematics, Computer Science and Physics.
description: These grants are available for students admitted both in associated master tracks and in the graduate program IRMIA++ "Mathematics and applications : research and interactions" (DU MARI). List of associated master tracks : https://irmiapp.unistra.fr/training/presentation#c48697 Presentation of the graduate program IRMIA++ (DU MARI) : https://irmiapp.unistra.fr/training/presentation#c48696
montant: The total amount of the grant is between 7,000€ and 9,500€, depending on the student's situation and distributed as follows: Travel and moving expenses (excludes students who are enrolled in an institution of higher education at Strasbourg for current year): Students from academic region Grand Est and Rhin Supérieur: 500€ for travel Students from a country < 4 000 km (France included): 1 000€ for travel (based on receipts) + 500€ for moving Students from a country > 4 000 km: 2 000€ for travel (based on receipts) + 500€ for moving Accomodation fees : 700€ per month during 10 months (7 000€ in total). The grant then amounts to between 7 000 and 9 500 euros/year, depending on the candidate situation. ATTENTION: This grant does not cover any registration fees.
duree: The grant is awarded for a complete academic year (10 months), and is renewable under conditions for a maximum duration of 6 months.
maitriseLangue: French and English. The graduate program is taught in English.
conditions: 80% of the grant will be transfered as the arrival certificat is signed, and the remaining 20% will be transfered at the end of the mobility. In addition, the ITI IRMIA++ reserves the right to require integral reimbursement of the grant if the student does not entirely follow the graduate program. Mobil'ITI grant can be combined with "bourses sur critères sociaux", but cannot be combined with: Dispositif de soutien à la mobilité internationale Unistra (DRI) Erasmus+ MIC / Mundus / KA 103 excepted dispositif Erasmus+ Stage KA103 UFA Other financiel support coming from IdEx funds for the same academic year.
inscription: Candidates must first apply for a Master's degree (on Unistra's e-candidat site, on MonMaster.fr or on Campus France, depending on their situation) in one of the Master's courses listed here: https://irmiapp.unistra.fr/fr/formation/presentation#c48697. They must then apply for the IRMIA++ Graduate program and the scholarship via the online form on https://irmiapp.unistra.fr/fr/formation/admission . ATTENTION: The online form requires your Campus France, Mon Master, or E-candidat file number, as well as which Master's track associated with the graduate program you have applied for. It is essential that you have already applied for this exact track with the file number indicated. Applications to other universities or other master's tracks will not allow you to access the graduate program or scholarship.
pieces: The documents required to apply for the Master's degree are specific to each master track, please refer to each master website. In the online form for graduate program and scholarship, you will have to upload these documents: a resume, the last obtained diploma and full transcripts of last three years, a cover letter describing your professional project and insertion in University of Strasbourg, the completed and signed Grant application form (downloadable in the online form).
selection: Applications will be reviewed by the studies coordinator. An interview will be set with the eligible candidates, with a jury composed of professors in mathematics, physics and computer science. Please note: Applications are first examined for admission to the graduate program. If it is accepted, it is then examined for the award of the scholarship. Decision information will be given in June 2026 for grant attribution. Master and graduate program registration are managed separately at scolarity service.
countryNote: not concerned
domainNote: Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science
levelNote: Candidates must be admitted both in Master track and graduate program IRMIA++ (DU MARI).

title: France Excellence Scholarships - Theology and Religions
synthese: The French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs is funding scholarships in theology and religions (at Master's and doctoral levels) as well as high-level scientific stays in the aforementioned fields for 2026. In this regard, the IFA is launching a call for applications from March 17 to April 14, 2026.
description: Target audience: - Francophone Algerian students with a study project in France directly related to religious studies. - Algerian researchers in religious studies who wish to pursue their studies or research within public university programs and laboratories. Types of scholarships offered: The scholarships offered for this program are of two types: study scholarships and High-Level Scientific Stay (SSHN) scholarships. 1) Study scholarships (awarded for degree programs): - Master's scholarships, for students enrolled in a Master's level degree program at a French higher education institution; - Doctoral scholarships, for students enrolled in a doctoral level program at a French higher education institution, or students with a joint supervision agreement (the joint supervision agreement will be required during the selection process). 2) High-level scientific stay grants: These scientific grants are awarded to beneficiaries participating in a research program (doctoral students, post-doctoral fellows or researchers) not enrolled in a French higher education institution.
montant: Terms and Conditions: - The stipend for a Master's level scholarship is €900 per month; The stipend for a Doctoral level scholarship is €1,850 per month; - The stipend for a High-Level Scientific Stay Grant (SSHN) at the "young researcher" rate is €1,850 per month; - The stipend for a High-Level Scientific Stay Grant (SSHN) at the "established researcher" rate is €2,055 per month; - In accordance with the scholarship regulations applicable as of January 1, 2023, tuition fees are not covered. - Round-trip travel and any prior language training are not covered. - If the student's accommodation is provided by a religious institution or association, the application must be indicated.
duree: Scholarship duration: - Long-term scholarships (Master's and Doctoral): These cover a period of 10 to 36 months at the Master's (M1 and/or M2) and Doctoral levels. - Short-term scholarships (Doctoral – Postdoctoral): These cover a period of 4 to 12 months of study at the Doctoral level (with or without joint supervision), or for a Postdoctoral position.
age: Eligibility criteria: - The program is open exclusively to Master's and Doctoral level studies; - All religions are welcomed; - Applicants must be native French speakers or have a sufficient level of French to pursue studies in France.
conditions: Documents required for a long-term or short-term scholarship application: - Scholarship or internship application form, depending on the type of mobility; - Diploma offered as equivalent to the French Baccalaureate and its translation into French; - Other higher education diplomas and their translations into French; - Letter of acceptance from the French higher education institution indicating the planned program and the diploma sought (scholarships are for candidates already in the Campus France Algeria application process); - Detailed study plan in France, indicating the professional objective after graduation; - Proof of score obtained on the Test de Connaissance du Français (TCF) within the last two years, or a Diploma of French Language Studies (DELF B2) or a Diploma of Advanced French Language Studies (DALF C1 or DALF C2). - For doctoral candidates, provide a detailed presentation of the thesis proposal.
inscription: To respond to the call for applications, you must fill in the scholarship form downloadable below and send it to esr@if-algerie.com along with the required documents before April 14, 2026 at midnight, Algerian time) strict deadline.
pieces: Documents required for a long-term or short-term scholarship application : - Scholarship or internship application form, depending on the type of mobility; - Diploma offered as equivalent to the French Baccalaureate and its translation into French; - Other higher education diplomas and their translations into French; - Letter of acceptance from the French higher education institution indicating the planned program and the diploma sought (scholarships are for candidates already in the Campus France Algeria application process); - Detailed study plan in France, indicating the professional objective after graduation; - Proof of score obtained on the Test de Connaissance du Français (TCF) within the last two years, or a Diploma of French Language Studies (DELF B2) or a Diploma of Advanced French Language Studies (DALF C1 or DALF C2). - For doctoral candidates, provide a detailed presentation of the thesis proposal.
