title: Doctoral grants - The Development Research Institute
synthese: The Institut de Recherche pour le Développement awards doctoral grants of up to 36 months to enable students from the global South to carry out a research project in another country of the South or of the North. The grant includes a monthly stipend, health insurance, and one round-trip air ticket each year.
description: The Allocations de recherche pour une thèse au Sud (ARTS) programme is one of IRD's main capacity building instruments. It enables students from Africa, South East Asia, Latin America and the Pacific . The thesis is carried out in the framework of a partnership between an IRD research team and a research team from the South. Its objective is to train the managers, experts and scientists of tomorrow. It can support the complete realisation of the work or provide additional support. - The student must be a national of a developing country and be enrolled in a doctoral programme in France or abroad. - His/her supervisory team includes one or more researchers from an IRD co-supervised research unit. - Support may not exceed 36 months with a maximum extension of 6 months. - Scientific stays in a laboratory or structure in France cannot exceed a duration of 6 months continuously and a cumulative duration of 6 months over one year. The scholarship is managed by Campus France.
montant: The grant includes: a monthly stipend, the amount of which varies with the host country medical insurance round-trip air ticket provided by IRD (for continuous stays of at least 2 months' duration) Grants include no other payments or benefits for the grantee or his/her family.
duree: Up to 36 months, nonrenewable.
maitriseLangue: Good level in French and English
conditions: Applicants must be engaged in an IRD research program, with IRD-affiliated staff, in at least one of their host institutions. Applicants must plan to perform research in one or more host institutions in the South or North. Priority is given to dissertation programs that involve research periods in more than one location, that will result in a dual degree, and that are confinanced by a partner.
inscription: There is no call for proposals for the ARTS grants, the thesis projects are pre-selected by the research units and arbitrated by the Institute's management. If you are interested in the programme, please contact the IRD units directly in order to know the thesis topics envisaged on their theme: https://www.ird.fr/sites/ird_fr/files/2020-07/liste%20unit%C3%A9s%202020_web.pdf
pieces: No documents are required as requests are made through our researchers
selection: Evaluation criteria: Scientific merit of the proposal: qualifications of the candidate, logic and coherence of his/her prior training, value of the proposed research Closeness of the association with IRD: nature of the proposed collaboration, solidity of the personnel links Contribution to the strengthening of research capacity in the South: existence of a research team in the field, degree of involvement of the candidate with the local team, degree of relevance to national priorities
countryNote: - The student must be a national of a developing country and be enrolled in a doctoral programme in France or abroad.
domainNote: Research themes of the Institute
levelNote: Applicants must hold a research Master or equivalent diploma Applicants must be enrolled in a doctoral program (any year) in France and/or a country of the global South.

description: The Knud Højgaards Foundation processes submitted applications on an ongoing basis, but only those that meet the formal requirements. Any application that deviates in any way from the application or documentation requirements will unfortunately not be considered. Therefore, the Foundation encourages all applicants to read the requirements below. Applications to the Knud Højgaard Foundation must be submitted on a digital application form. You can access the application form by registering as a user. As different application forms are used for the different purposes supported by the Foundation, it is important that you choose the correct application form, otherwise we will not be able to process your application. All documents uploaded must be in PDF format. Applications can be submitted throughout the year and are processed on an ongoing basis.
conditions: https://www.khf.dk/ansoegninger/
inscription: https://www.khf.dk/ansoegninger/

title: Scholarships - Hede Nielsens Foundation
synthese: Masters-level study grants and grants for work placements abroad.
conditions: Funds must be requested at least 60 days before the start of the project. (Preferably earlier). Please note that there must be a link between the budget and the period requested. e.g. 5 months for both. Applications must be written in Danish. Other annexes may be in English. All correspondence must be in Danish. Funding may be requested throughout the year, but not in July. Applications for projects starting in September must therefore already be created in June, as applications must be received at least 60 days beforehand.
inscription: Comment faire une demande au Fonds | La Fondation Hede Nielsen

title: Travel Grant for Individuals with Disabilities - Jascha Foundation
synthese: These grants can be used to fund equipment, treatments, and travel that add value to their lives. Applications must include a third-party statement, the latest tax assessment, and an offer for the object of the application.
inscription: Applications must be submitted online via the provided link. Applicants must provide all required documents. Applications must include a third-party statement, the latest tax assessment, and an offer for the object of the application. Grants only cover expenses incurred after receiving the grant.

title: Travel Grant for Sciences of Education Students - Ole Kirk Foundation
synthese: The Ole Kirk Foundation supports education students undertaking an internship abroad with children aged 0-18. Applications must be submitted at least 1 month before departure.
description: The Ole Kirk Foundation offers travel grants to education students who are undertaking an internship abroad as part of their studies. The internship must take place in an institution working with children aged 0-18 and last at least 5 months. Applications must include a copy of the agreement with the educational institution in Denmark and the internship location abroad.
inscription: Applications must be submitted at least 1 month before the departure date. Applicants must provide a copy of the agreement with the educational institution in Denmark and the internship location abroad.

title: Travel Grant for Students in the Faroe Islands - The Faroese Student Grant Fund (Studni)
synthese: The Faroese Student Grant Fund (Studni) offers travel grants to students from the Faroe Islands to pursue studies abroad. Applications are processed continuously.
description: The Faroese Student Grant Fund (Studni) supports students from the Faroe Islands who wish to continue their studies abroad. The grants cover travel, accommodation, and living expenses for study periods abroad. Applicants must be Danish nationals or legal residents of the Faroe Islands.
conditions: Applicants must be Danish nationals or legal residents of the Faroe Islands. Studies can be conducted worldwide. Applicants must have resided in the Faroe Islands for at least two of the last three years before the start of their studies or have lived at least half of their life in the Faroe Islands. Students with children can receive an additional allowance for childcare expenses.
inscription: Applications must be submitted online via the provided link. Applicants must provide all required documents.
pieces: Applicants must submit a complete application package including a CV, motivation letter, detailed project description, and a letter of recommendation.
selection: Applications are evaluated by the Faroese Student Grant Fund (Studni). Selection criteria include the relevance of the project, financial needs, and the potential impact on the applicant's studies.

title: Travel Grants for Individuals with Cerebral Palsy - Elsass Foundation
synthese: The Elsass Foundation offers travel grants to individuals diagnosed with cerebral palsy (CP) in Denmark to fund experiences and travel. Applications are processed continuously.
description: The Elsass Foundation supports individuals with cerebral palsy (CP) in Denmark by providing travel grants.
conditions: Applications must include the applicant's annual tax statement and documentation of the CP diagnosis. Travel grants exceeding 17,100 DKK are generally not awarded.
inscription: Applicants must submit a complete application package including the annual tax statement, documentation of the CP diagnosis, and an explanation of the purpose of the application.

title: 6 FMJH Post-doctoral fundings in Mathematics for 2026
synthese: The "Fondation Mathématique Jacques Hadamard (FMJH)" offers 6 postdoctoral fundings for 2 years starting from October 2026.
description: The "Fondation Mathématique Jacques Hadamard (FMJH)" offers 6 postdoctoral fundings for 2 years. The positions are broken down as follows: ► 1 position in the program "Mathematics in Computational Science and Engineering" ► 1 position in the program "Mathematics and Life Sciences" ► 1 position in the program "Mathematical Physics" ► 1 position in the program "PGMO" Each candidate can either propose a free research topic or choose one of the topics submitted by researchers from the FMJH perimeter. These topics are associated with the thematic programmes and are listed in the table attached to the call. Application's deadline: December 8, 2025
montant: The salary is about 25,000 € net per year. The laureates can be asked to give 20 hours per year of tutoring to undergraduate or master students. There are two ways to apply, depending on whether the research program is free or part of a closed list of subjects proposed by researchers within the FMJH perimeter. They are listed in a table.
duree: The commitment will begin in October 2026 for 2 years.
inscription: Online application
pieces: In addition to this indication of theme, the application file must include: a curriculum vitae, a research project, a wish to be assigned to one of the research units affiliated to the FMJH, the name of a scientific contact in the chosen laboratory, a letter of motivation setting out the applicant's wishes and research program.
selection: Selection is based on application's files, taking into account the scientific quality of previous studies and recommendations from professors/researchers. Selection will be carried out by juries composed of faculty members from the concerned institutions.
domainNote: To be eligible, the PhD candidates must have defended their thesis before October 1 of the year of recruitment.

title: Excellence post-doc program Hadamard Lecturers FMJH 2026
synthese: The FMJH offers 5 post-doctoral grants of 3 years intended for young mathematicians who have demonstrated their excellence in the development and transmission of knowledge.
description: These positions are intended for young mathematicians who have demonstrated their excellence in the development and transmission of knowledge and wish to be assigned in one of the FMJH-affiliated laboratories. They are long-term post-docs (3 years) with a low teaching load (corresponding to one third of the statutory service of a Maître de Conférence des Universités).
montant: The salary is around €28,900 net/year (before tax).
duree: 3 years
maitriseLangue: Hadamard lecturers are expected to be able to teach mathematics in either French or English (if they can teach in both languages, that's ideal).
inscription: Online application
pieces: The application must include: a curriculum vitae with a list of publications, a research program a wish to be assigned to one of the FMJH-affiliated laboratories listed on our website, the name of a scientific contact in the chosen laboratory, the names of one or two referees, a letter of motivation linking the assignment request to the research program.
selection: The winners are selected by a jury, who first make a pre-selection on the basis of their application files, then rank the pre-selected candidates on the basis of an audition to check their ability to express themselves orally. All auditions are conducted remotely, to ensure fairness and avoid long-distance travel.
levelNote: To be eligible, candidates must have defended their thesis before September 1 of their recruitment year.

title: Study trip assistance for journalism students - The Magazine Fionie Foundation
synthese: The Magazine Fionie Foundation is offering a study trip grant for journalism students. This grant is intended for bachelor's and master's students for study trips abroad as part of their Danish programme or a full master's programme abroad.
description: The Magazine Fionie Foundation is offering a scholarship to help journalism students finance their study trips abroad. The grant is intended for bachelor's and master's students enrolled in Danish programmes or in full master's programmes abroad. Applications must be submitted by 1st April for the autumn semester and by 1st November for the spring semester. Applicants must provide their examination results, a detailed budget, credit transfer documentation and admission documentation. The award of the scholarship is based on an overall assessment of the applicant and the purpose of the study trip. The Foundation does not support study trips lasting less than one semester.
montant: The scholarship covers travel, accommodation and living expenses for a period of one semester. The exact amount of the scholarship depends on the detailed budget submitted by the applicant and other funds requested. Applicants must provide an indication of the other funds they have requested for support.
duree: The duration of the scholarship is one semester. Students must apply before 1 April for the autumn semester and before 1 November for the spring semester. The Foundation does not support study trips lasting less than one semester.
conditions: Students must be enrolled in a journalism programme. For undergraduate students, only the following programmes are eligible: Journalism Programme at the University of Southern Denmark, Journalism Education at the Danish School of Media and Journalism, Journalism Programme at Roskilde University, Television and Media Organisation at the Danish School of Media and Journalism, Visual Communication at the Danish School of Media and Journalism, Photojournalism Programme at the Danish School of Media and Journalism.
inscription: Applicants must submit their application online, providing the necessary information and attaching the required documents. The application deadlines are 1st April and 1st November.

description: Every Dane over the age of 18 is entitled to public support for his or her further education (in the form of State education grants and loans) as well for studies abroad. Danish Education Support Agency For further information: https://www.su.dk/su-i-udlandet Time limitation: https://www.su.dk/su-i-udlandet

title: 2026 "France Excellence Pakistan - Climate Change"
synthese: The French Embassy in Pakistan awards scholarships to meritorious young Pakistani students who wish to pursue their higher education in France at the Master Level. This year, the call for proposal for the full scholarships targets the best programs that can enhance the knowledge and skills of talented students.
description: PRESENTATION OF THE PROGRAM Pakistani applicants with outstanding academic records have a number of funding options for their studies in France: 134 scholarship programs offered by the French government, universities or companies are listed on the Campus Bourses scholarship search engine on the Campus France Pakistan website. In addition, the French Embassy in Pakistan awards scholarships to meritorious young Pakistani students who wish to pursue their higher education in France at the Master Level. This year, the call for proposal for the full scholarships targets the best programs that can enhance the knowledge and skills of talented students to help Pakistan adapt to Climate Change. Master Degree Programs for France Excellence Pakistan-Climate Change : 1. MSc Process and Bioprocess Engineering / track Project Management for Environmental and Energy Engineering (Master 1 + 2), IMT Atlantique - Nantes 2. Materials Science and Engineering Masters - Biorefinery and Biomaterials program (Master 2), INP Pagora Grenoble 3. Master in Agriculture, Food Sciences, Environment and Nutrition (MAFEN) (Master 1 + 2), Université d'Avignon 4. One-Health Emerge Master's Degree (Master 2), ONIRIS 5. Master in International Economics (Master 1 +2), Université de Lille 6. Master's Degree in Civil Engineering (Master 1 + 2), ESTP
montant: BENEFITS Tuition fees Monthly living allowance One Return air ticket Pakistan-France-Pakistan Student visa and Etudes en France fee waiver (reimbursed upon request after being awarded with the scholarship) Social Security Assistance to find affordable student accommodation (priority access to CROUS residencies, subject to availability) Free French language classes before departure to France
age: Applicants must be 28 years old maximum at the time of application.
maitriseLangue: Knowledge of French is an asset but not mandatory to apply for the scholarship (except for ESTP, where minimum A2 level is required).
conditions: Please note that: - if you apply for a 2 years Master's Program the renewal of the scholarship at the M2 level will ONLY be possible if you succeed to pass in all your first-year exams (no retake possible); in case of retake, your scholarship will be terminated. - The courses (and internship in M2) should take place in France. - The recipient of the scholarship is compelled to join the university and program he/she has been selected for. In case of a 2 years degree, the recipient cannot change its programme between M1 and M2. Otherwise, the scholarship will not be delivered. - On Etudes en France platform, students may apply to up to 7 programs, but only the listed degrees are eligible for the France Excellence Pakistan – Climate Change scholarship.
inscription: IMPORTANT: - Deadline to apply is November 30, 2025 . Applications submitted after the deadline will not be eligible. - Students must apply directly to the French university through the Etudes en France platform. For IMT Atlantique, INP Pagora and ESTP, applications must also be submitted on their respective platforms to be eligible. - Fees apply for the Etudes en France platform (30 000 PKR); it can be reimbursed upon request to Campus France Pakistan only if you are awarded with the “France Excellence for Climate Change” scholarship. You'll find tutorials for Etudes en France platform on Campus France Pakistan website and social media (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Youtube).
countryNote: Applicants must be Pakistani nationals.
levelNote: The applicant should hold a 4 years bachelor degree (or be currently enrolled in the 4th year) with a CGPA of 3.0 out of 4 minimum from any Pakistani university recognized by Higher Education Commission, Pakistan There should not be more than a period of 2 years after the completion of the undergraduate degree.

title: Research and study trips - The New Carlsberg Foundation
synthese: The New Carlsberg Foundation wishes to contribute to a general strengthening of research within the field of art and of exchanges between Danish and foreign research environments within the field of art and art history.
conditions: Scholars working with art research can apply for support for research trips and participation in conferences abroad. The Danish art academies can apply for support for joint study trips for students at the Danish art academies working with visual arts. Applications for joint study trips must be submitted and administered by the academy's administration.No support is provided for artists' research activities or for students' individual travel and studies abroad. No support is provided for trips already undertaken.
inscription: An application for support is submitted through the foundation's online application system.The New Carlsberg Foundation's board assesses the applications received. The applications are either approved (yielding partial or full support) or declined.The applicant receives notification of the result through the foundation's online application system. Expect a processing time of a few weeks after the board meeting.

title: French Government Scholarships from the French Embassy in Poland - Research stay
synthese: These grants are intended for Polish researchers: professors, researchers or post-doctoral fellows wishing, for example, to establish contacts or to be trained in a specific equipment in France.
description: These scholarships are intended for Polish researchers: professors, researchers or post-doctoral fellows wishing to establish contacts or to train in specific equipment in France. They must hold a doctorate. All fields of study are concerned.
montant: Allowance received by the fellow The scholar receives 1704 € per month spent in France. Other benefits - The scholarship entitles you to social security coverage. - The Campus France scholarship operator can directly reserve and pay for your accommodation (usually in a hotel residence or hotel) at a preferential rate. If you choose this option, you will contribute financially to the cost of accommodation. - Travel between Poland and France is not covered by the scholarship.
duree: between 1 and 3 months.
inscription: Fill out the form and read the rules Send the documents listed below to science.varsovie-amba@diplomatie.gouv.fr with the subject line "SSHN_Name" and respecting the nomenclature indicated in brackets for each document
pieces: → CV (CV_name): 2 pages maximum in French or English → Description of your research project (Description_name): in French or English, 2 pages maximum, including: Plan of your research project Your motivations for this research stay and expected achievements Will this work take place in the context of a previous collaboration between the two research institutions? If so, which ones? Main steps of the research work What are the long-term prospects of your research work? Do you plan to continue your collaboration after the scientific stay? → Invitation letter (Invitation_name) : Invitation letter from your French research institute in French or in English with the dates of the stay and the logo of the university / laboratory → Reference letter (Reference_name) : Reference letter from your Polish research institute in French or English
selection: Applications are received at the Embassy and reviewed by a committee of experts representing each discipline. Selected candidates will be informed in December.
countryNote: These grants are intended for Polish researchers

title: French government scholarships for PhD and researchers (SSHN) - Embassy of France in Slovakia
synthese: The Department of cooperation and cultural action at the French Embassy in Slovakia offers short-terms scholarships to Slovak PhD students and researchers. The amount of the scholarship is 1 704€/month for the junior researchers and 2055€/month for the senior researchers.
description: The internship must meet a need of the candidate to stay in France. For example, learn a technique in France that does not exist in Slovakia yet, have access to some works not available in Slovakia, realize a research study about France or follow a short and specific training in France.
montant: 1 704 €/month 2055 €/month
duree: From 1 to 3 months
maitriseLangue: The candidates applying for research scholarships must have a level of French allowing them to present, in French for about 10 minutes, their internship project and answer any possible questions from the selection panel. It is possible for a candidate applying for an internship in a laboratory to have no knowledge of French language provided that the responsible of the internship agrees.
conditions: -It is up to the candidate applying for a research scholarship to choose the place of his internship in France and to make the necessary contacts to get an acceptation letter. - Finding a research laboratory in France: https://www.campusfrance.org/en/finding-research-laboratory-France
inscription: - Applications must be sent by e-mail to the attention of Mr. Thomas Perrin (thomas.perrin@institutfrancais.sk) until 3rd November 2024.
pieces: - The application form - Copies of the obtained degrees - Acceptation letter from the French institution - Cover letter and research project - Resume in English or French
selection: The candidates preselected will be invited to present their application in French or English language in front of a selection panel.
levelNote: The excellence of the application and of the research project

title: Early Bird Scholarship - emlyon business school - Specialized programs MSc/Master
synthese: Students applying early in our recruitment process are automatically eligible to a 10% scholarship.
description: 10% scholarship guaranteed for students applying on our first recruitment session (usually in October).

title: Franco-Thai Young Talent Research Fellowship Program - Embassy of France in Thailand
synthese: The Franco-Thai Young Talent Research Fellowship Program supports Thai post-doctorates who intend to spend 2 to 6 months scientific stay in a laboratory in France.
description: The Franco-Thai Young Talent Research Fellowship Program aims at jumpstarting the career of young researchers from Thailand and from France by giving them the opportunity to develop promising collaboration with their counterparts. This program supports Thai and French post doctorates, graduated in 2019 or after, who are lecturers or researchers in public or private institutions intending to conduct a research project of 2 to 6 months within a laboratory or research center located in France (for Thai candidates) or in Thailand (for French Candidate). All fields of research will be considered and the selection will be made based on the criteria of excellence. For the candidates who are currently PhD student, they must complete their PhD by february 2024, before leaving for France. This program operated by Campus France under the coordination of the French Embassy in Thailand, is co-funded by both Thai (NXPO – PMU-B) and French (Ambassade de France) parties. Timeline : Submission d eadline : October 31, 2025 Results : March 2026 Departures can be scheduled starting in April 2026
montant: For French researcher coming to Thailand - a round trip ticket from France to Thailand (including welfare; health insurance, domestic transportation) - a monthly allowance of 1,800 € For Thai researcher coming to France (Co-funding) - a round trip ticket from Thailand to France, - a monthly living allowance of 1,800€ - the OFII and visa fees - health insurance coverage for the duration of the stay in France. For Thai researcher coming to France (PMU-B grant: Under the program of National Postgraduate/Postdoctoral System of Thailand) - a round trip ticket from Thailand to France - a monthly living allowance of 1,800€ - the OFII and visa fees - health insurance coverage for the duration of the stay in France. NB: Neither bench fees nor support for finding housing in France and Thailand will be provided by this program.
duree: A 2 to 6 month scientific stay in a laboratory in France.
maitriseLangue: Good French or English level is required.
inscription: Application must be submitted on the dedicated platfom website : https://www.francothai-science.com
pieces: Documents to be provided : - The filled and signed application form - Copy of Passport - Up-to-date résumé stating the entire curriculum (including list of publications) - Cover letter explaining motivations and interests in the project - Copy of academic diplomas - Detailed description of the research project to be conducted abroad - Letter from the hosting laboratory - Schedule of thesis defence, if PhD is still ongoing when applying Optional documents : - Academic and/or professional recommendations - Language proficiency certificates: French (TCF, DELF, DALF, academic degree,...) and/or English (TOEFL, TOEIC, etc.) - Co-funding commitment letter
selection: In order to identify the successful candidates, the selection committee will take into account : - The scientific and technical quality of the project - The methodological rigor of the project - long-term scientific and/or technical advantages - the match between the candidate's background and knowledge
countryNote: Thailand and France
domainNote: All fields are eligible.The project proposals in the Humanities , Social sciences and Innovation are strongly encouraged. Note concerning Thai candiates to PMU-B grant Under the program of National Postgraduate/Postdoctoral System of Thailand Priority will be given to projects in the following areas : Earth Science&Space, Quantum, High Energy Physics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Metaverse, BCG (Medical, Argricutural, Food, Energy, Material, Tourism), Social Humanity and Art (SHA).
levelNote: To identify the successful candidates, the selection committee will consider: The scientific and technical quality of the project The methodological rigor of the scientific approach The long term scientific and/or technical benefits The adequacy with the candidate background & knowledge

title: Scholarship Danish Education Fund
synthese: The Danish Study Fund offers grants to cover tuition fees abroad in excess of the amount awarded by the study abroad grant programme, up to a maximum of DKK 20,000.
description: The Danish Study Fund offers grants to cover tuition fees abroad that exceed the amount allocated by the study abroad grant programme, up to a maximum of DKK 20,000. To be eligible, tuition fees must be more than DKK 5,000 above the amount allocated by the study abroad scholarship programme . Applicants must be admitted to an educational establishment abroad or have a credited stay of at least one semester at an educational establishment abroad. The scholarship is awarded for full-time programmes leading to a minimum of 30 ECTS credit points per semester. Applicants must be entitled to Danish SU and pay all or part of the tuition fees themselves.
inscription: Applications must be submitted in March for spring-semester stays and in October for autumn-semester stays. Applications are selected at random from among eligible candidates.

title: Scholarships for Slovak students wishing to study in France - Slovak Government Scholarships
synthese: Scholarships for Slovak students wishing to study in France. The Slovak government offers scholarships for study stays in France. This program is aimed at Master's students who are going to France for one or two semesters.
description: Period : Semester 2, 2026 The program includes a 770€ monthly living and study grant, as well as a 250€ travel allowance to France. This program is not intended for students who will spend the whole of their studies in France, but for those who wish to spend a semester or a year on exchange.
montant: 770/month and €250 travel grant
duree: 1 or 2 semesters
inscription: Inscription is online.
pieces: The documents required are a CV, a letter of motivation, a program of study, two letters of recommendation from university teachers, a certificate of schooling and a grade point average certificate. A letter of acceptance or invitation from a French higher education institution is also required, with dates of stay.
levelNote: Master's exchange students only.

title: DFF-International Postdoctoral Travel Grant - Independent Research Fund Denmark
synthese: The DFF-International Postdoctoral Travel Grant offers up to 1,500,000 DKK for international research stays. Applicants must have obtained a PhD from a Danish institution or be about to defend their thesis within 12 months after the application deadline.
description: The DFF-International Postdoctoral Travel Grant offers up to 1,500,000 DKK for international research stays. Applicants must have obtained a PhD from a Danish institution or be about to defend their thesis within 12 months after the application deadline.
montant: The DFF-International Postdoctoral Travel Grant enables postdoctoral researchers to conduct two-year research stays at foreign institutions. Applicants can apply for funds to cover one round-trip journey and an additional allowance for accompanying family members. Salaries for technical or administrative staff are generally not covered.
duree: The DFF-International Postdoctoral Travel Grant is 1,500,000 DKK, excluding overhead/administration expenses. It covers travel, accommodation, and living expenses for research stays abroad. Applicants can also apply for an additional allowance of 55,000 DKK per year for accompanying family members.
conditions: Applicants must be Danish nationals or residents of Denmark. Research stays can be conducted worldwide, except in institutions where the applicant has already stayed for 12 months or more within the last three years. Grants are intended for postdoctoral researchers in various research fields to enhance their experience and skills. Applicants must have obtained a PhD from a Danish institution or be about to defend their thesis within 12 months after the application deadline.
inscription: Applicants must have obtained a PhD from a Danish institution or be about to defend their thesis within 12 months after the application deadline.
pieces: Applicants must submit a complete application package including a CV, motivation letter, detailed research project description, declaration from the foreign host institution, and a letter of recommendation.

title: Grants for American Students - Fulbright France
synthese: Fulbright France grants aim to support American students wishing to pursue a study and/or research project in France, starting at the Master's level.
description: Fulbright France, the Franco-American Commission, co-financed by the French and American governments, supports study and/or research visits by American students (and also by French students in the USA). Among the projects supported: - Pursuing a Master's degree at a French university or Grande école - Doing research as part of doctoral studies - Pursue a musical/artistic project The program also offers grants in partnership with: - ENS Paris-Saclay for Master and Doctoral students - ENS Rennes for Master's students - CY Cergy Paris Université for Master's students - the University of Bordeaux for PhD students - the University of Paris-Saclay for PhD students - the United States Foundation for young artists
funder: French government, Foreign governments, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies, Foundations and associations
montant: A monthly allowance and a travel allowance (details of each grant on our website).
duree: Between 6 and 12 months depending on the program.
maitriseLangue: It is recommended to understand and speak a minimum of French for a stay in France, but this depends on the program and the project (details of each grant on our website).
inscription: The applicant must submit an application to the Institute of International Education (IIE).
pieces: - Covering letter - Transcripts - Letters of recommendation - Letter of invitation from a French university or research center
selection: Pre-selection by the Institute of International Education (IIE). Evaluation and final selection by a Binational Committee organized by the French-American Fulbright France Commission. Final approval by the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board.
countryNote: American citizenship is mandatory.
levelNote: Candidates must, at least, have a Bachelor's degree at the time of their stay in France.

title: State Fellowship Apartment in Paris (Statens Legatbolig i Paris)
synthese: The Statens Legatbolig offers Danish artists and researchers the opportunity to stay in Paris for one month. Applicants with a project directly linked to Paris or France will be prioritized.
description: Managed by a foundation named after its benefactors, Ludvig Preetzmann-Aggerholm and his wife, the apartment supports Danish cultural and academic professionals by providing accommodation in Paris. The apartment is located at 3, rue de la Perle, Paris, in the heart of the Marais district. It spans two floors (not wheelchair-accessible), is fully furnished and equipped for two people, and includes a living room, sleeping alcove, bathroom, and kitchen. Rent is 2,600 EUR per month, including heating, electricity, and a phone subscription (subject to change).
montant: This is not a financial scholarship, but access to a furnished apartment in Paris for 1 month. Rent must be paid by the resident (2,600 EUR/month).
conditions: No formal degree requirements, but applicants must present a strong professional record (CV, publications, performances, or research output).
inscription: Required Documents: Completed application form. Short CV including education, publications, exhibitions, or research outcomes. Project description, including relevance of the stay in Paris. Preferred month(s) listed in order.
web1: Statens Legatbolig i Paris (Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

title: Travel grant - The Danish Pasteur Society
synthese: Support for Danish researchers in science and industry in the fields of microbiology, immunology and related sciences. The support granted mainly for periods of study abroad, in particular at the Institut Pasteur in France.

funder: French government, Foreign governments, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies, Regions and cities, Foundations and associations
montant: A monthly allowance and a travel allowance (details of each grant on our website).
duree: Between 3 and 12 months depending on the program and the project.
maitriseLangue: Depending on the project.
inscription: Applicants must submit an application to the Institute of International Education (IIE).
pieces: - Project description - Resume (CV) - Letter of invitation - Letters of recommendation
selection: Pre-selection by the Institute of International Education (IIE). Evaluation by the French Ministry of Higher Education and Research. Final selection by a Binational Committee organized by the French-American Fulbright France Commission. Final approval by the J. William Fulbright Foreign Scholarship Board.
countryNote: American citizenship is mandatory.
levelNote: Applicants must hold a PhD or its equivalent.

title: Reinholdt W. Jorck Travel Grants
synthese: The grants are intended for students, candidates, PhD students, or postdocs wishing to undertake part of their education (minimum 3 months), a full education (master's, PhD, LLM, MBA with max. 3 years of professional experience) or research (minimum 3 months) abroad. The grant can be up to 50,000 DKK.
montant: The grant can be up to 50,000 DKK per applicant.
duree: The minimum duration of the grant is 3 months for studies or research abroad.

title: Travel Grants - Synoptik-Fonden

title: IDIL Scholarship
synthese: Monthly scholarship of €600 awarded to international students studying in France for the first time. PLEASE NOTE: You will automatically be awarded this scholarship if you are admitted in an IDIL Master's Degree.
description: IDIL offers scholarships to international students accepted into one of the IDIL courses : https://idil.edu.umontpellier.fr/master-idil/les-parcours/. Important: This scholarship provides partial financial assistance and does not cover the full costs required for your stay in France. Students should plan to have additional funds for living expenses and any unforeseen costs. Scholarships are awarded as follows: -Upon Arrival: IDIL provides €600 after validation of your file (see the list of required documents). This validation generally takes place between September and October. IDIL does not cover airfare or international transportation costs. This financial aid of 600€ is only available for the first year of the Master's program and is intended to help ease your initial settlement in France. It will not be available in the second year. -Monthly Scholarship: between September and December, attendance at classes allows you to receive a “study grant” of €600 per month, applicable to both the first and second years. These grants are paid retroactively (for example, you'll receive the October grant in November), provided your administrative file was validated upon arrival (see the section on required documents). Note: The IDIL scholarship covers only the first semester of Master's Year 1 and the first semester of Master's Year 2. The second semester includes a paid internship with a stipend of around €600 per month. For more information, visit the IDIL Financial Support page: https://idil.edu.umontpellier.fr/en/accueil-des-etudiants-internationaux-2/la-prise-en-charge-idil/
montant: First year IDIL (M1) - 600 € in August - 600 €/month between September and December Total = 3000 € between August and December Second year IDIL (M2) - 600 €/month from September to December - 600 € (if single registration in M2) Total = €2400 between September and December or €3000 between August and December if enrolled directly in M2
duree: 9 months in TOTAL 5 months YEAR 1 6 months YEAR 2
maitriseLangue: B2 level in English. For certain IDIL courses, a level in French may be required. We also recommend having a basic level in French for everyday life. The IDIL programs offers free French lessons for international students.
conditions: To be eligible for the IDIL scholarship, you must meet the following requirements: -Be accepted into an IDIL program and have applied either through the Études en France platform (if you reside in a country that requires this procedure) or through Mon Master (if you live in Europe or a country not subject to Études en France). -Have no prior studies or enrollment in any French higher education institution. -Submit all required documents upon your arrival in France (including:A postal address in France, Email and phone contact details, French bank account details (RIB), ID or passport, For non-EEA residents, a copy of a valid visa, Proof of student liability insurance, Documents proving social security coverage, A copy of your University of Montpellier student card or enrollment certificate for the current and previous year) IF YOU DO NOT MEET THESE CONDITIONS, YOUR REQUEST WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.
inscription: This platform does not enable you to apply for the IDIL scholarship or for an IDIL Master's programs. Depending on your country of residence, you will need to submit your application either on the Études en France platform (with deadlines varying by country) or on Mon Master. The IDIL scholarship is automatically awarded to any international student admitted to one of the IDIL master's programs, provided that you meet the following conditions: -You have not studied at a French higher education institution in the past two years -You have completed administrative validation upon arrival in France. No specific application process is required for this scholarship. However, an administrative verification of the student's background and academic record will be carried out to confirm eligibility.
pieces: The following documents are required upon arrival in France and upon acceptance into an IDIL master's program: French Adress, mail and mobile phone number French RIB Passport or identity card For persons from outside the EEA, a copy of the valid visa Scholar or Student Civil Liability insurance certificate Proof of social security coverage A copy of your UM student card or UM school certificate
selection: All international students accepted in an IDIL program and who have not studied in a French Higher Education institution during the last 2 years and who have also validated their administrative file upon arrival in France.
countryNote: Only for international students who have not the French citizenship, and who have not studied at a French higher education institution in the last two years
domainNote: The IDIL Scholarship is ONLY awarded to students who have been selected in an IDIL course: https://idil.edu.umontpellier.fr/master-idil/les-parcours/
levelNote: You need to be accepted in an IDIL Master's Degree. For more information, you can find the entry requirements here : https://idil.edu.umontpellier.fr/inscription/

description: One of the leading French Business Schools founded in 1962, Brest Business School is a Member of the French Business Schools Association (Conférence des Grandes Ecoles), a group of the finest specialized business schools in France. Our MIB is entirely taught in English and is designed for high-potential students with little or no professional experience at all. The objective is to provide you with the technical and behavioral skills leading to a management career in an international environment. This unique and comprehensive program combines the academic rigor of courses taught by highly qualified faculty and business-oriented teaching taught by senior managers from leading MNCs and experts. title: Volontariat Franco-Allemand - Franco-German Voluntary Service
synthese: No plans for the coming year? Do you want to get moving, get involved in the public interest by improving your German? Apply now for a Volontariat Franco-Allemand (VFA) in Germany!
description: This voluntary service starts at the beginning of September and lasts 10 to 12 months. Afraid of the unknown or not up to the challenge? Is German not for you? The 4 training sessions throughout the year will help you to familiarise yourself with your environment. You'll be supervised by a Franco-German team and meet other volunteers from France and Germany. In just one year, you can meet new people, travel and improve your language and intercultural skills in a friendly environment. The framework of the Franco-German Voluntary Service: - The Franco-German Voluntary Service is a civic service: you have the status of a volunteer in the civic service. - The volunteering period always starts in September and lasts from 10 to 12 months. - Volunteers work a maximum of 35 hours per week. - Volunteers are entitled to 2 days off per month - The Franco-German Voluntary Service includes 25 days of training, divided into four seminars during the voluntary service.
montant: Civic Service Agency allowance of €558.17 Additional benefit paid by the host organisation in kind or in cash, minimum amount €114.85
duree: The Volontariat Franco-Allemand lasts from 10 to 12 months .
maitriseLangue: A minimum level of A2 in German is required, although beginners may be accepted depending on the situation.
conditions: Conditions of participation: - Be between 18 and 25 years old - Resident in France (for participants) - Depending on the type of volunteering: a certain level of fluency in German may be required.
inscription: The application period starts on 5 December 2024 . For school, university and OFAJ volunteers: Visit the platform: vfa-in.ofaj.org For volunteers from local authorities or associations: Go directly to the OFAJ website
pieces: CV and covering letter
domainNote: There are several areas of Franco-German Voluntary Service: School sector University sector Volunteering with the OFAJ In the community Then in associations: Sports sector Social work field Ecology field Cultural field
levelNote: No diploma is required for the Franco-German Voluntary Service

title: Scholarships France Excellence IFA 2024
synthese: Every year, the French Institute of Algeria financially supports candidates studying in Algeria in their pursuit of studies in France according to criteria of academic excellence and priority fields of study.
description: As part of the 6th edition of its “France Excellence IFA” scholarship program, the French Institute of Algeria is awarding twenty-five scholarships for the 2024-2025 academic year to welcome students from Algeria in Master 2 in French higher education establishments. The call for applications is open from April 16, 2024 to May 16, 2024 at midnight (Algiers time) and concerns Algerian students or residents in Algeria, having already completed their Campus France Algérie procedure for a year of study in France in 2024/2025, by providing in their application file a letter of acceptance for Master 2 in a French higher education establishment.
montant: The winners will receive an excellence grant worth €860/month over a period of 12 months. They will also benefit from the following conditions: free visa (consular fees); covering the Algeria-France return trip; health and civil liability insurance coverage during the stay; free registration fees for the preparation of a national diploma in most public establishments.

maitriseLangue: Mastery of the French language required
inscription: The call for applications is open from April 16, 2024 to May 16, 2024 at midnight (Algiers time)
pieces: The application file must include all of the following documents: Passport Cover letter (2 pages maximum) Curriculum Vitae (2 pages maximum) Master 2 acceptance letter Last diploma obtained (with translation into French) Transcripts for the last 4 years of study (with translation into French)
selection: We advise candidates to read the call for applications carefully to prepare all the documents in their file and then to submit a complete file via the online form. NB: incomplete files will be declared inadmissible. Application Timeline April 16, 2024: opening of applications; May 16, 2024: applications close; End of May: notification of results; September/October 2024: arrival of the winners in France and start of their training. If you have any questions, please send an email to grants-excellence@if-algerie.com
countryNote: The scholarship is awarded for a single academic year. It is therefore up to the student to provide the financial means necessary to possibly continue their studies in France beyond the period covered by the scholarship. Funding for grade repetition is not possible

levelNote: This call for applications concerns Algerian students or residents in Algeria, having already completed their Campus France Algeria procedure for a year of study in France in 2024/2025, by providing in their application file a letter of acceptance into Master 2 in a French higher education establishment. title: Master 2 Scholarship - The Grenoble Alliance for Integrated Structural & Cell Biology
synthese: The Grenoble Alliance for Integrated Structural & Cell Biology (GRAL) funds Master 2 research scholarships. description: In the framework of the Chemistry Biology Health (CBH) Graduate School of Université Grenoble Alpes, the GRAL research programme funds MSc (Master 2) research scholarships. We seek motivated candidates planning to: - attend one of the following Master programmes (2nd year MSc / Master 2 / M2) at Université Grenoble Alpes (taught in English): - Master in Biology: - Structural Biology of Pathogens - Neurobiology, Neurosciences - Physiology, Epigenetics, Development, Cell Differentiation - Master in Plant Biology: PLANTA International - Master in Health Engineering: BioHealth Engineering - & do a research internship in Integrated & Structural Cell Biology at one of the labs associated with the GRAL programme in Grenoble: BGE, BioSanté, IBS, LCBM, and LPCV. The list of possible research projects is available on GRAL's website: https://www.labex-gral.fr/gral-master-2-scholarships-2025-2026
funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies
montant: 5500 € paid during the 1st semester (2 instalments) + an internship grant (‘gratification de stage‘) during the 6-month research internship (ca. 600€ per month)
duree: 1 academic year
conditions: The admission to a 2nd year MSc programme (M2) at Université Grenoble Alpes is fully independent of the GRAL Scholarship. Application deadlines may differ between the different programmes. See admission requirements on Université Grenoble Alpes's website: http://www.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/fr/grandes-missions/formation/candidatures-et-inscriptions/ The scholarship is conditional to the registration to one of the above programmes of the master's degree in Biology, Plant Biology, or Health Engineering of Université Grenoble Alpes, and to the recipient maintaining a satisfactory academic record in the programme. We strongly recommend that the candidates take contact with the potential supervisor(s) for the research project(s) of interest.

title: Graduate Programme "Changing cultures, societies, practices" in Lille
synthese: Join a stimulating, competitive and innovative scientific environment that gathers research-driven Master's degree and PhD courses in various disciplinary fields in order to tackle on the challenges of the contemporary world in a global research dynamic on transition.
description: The Graduate Programme "Changing cultures, societies, practices" brings together 16 master's degrees as well as 3 Graduate Schools "Sciences Économiques, Sociales, de l'Aménagement et du Management", "Sciences Juridiques, Politiques et de Gestion" and "Sciences Humaines et Sociales" and relies on 28 research units internationally renowned in their field. Master's students and doctoral students are immersed in a high-level research environment, based on the main themes of the Lille laboratories. This programme prepares students to tackle the interdisciplinary challenges of global transition in contemporary societies from three different angles : Changing institutions and organisations Vulnerabilities and inclusion Europe, historical constructions and transition dynamics Joining the Graduate Programme "Changing cultures, societies, practices" assures each student: an international training: thematic courses, grants available to complete an internship abroad interdisciplinary skills: summer schools, scientific conferences, joint courses reinforced individual support to define its career from the second year of master (M2) to its professional life, based on a network of professionals from the private and public sector and on opportunities to pursue a PhD . Each year, scholarships are available for students applying for M2 in one of the Masters courses concerned. See the list of the 16 Masters courses concerned in the tab "Particularities concerning the fields".
funder: Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies, Regions and cities
montant: Applicants can either apply for the first year of a Master's or the second year of a Master's. Scholarships for the academic year are dedicated to students with the highest academic records. The amount of the grant varies between €4,500 and €8,500 for one academic year depending on the student's profile. 1. FOREIGN CITIZEN APPLICANTS ☑️ Eligibility: incoming international students enrolling for the first time a French higher education institution in a master track of one of the Graduate Programmes. ☑️ €8,500 2. FRENCH CITIZEN APPLICANTS AND RENEWAL ☑️ Eligibility: first-time French students, international students already in France, and those extending their scholarship into the second year, in a master track of Graduate Programmes. ☑️ €4,500
duree: The Graduate Programme scholarship is awarded for the academic year and is not automatically renewed. A new application must be submitted for any renewal.
maitriseLangue: Most courses are taught in French, but some masters are taught entirely in English. Before enrolling, please enquire about the language of instruction. A minimum level of B2 in the language of instruction is required.
conditions: Deadlines for applications : #1 call: March 15, 2025 #2 call: May 15, 2025
inscription: The student must fill up her/his application for the scholarship via the dedicated application platform (link below) with the required documents. Application for scholarship and application to the master degree are two independent procedures. They must be completed both separately. Thus, the student must apply alongside to the master degree she/he is interested in and that is part of the Graduate Programme. Depending on the country, the student must follow the StudyinFrance Campus France procedure or the e-candidat procedure (in this case each master has its own deadline for application).

title: Ecole national des chartes - CHambrun foundation scholarship
synthese: A 4-year scholarship is being offered by the Fondation Chambrun-Lafayette to support the education of a foreign student enrolled on the paleographer archivist course at the Ecole nationale des chartes - PSL from the start of the academic year 2025.
description: The Ecole nationale des chartes - PSL is an institution of excellence for training archivists, heritage curators and researchers in history and the sciences ancillary to history. Training as an archivist palaeographer is accessible from ‘Baccalaureat grade + 2 years' level; as all courses are in French, the required level of French for the candidate is then C1. This scholarship, financed by the Fondation Chambrun-Lafayette, provides support for a foreign student wishing to enrol on the course offered by the École nationale des chartes - PSL in Paris. Students from the international selection process follow the same curriculum as the French candidates who have passed the entrance exam for the diploma in paleographic archiving (attending courses and internships, writing a 'school thesis' and obtaining the diploma). They are appointed “foreign students” by ministerial decree and graduates become “foreign archivist-paleographers ”. Like all students applying for the diploma of archivist-paleographer, candidates must write a thesis for the School. The specific feature is that the candidate will have to commit to a thesis on a theme related to General Lafayette, his era, his networks, his ideas and their posterity (‘Éclairages sur le Général La Fayette et son environnement historique et culturel, en France et dans le monde, du règne de Louis XV à la Monarchie de Juillet'). Candidates must indicate their intention for the subject of their thesis when applying The purpose of the Chambrun-La Fayette Foundation is to preserve, restore and maintain General La Fayette's château, known as Château de Lagrange, to classify, complete and promote all the archives of the General and his family and, more generally, to raise awareness of the personality, life and ideas of La Fayette, who devoted his life to the defence of the democratic ideal
montant: The foundation will pay an allowance of 1500€ per month on the school year (1octopber to 30 June) over 4 years to a foreign student who have enrolled .
duree: 4 years (oct 2025 to June 2029)
maitriseLangue: C1 in French
inscription: see the website for the detailed conditions Application has to be sent to the school before May 11 2025. email : etudes@chartes.psl.eu email : ri@chartes.psl.eu

synthese: The EUR LIVE - Graduate School of Research offers a three-year doctoral contract for motivated applicants eager to work on Vulnerability in Health with an interdisciplinary approach.
description: The EUR LIVE Graduate School of Research offers a transdisciplinary training in research from Master to Ph.D. to study the different facets of vulnerability in health, biology, epidemiology, economics, and environmental sciences. The program combines the knowledge of three pillars: Health & Biology Health Economics & Public Health Health & Environment. The call for Ph.D. doctoral grants is open to all nationalities. The grant covers a three-year doctoral contract for motivated applicants eager to work on Vulnerability in Health with an interdisciplinary approach. High potential students are selected every year among national and international candidates. Find out the call for doctoral scholarships 2025-2028 and the specific criteria by pillar on our webpage. The EUR LIVE doctoral grant gives laureates the opportunity to: Encourage mobility with financial support for internships or grants for research projects. Enhance pedagogical exchanges between different UPEC departments, collaborating with academic and non-academic partners. Graduating from associated Doctoral Schools, EUR LIVE PhD students will achieve their research in co-direction with other universities (national or from abroad). Join the EUR LIVE alumni to ensure optimal professional integration.

title: Postdoctoral grants - The Fyssen Foundation
synthese: The Fyssen Foundation supports postdoctoral researchers studying the logical mechanisms of human and animal behavior. Grants are made for 1 or 2 years. The annual amount is €45,000.
description: GOALS The aim of the FYSSEN Foundation is to encourage all forms of scientific inquiry into cognitive mechanisms, including thought and reasoning, which underlie animal and humain behaviour; their biological and cultural bases, and phylogenetic and ontogenetic development. The selected projects will concern the following disciplines : Ethology - Psychology/ Neurobiology / Social Anthropology / Human Paleontology - Archaeology The Fyssen Foundation fellowship grants a maximum of 45 000 Euros per year for a first post-doc. Grants are allocated from 12 months to 24 months, not renewable.
montant: Annual maximum of 45 000 EUROS
duree: Grants are allocated from 12 months to 24 months, not renewable.
age: Be under 35-years-old on the closing date of the call for projects.
conditions: Have a university thesis (PhD or equivalent) for less than two years on September 1st of the year of application. Not be installed in the host laboratory for more than 3 months at the date of Septembre 1st. Regarding the host laboratories located in France: the recipient will be hosted within a framework of a fixed-term contract, and will have to make sure that a convention of co-financing can be signed between the Foundation and the laboratory to reach the level of the gross salary.
pieces: Requested documents to complete the folder : The application form An invitation letter of the host laboratory The letters of two scientific personalities able to evaluate the program and the research of the candidate (A letter of recommendation can not be written by a member belonging to the host laboratory, but it may come from a thesis supervisor, a member of your thesis examiners, for example) The research project on 8 pages maximum drafted in French or in English (Font size 12, simple interline 1,0) A complete description of the research project including: (a) objectives, (b) methods used to collect data and data analysis (c) expected results and their theoretical significance. title: EUR CREATES 2025 - Scholarship
synthese: To be eligible for a scholarship for one of EUR CREATES' Master's programs, the student must have at least a Bac +3 level (or equivalent) from a French or foreign university and wish to continue their studies in a EUR CREATES program. Additionally, the student must have an overall grade-point average of at least 14/20.
description: EUR CREATES (Creativity, Transformation, Emergence) is the college of Arts and Humanities at Université Côte d'Azur (Nice, France). EUR CREATES offers training and research in the following fields: Arts; literature, languages, cultures, and foreign civilizations; philosophy; information and communication sciences; linguistics; history and archaeology; anthropology and ethnology; management and business sciences; psychology; education sciences. EUR CREATES offers more than 24 accredited master's programs, around twenty doctoral degrees within the SHAL Doctoral School (Society, Humanities, Arts, and Literature), including three in the specific field of artistic research (music, arts, and writings), as well as short training programs (residencies, Summer School, etc.), in collaboration with industrial partners or national and international institutions (Vivendi/Canal, INA, Dolby©). This call for applications aims to increase the attractiveness of all Master's programs offered by EUR CREATES at the national and international levels and targets students who have demonstrated academic excellence. The scholarship will cover the the first or the second year of the awardee's Master's program.
montant: SCHOLARSHIP PAYMENTS The scholarship amount is 10,000 € and is paid in monthly installments. The scholarship will be paid subject to the recipient's attendance, meaning they must attend classes and exams throughout the academic year. Failure to provide evidence of attendance will result in the immediate suspension of the scholarship payment. The amount of the scholarship is 1000 euros per month for 10 months; any potential internship compensation may be combined if allowed by current regulations. Non-EU students who receive this scholarship may be eligible for a partial exemption from differentiated tuition fees, subject to meeting the exemption conditions voted at UCA. Master's programs involving work-study/apprenticeship are not eligible for this scholarship program.
age: There is no age limit or nationality requirement for the attribution of this scholarship.
conditions: MASTER'S PROGRAMS OFFERED: Master Arts Parcours Danse Parcours Musique Parcours Théâtre Parcours Anthropologie des arts vivants Master LLCE Parcours Langues et métiers de la culture Parcours Tradaptation : sous-titrage et doublage des productions cinématographiques et audiovisuelles (TSD) Master Lettres Parcours Métiers des Lettres Classiques et Modernes Parcours Recherche et création à distance Parcours Mondes du document Master Humanités et Industries créatives Parcours Management de jeu vidéo, image, créativité (MAJIC) Parcours Management de projet, Innovation, créativité (MAPIC) Master Information, communication Parcours Médias et humanités numériques Parcours Évènementiel, médiation et ingénierie de la culture – Arts actuels, musées et patrimoine (EMIC) Parcours Media design Parcours Ingénierie de la communication organisationnelle, numérique et stratégique (ICONES) Master Langues Étrangères Appliquées Parcours Traduction et Rédaction d'Entreprise Parcours Langues et affaires internationales : relations franco-italiennes Master Philosophie Parcours Philosophie contemporaine et métiers de la philosophie Master Psychologie : psychopathologie clinique psychanalytique Parcours Psychopathologie Psychanalytique et Cliniques Transculturelles Parcours Psychanalyse Master Sciences du langage Parcours Sciences du langage Master Français Langue Étrangère Parcours Didactique du Français langue étrangère et langue seconde
inscription: CALENDAR FOR THE CALL: - Launch of the call: October 2024 - Deadline: March 30, 2025 - Results: April 30, 202 Deadline for scholarship acceptance by candidates: May 30, 2025 PROCEDURE Administrative validation of applications (see "Eligibility Criteria" and "Applications" sections) Validation and pre-ranking of applications by the EUR CREATES executive committee Final ranking of applications by the EUR CREATES COPIL based on the evaluation criteria outlined above. Applications must be submitted electronically as a single "zip" file by email to "eur-creates.contact@univ-cotedazur.fr" before March 30, 2025. The subject of the email should be: "Candidature Bourse de Recherche Master" (failure to do so will result in exclusion).
pieces: The zip file should contain the following documents: - A CV of no more than two pages - A letter of motivation in French, signed by the head of the chosen Master's program (for students wishing to enroll for the first time in a EUR CREATES Master's program) or the current program (for students currently enrolled in the first year of a EUR CREATES Master's program) - A research project (minimum of 4 pages) outlining how the choice of program aligns with a detailed research project and EUR's research themes, including a bibliography (at least one page). If applicable, the presentation of the research project should also mention the candidate's doctoral project, including its link to the EUR's research themes. - Academic transcripts, rankings for Bachelor's years, and possibly Master's years (translated into French for foreign students). For foreign diplomas, explanations of the grading scale must be attached. - A copy of the passport or national identity card. AWARDING OF THE SCHOLARSHIP Starting from the notification date, the selected candidate has one month to accept the scholarship. A lack of response during this time period will be considered a refusal of the scholarship, which will automatically be awarded to the candidate ranked second. Once admitted to the Master's program, the candidate must complete all necessary administrative procedures for registration. The awarding of this scholarship is conditional on acceptance into the Master's program.
selection: EVALUATION OF APPLICATIONS Applications will be evaluated according to the following criteria: The excellence of the candidate as demonstrated by their academic record. The candidate must have shown particularly high academic performance (14/20 grade-point average). The relevance, originality, and feasibility of the proposed research project. The candidate's motivation to potentially pursue a PhD within an EUR CREATES lab will be particularly valued. An interview (via videoconference) may be scheduled, if necessary.
levelNote: ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA To be eligible for a scholarship for one of EUR CREATES' Master's programs, the student must have at least a Bac +3 level (or equivalent) from a French or foreign university and wish to continue their studies in a EUR CREATES program. Additionally, the student must have an overall grade-point average of at least 14/20 (or equivalent). There is no age limit or nationality requirement for the attribution of this scholarship.

title: EDHEC EMERGING COUNTRY DOCTORAL SCHOLARSHIP
synthese: In the context of the EDHEC PhD in Finance programme, the school can offer financial assistance for admitted applicants (merit-based and means-tested scholarships) residing and working in countries classified as low- or middle-income by the World Bank
description: In the context of the PhD in Finance programme, the school can offer financial assistance for admitted applicants (merit-based and means-tested scholarships) . The EDHEC Emerging Country Doctoral Scholarships are open to self-funded applicants residing and working in countries classified as low- or middle-income by the World Bank, who wish to pursue the EDHEC- PhD in Finance programme (executive track). They may apply for merit-based and means-tested scholarships representing up to 50% of tuition fees. The scheme is intended for practitioners who join the programme without interrupting their careers and who can demonstrate outstanding academic and/or professional achievements. Low- or middle-income countries by the World Bank: https://data.worldbank.org/income-level/low-and-middle-income
montant: The scholarship can represent up to 50% of tuition fees.
duree: The programme is delivered over three years.
maitriseLangue: Fluent in English. the language of Instruction is English and the thesis is written in English.
conditions: PhD in Finance applicants should indicate their interest in the scholarship when they file their application for admission and submit a cover letter in support of their application to the scholarship. Where relevant, applicants may also concurrently or subsequently submit a letter of support from their employer explaining why they are sponsoring the applicant and describing what support they would be extending should the applicant be admitted to the programme and/or be awarded a scholarship. Scholarships are awarded for three successive years subject to respect of normal progression and maintenance of good standing in the programme, and no participant's change of country of residence. For futher details, please visit: https://www.edhec.edu/en/phd-finance/admissions-fees-and-funding
inscription: Admission to the EDHEC PhD in Finance programme is highly selective. Normal requirements include: a master's degree (or equivalent) from an accredited school, college, or university (business management, economics, science, and engineering degrees are preferred); academic excellence; superior scholastic potential (certified by GMAT or GRE scores - the average participant in the programme has a GMAT of 695); relevant professional experience; and English proficiency. The prerequisites for the PhD in Finance are courses covering financial economics, econometrics, and stochastic modelling (Master's level). Applicaiton form can be downloaded at: https://www.edhec.edu/en/phd-finance/download-application-form
pieces: PhD in Finance applicants should indicate their interest in the scholarship when they file their application for admission and submit a cover letter in support of their application to the scholarship. If the application is positively considered for admissions, the following documents will be required: a proof of residence and employment, the latest three payslips, the tax assessment notifications for the two calendar years preceding the scholarship application (tax return may be accepted in the event that the tax assessment notifications are not yet available). Description of how the applicant intend to fund programme expenses and list of all other funding the applicatn may receive.
