title: ASHINAGA AFRICA INITIATIVE
synthese: The Ashinaga Africa Initiative is an international leadership program that cultivates the next generation of leaders to contribute to the development of sub-Saharan Africa. AAI Scholars have lost one or both parents and are committed to returning to sub-Saharan Africa to initiate change, innovation, and development.
description: The Ashinaga Africa Initiative began in 2014. Its mission is to contribute to sub-Saharan Africa's expanding role in global development through increasing access to higher education abroad. We support orphaned students who are committed to returning home and initiating change, by providing access to full financial support to study at a university abroad (equivalent to an undergraduate degree). Ashinaga support covers tuition, accommodation, travel costs, and other necessary fees.
montant: Stipends provided in France, varies in other countries: 400 euros per month Exact rent Exact tuition Transport between country of origin and country of study Stipend for installation/moving costs
duree: Maximum duration of the scholarship : 3 to 5 years, length of first possible diploma (repeating academic year will result in the end of the scholarship)
maitriseLangue: Fluent writing and speaking in either French OR English
conditions: The application is open to those who; · Have lost one or both parents. · Have completed secondary school and received the results of their national secondary school examinations (technical and vocational degrees not accepted) within the last two years (any date after 1st August 2022, including all of 2023 and 2024) or will have completed secondary school and received final exam results before February 9th, 2025. · Be born after 1st September 2002. · Not have the means to attend university abroad without external financial support. · Be proficient in English, French or Portuguese. · Be regularly ranked in the top 10% of their class during their last 2 or 3 years of secondary school. · Be able to participate in the two Ashinaga preparatory programs, over the course of one year, before attending university. · Be committed to return home, or to Sub-Saharan Africa, and contribute to society in Sub-Saharan Africa after graduating from university. · Have no dependents who could interfere with academic progress. · Have a good enough health condition to be able to study abroad
inscription: Applications open Octobre 2024. There are two stages to apply; Applicant Registration: all applicants must first confirm their eligibility by registering for the programme. Only students who register for the programme and are deemed eligible will receive the application form by email. Each decision about an applicant's eligibility is based on the criteria outlined above and their academic record. Our expectations for the academic record of an applicant reflects the academic level we expect students to have in order thrive as part of our intensive leadership programme. Application: all students who register for the program will receive an email with a link to the application form within 1 month of their registration if they are eligible for the program. We strongly recommend applying online.
pieces: Create a new account using the 'Register' button at the top of this page. Follow the instructions to complete the applicant registration form. Documents to Submit for Registration Photo or scan of at least one of the following documents; Passport, National ID Card or Birth Certificate Photo or scan of your most recent Secondary School Term Report/Transcript Photo or scan of your final Secondary School Examination Results Certificate (if applicable)** **For students receiving their examination results in February 2023, we will ask you to send your examination certificate as soon as possible after you have received it.
selection: Study of application and attached documents done in country of applicants' residence or via videoconference
countryNote: Applicants must have completed secondary school and passed national secondary school examination (technical and vocational degrees not accepted) in one of the 45 countries listed as eligible countries.
domainNote: All subjects except for medicine
levelNote: The offer of the scholarship is for a Bachelors or a Licence with possibility of Masters

title: Feodor-Lynen research grant - Alexander von Humboldt Foundation
synthese: The Feodor Lynen research grant supports you, whether you are a post-doctoral student or an experienced researcher, in your research project abroad.
description: Through this scholarship, funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research, the Humboldt Foundation enables German researchers with above-average qualifications at all career levels and in all disciplines to spend research periods with members of the Humboldt network around the world.
montant: The amount of the grant varies according to your living situation. For an individual calculation of the amount, please use the scholarship calculator. Travel expenses will be reimbursed additionally. https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/bewerben/foerderprogramme/feodor-lynen-forschungsstipendium/stipendienrechner-fuer-feodor-lynen-stipendien
duree: Post-doctoral students can apply for a grant of 6 to 24 months, while experienced researchers can apply for a grant of 6 to 18 months (which can be divided into a maximum of three stays over three years).
maitriseLangue: You must have a good knowledge of French or at least a very good knowledge of English.
conditions: The Feodor Lynen research scholarship is aimed at German researchers with a doctorate and above-average qualifications, whatever their discipline. Postdocs You completed your doctorate less than four years ago Or you can complete your doctorate in a maximum of six months and submit the results in writing. In addition, you have already published scientific articles in journals and publishers assessed according to international standards. Experienced researchers You completed your doctorate less than twelve years ago. A long list of scientific publications in journals and publishers referenced according to international standards, as well as your previous work, prove the specificity of your scientific profile.
inscription: On the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation website
pieces: Curriculum vitae in tabular form (maximum two pages) Presentation of your research project (maximum five pages) Complete list of your publications List of main publications If necessary: acceptance statements and/or confirmations of receipt from publishers as well as abstracts/translations of main publications not available in German or English Doctoral certificate or proof of successful completion of the doctoral procedure, or confirmation that it will take place within the next 6 months.
selection: The selection committee responsible for your application meets every February, June and October. Please send your completed application form, together with any additional documents required, in good time before the desired selection date. Applications generally take four to seven months to process. In the case of incomplete or incorrect applications, the processing time is extended accordingly, so that a postponement to a later selection session is often necessary. The deadline for fulfilling certain formal requirements, particularly with regard to career limits and previous stays in the host country, is the day on which the application is received. After the selection meeting, the avh-Stiftung will inform you of the result by e-mail as soon as possible.
domainNote: The scholarship is open to all fields of research.

Additional funding from the DFJW is not possible if the internship remuneration and/or funding exceeds 1,000 euros per month. Das Stipendium kann mit Förderprogrammen anderer Organisationen (außer DAAD und DFH) kombiniert werden. title: Paul-André Crépeau Scholarship - The Canadian Institute for Advanced Legal Studies
synthese: The Canadian Institute for Advanced Legal Studies' French Language Scholarship covers the tuition fees payable to a university outside Canada for a course of study conducted in French, as well as a portion of living expenses and travel expenses, subject to any other awards received by the recipient
description: The purpose of the scholarship is to support advanced legal studies leading to a second-cycle or third-cycle diploma (the equivalent of a master's or doctoral degree from a Canadian university) at university outside Canada in a program of study that is conducted in French, or to allow for a one-year stay within the scope of a doctoral program jointly supervised with a French-language university outside Canada. The recipient must have earned a bachelor's or master's degree in law from a Canadian university within four years preceding the proposed year of studies. In order to receive the scholarship, the recipient must have been accepted by a university outside Canada into a graduate course of study in law conducted in French or must already be enrolled in and pursuing a jointly supervised doctoral program. Candidates need not have received confirmation of their acceptance at the time of their application or at the time the scholarship recipient is selected.
montant: Each year, the Canadian Institute for Advanced Legal Studies determines the maximum amount of the scholarship, up to an amount of $20,000 for 2025-2026, taking into account the tuition fees as well as the other anticipated living expenses and travel expenses.
age: The recipient must have earned a bachelor's or master's degree in law from a Canadian university within four years preceding the proposed year of studies.
inscription: Applications, submitted by mail or email and addressed as follows, must be received NO LATER THAN DECEMBER 31, 2024: Anne Thomas, Vice-President and Secretary Canadian Institute for Advanced Legal Studies P.O.Box 43538, Leaside Post Office 1601 Bayview Avenue Toronto, Ontario, M4G 4G8 Telephone: 416 429 3292 Email: info@canadian-institute.com Website: www.canadian-institute.com
pieces: Applications must include: 1. A curriculum vitae; 2. A personal written statement explaining the proposed graduate course of study or, where applicable, the state of progress of the jointly supervised PhD; 3. A copy of transcripts for undergraduate and graduate studies, for studies in law or for a bar admission course, as applicable; 4. No more than three letters of reference; and 5. A statement of tuition fees and anticipated living and travel expenses.
selection: A selection committee established annually by the Institute for this purpose will examine applications, having regard, in particular, to the applicant's academic record and the proposed course of study. The awarding of a scholarship is subject to the committee's verification that the eligibility criteria have been met. The selection committee reserves the right not to award the scholarship in the event that no applicants are considered to be qualified. Decisions of the selection committee are final. SELECTION OF THE SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENT The Institute will contact the scholarship recipient by April 15, 2025.

title: Praxes - Voluntary Internships - Franco-German Youth Office
synthese: [EN] Have a work experience [DE] Eine berufliche Erfahrung machen
description: [EN] The PRAXES programme is aimed at young adults between the ages of 18 and 30 who live in Germany and who would like to do a voluntary internship abroad in France, regardless of their education or employment. Not only will you get to know everyday working life in another country and discover new cultural and living habits, but you will also expand your professional, social and personal skills. In this way, you can enhance your CV and improve your French skills at the same time. The internship in France, which lasts between one and six months, is chosen by the participants themselves. You can find current internship offers on the PRAXES job board, for example. The DFJW issues the convention de stage (internship agreement) required for internships in France. In addition, there is pedagogical support throughout the entire duration of the internship, e.g. in the form of telephone conversations and self-assessment forms. [DE] Das Programm PRAXES richtet sich an junge Erwachsene zwischen 18 und 30 Jahren mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, die unabhängig von Ihrer Ausbildung oder von Ihrem Arbeitsverhältnis ein freiwilliges Auslandspraktikum in Frankreich absolvieren möchten. Sie lernen nicht nur den Berufsalltag in einem anderen Land kennen und entdecken neue Kultur- und Lebensgewohnheiten, sondern erweitern zusätzlich Ihre fachlichen, sozialen und persönlichen Kompetenzen. So können Sie Ihren Lebenslauf aufwerten und gleichzeitig Ihre Französischkenntnisse verbessern. Das ein- bis sechsmonatiges Praktikum in Frankreich wird dabei von den Teilnehmenden selber gesucht. Aktuelle Praktikumsangebote finden Sie zum Beispiel über das PRAXES-Jobboard. Das DFJW stellt die in Frankreich für Praktika notwendige convention de stage (Praktikumsvereinbarung) aus. Darüber hinaus gibt es während der gesamten Dauer des Praktikums eine pädagogische Begleitung, z. B. in Form von Telefongesprächen und Selbsteinschätzungsbögen.
montant: [EN] Flat-rate mobility grant of 500€, which is aimed at participants with increased support needs. The DFJW covers the costs of additional insurance for the duration of the internship. This consists of travel health insurance, accident insurance and liability insurance. [DE] Pauschale Mobilitätsförderung von 500€, welches sich an Teilnehmende mit einem erhöhten Förderbedarf richtet. Das DFJW übernimmt die Kosten für eine Zusatzversicherung über die Dauer des Praktikums. Diese besteht aus einer Auslandsreisekrankenversicherung, einer Unfallversicherung sowie einer Haftpflichtversicherung
duree: [EN] 1-6 months [DE] 1-6 Monate
inscription: [EN] Would you like to take part in the Praxes programme and plunge into French professional life? Find your internship yourself or via the PRAXES job board. Once you have found an internship and meet the eligibility requirements, you must contact the OFAJ team. [DE] Sie möchten am Programm Praxes teilnehmen und sich in das französische Berufsleben stürzen? Finden Sie Ihr Praktikum selbst oder über das PRAXES-Jobboard. Sobald Sie einen Praktikumsplatz gefunden haben und die Teilnahmebedingungen erfüllen, Sie müssen das OFAJ-Team kontaktieren.
pieces: [EN] Contact the team by e-mail or phone, receive personal access data to the PRAXES@IN platform, complete the information on the platform with the help of the internship company: personal data, information on the internship, education and diplomas, CV, letter of motivation, European health insurance card, after verification, sending of the contract documents by the DFJW (processing fee of 50€ to be paid by the intern), sending of an original of the signed internship agreement as well as the training contract to the DFJW before the start of the internship. [DE] Team per E-Mail oder Telefon Kontaktieren, Erhalt der persönlichen Zugangsdaten zur PRAXES@IN Plattform, Vervollständigung der Informationen auf der Plattform mithilfe des Praktikumsbetriebes: persönliche Daten, Angaben zum Praktikum, Ausbildungen und Diplome, Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, europäische Krankenversicherungskarte, Nach Überprüfung Versand der Vertragsdokumente durch das DFJW (Bearbeitungsgebühr von 50€ ist von Praktikantin bzw. dem Praktikanten zu tragen), Versand eines Originals der unterzeichneten Prakitkumsvereinbarung sowie des Weiterbildungsvertrag an das DFJW vor Praktikumsbeginn.

synthese: The DFJW provides a scholarship to support compulsory internships in France that are recognised by the German home university as part of the Bachelor's degree programm
description: [EN] You have to complete a compulsory internship as part of your Bachelor's degree and would like to gain experience abroad - preferably in France? Then the DFJW has just the right support for you. With the DFJW-supported, subject-related internship in France, you will gain important professional experience, discover the culture and way of life on the other side of the Rhine and improve your intercultural skills and French language skills. [DE] Ihr müsst im Rahmen eures Bachelorstudiums ein Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren und möchtet dabei gerne Auslandserfahrung sammeln - am besten in Frankreich? Dann hat das DFJW genau die richtige Förderung für euch im Angebot. Mit dem vom DFJW unterstützten, fachbezogenen Praktikum in Frankreich sammelt ihr wichtige Berufserfahrungen, entdeckt die Kultur und Lebensweise jenseits des Rheins und verbessert eure interkulturellen Kompetenzen und Französischkenntnisse.

description: [EN] The Rhineland-Palatinate Scholarship Foundation supports students, graduates and young researchers who wish to do an exchange during their studies with a French partner university. title: Language assistants at foreign universities - DAAD
synthese: The aim of the programme is to enable university graduates to gain further academic qualifications in the field of academic teaching abroad following their studies.
description: [EN] Funding is provided for teaching stays at foreign host universities. The scholarship holders independently organise German lessons, practical language and German studies courses in the local departments of German Studies, Translation Studies or in German lessons accompanying their studies - usually for 8 to 10 hours per week. The teaching activities are usually supervised by the host university and - at many locations - also by a DAAD Lektor. [DE] Gefördert werden Lehraufenthalte an ausländischen Gasthochschulen. Die Stipendiatinnen und Stipendiaten gestalten dort - im Umfang von in der Regel 8 bis 10 Wochenstunden - eigenständig Deutschunterricht, sprachpraktische und deutschlandkundliche Lehrveranstaltungen in den dortigen Fachbereichen der Germanistik, der Übersetzungswissenschaften oder im studienbegleitenden Deutschunterricht. Die Lehrtätigkeit wird in der Regel von der Gasthochschule sowie - an vielen Standorten - zusätzlich von einem DAAD-Lektor bzw. einer DAAD-Lektorin fachlich betreut.
montant: [EN] The scholarship includes the following benefits: - a monthly scholarship instalment determined according to the host country -Travel allowance depending on the host country -sickness, accident and personal liability insurance benefits [DE] Das Stipendium umfasst die folgenden Leistungen: - eine monatliche, je nach Gastland festgelegte Stipendienrate -Reisekostenzuschuss je nach Gastland -Leistungen zur Kranken-, Unfall- und Privathaftpflichtversicherung
duree: [EN] The stay at the foreign university is intended for the duration of one academic year (usually 9 to 10 months). In exceptional cases and after examination of strict criteria, the stay at the host university can be extended by another academic year. inscription: Online

title: Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) - Visiting Fellowships for Young Researchers
synthese: The Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE), in collaboration with Campus France, funds the Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) Visiting Fellowships Program for Young Researchers wishing to conduct further research in France.
description: The MOPGA Visiting Fellowships Program for Young Researchers will be supporting researchers working on topics listed in the "Research Themes" section : https://www.campusfrance.org/en/mopga-priority-research-topics
montant: The fellowship includes the following benefits: Monthly allowance of 2,500 euros Moving allowance of 500 euros Support for social security coverage Support for health insurance
duree: 40 fellowships will be awarded over a 12-month period from September 2024 .
maitriseLangue: Researches will be conducted in French or in English depending of the requirements of the host laboratory.
conditions: Candidates must not have resided in France between October 9th 2023 and January 9th 2024 (more than 90 days). The start of the MOPGA Visiting Fellowships for Young Researchers is due to take effect in September 2024.
inscription: Description of the research projet (in English or in French): Title of the Project Keywords (6) Abstract of the Research Project (2,000 characters max.) Context and Motivation (2,000 characters max.) Scientific Objectives (2,000 characters max.) Methodology and Planning report (4,500 characters max.) Project position in relation with the MOPGA scientific domain (2,000 characters max.) Collaborations and/or impacts for the candidate's country of residence in relation to the research project proposal (2,000 characters max.)
pieces: Documents needed: CV including the list of your publications in English PhD Diploma (or certificate of PhD diploma) CV of your research supervisor in the French host institution (2 pages max.) Letter of support from the French host institution Letters of recommendation (3 max.) Passport or proof of ID
countryNote: All nationalities, except the French one.
domainNote: Five broad research themes are prioritized: Earth systems, Climate change and sustainability, Energy transition, Societal challenges of environmental issues, Human, animal and ecosystem health as part as a "One Health" approach. To coincide with the One Ocean Summit to be held in Brest in February 2022, a special attention will be paid to applications linked to oceans.
levelNote: Candidates must have obtained their PhD less than five years prior to the application (i.e. they must have defended their PhD between January 2019 and January 2024).

title: Scholarships - William Demant Fonden
synthese: The Foundation supports all study programmes for study or work placements abroad.
description: The Foundation supports all study programmes for study or work placements abroad. To apply to the Foundation, you must have obtained a bachelor's degree and have an average mark of at least 7 on the 12-point scale. An application must be submitted to the Foundation no later than one month before the planned start of your studies. You can only apply for support once for the same purpose. In principle, the Foundation only supports study periods longer than one year at a time. However, it is possible to apply for support for the 2nd year as well. If you are fortunate enough to receive more support than budgeted (overfunding), it is expected that the excess amount will be repaid to the Foundation. The Foundation supports participation in conferences abroad. To apply to the Foundation, you must be a student and actively participate in the conference - by giving a talk, presenting a poster or similar. The Foundation mainly supports re search projects in the field of audiology or related fields - preferably with significant relevance to Danish society and/or industry. Applications are processed on a rolling basis and distribution dates are also continuous. Scholarship portions vary in size. Applications take approximately two months to process. For research project applications, you should allow for a longer processing time.
montant: Over the past ten years, the William Demant Foundation has distributed more than a billion Danish kroner for various purposes. The emphasis has been on projects that promote research and the dissemination of knowledge in audiology. But the William Demant Foundation has also made significant contributions to the education of young people, social projects for vulnerable groups and initiatives to promote art and culture. Over the past ten years, the William Demant Foundation has, among other things, supported Danish doctoral students to the tune of more than DKK 40 million.

In the past, for example, an architect has already been sponsored for a Master's in Real Estate Development at Columbia University in New York, or an Arabist who completed a Master's in Economics in International Development in Cairo. The Studienstiftung has been running the programme since 1991 together with the Haniel Foundation, which also finances it. Voraussetzung ist ein Studienabschluss; die Fachrichtung ist nicht vorgegeben. Das Programm besteht aus einem Aufbaustudium im Ausland und einem mindestens zweimonatigen Praktikum. Beides muss von den Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern im Vorfeld selbst organisiert werden. Neben klassischen Vorhaben wie MBA- oder LL.M.-Studiengängen sind durchaus auch Personen mit ganz eigenen Vorstellungen gefragt. So wurde in der Vergangenheit zum Beispiel bereits eine Architektin für einen Master in Real Estate Development an der Columbia University in New York gefördert oder eine Arabistin, die in Kairo einen Master in Economics in International Development absolviert hat. Die Studienstiftung führt das Programm seit 1991 gemeinsam mit der Haniel Stiftung, die es auch finanziert.

title: Internationalisation fellowships - Carlsberg Foundation
synthese: These fellowships are awarded to promising PhDs for a one-to-two year uninterrupted research stay at a leading international research institution outside Denmark.
description: These fellowships are awarded to promising PhDs for a one-to-two year uninterrupted research stay at a leading international research institution outside Denmark. To be eligible for the Internationalisation Fellowships, the applicant must hold a PhD degree or must have received the assessment of the PhD thesis. The applicant must have a demonstrated strong connection to Danish research (see the FAQ for a definition thereof). Applicants with more than three years of experience at the time of application since obtaining their PhD degree are not eligible. Any periods of leave will be accepted as extensions of this time limit (maternity leave, paternity leave, family care leave, illness, military service, etc.). The exact PhD date must be specified in the CV. Applicants who are already affiliated to the research institution where the project is to be carried out cannot apply for these fellowships. Furthermore, the fellowships cannot be applied for as a continuation of other postdoctoral fellowships abroad. The applicant will be expected to take up residence in the country where the international research institution is located during the period of the fellowship.
montant: DKK 450,000 / 500,000 / 550,000 per year The internationalisation fellowships are generally tax-free in Denmark and amount to: DKK 450,000 per year if the applicant is travelling alone DKK 500,000 per year if the applicant is travelling with a partner DKK 550,000 per year if the applicant is travelling with a partner and children The amount is granted as a fixed rate, which must cover all costs, including salary. In cases when the applicant plans to move to a particularly expensive location, it is possible to apply for up to an additional DKK 60,000 per year to cover extra high rent and living expenses. The additional DKK 60,000 must be applied for at the time of submission of the application. It is not possible to apply at a later time.
duree: Call opens: 30 June 2024 Deadline: 1 October 2024, 16:00
conditions: https://stage-carlsbergfondet.euwest01.umbraco.io/en/applicant/internationalisation-fellowships/
inscription: https://stage-carlsbergfondet.euwest01.umbraco.io/en/applicant/internationalisation-fellowships/

title: Scholarships for students / doctoral candidates - Fondation KV
synthese: The KV Foundation provides financial support to students in legal and business programs and to researchers working on projects related to combating cancer, rheumatism, and other societally dangerous diseases; the application deadlines are March 15th and September 30th, respectively.
description: The KV Foundation provides financial support to students and researchers. Students can apply for funding for continuing education and study trips abroad, with a focus on legal and business programs at universities and the Copenhagen Business School. To be eligible, students must have completed a second cycle of secondary education or similar training. The application deadline is March 15th. Researchers can apply for funding for individual research projects that aim to combat cancer, rheumatism, and other societally dangerous diseases. The application deadline is September 30th. To apply for funding, students and researchers must fill out the application form on the foundation's digital application portal and meet certain requirements. The application can only be submitted once all required information has been entered on the application pages and uploaded as PDF files. After submitting the application, candidates will receive a confirmation email with an application number. The foundation processes personal data in accordance with its privacy policy. If a student or researcher's application is approved, they will receive an email or letter with information about the payment of the foundation's support. The foundation must have information about the candidate's bank account number before the payment can be made. It takes the foundation about 3 months after the application deadline to process an application. All candidates will receive a response.
conditions: STUDENT You must have completed upper secondary education or a similar course. Support is mainly granted to law and economics students. RESEARCHERS You can apply for funding as an individual or for a research project.

Enhance pedagogical exchanges between different UPEC departments, collaborating with academic and non-academic partners. Once their DUT has been completed, they can further their studies in an engineering school. In 2020, 27 scholarships were offered by JPA under this program. The scholarship covers the students' expenses (tution fess + living expenses) during the whole duration of their studies in France (6 years).

EMIMEP will also offer a few consortium scholarships to the most talented self-funded students. EMIMEP will cover the enrolment fee for the Erasmus Mundus students and some self-funded students.

title: Pre-France program for Malaysian students in Engineering
synthese: This training program in engineering for Malaysian students after SPM is sponsored by the governmental agencies JPA and Mara. The scholarship covers the tution fees and living expenses during the whole duration of studies in Malaysia and in France.
description: Engineering training program sponsored by JPA (Jabatan Perkhidmatan Awam) and Mara (Majlis Amanah Rakyat). After completion of their SPM (Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia), students follow a 13-months pre-university course in Malaysia (French and scientific classes) and spend 4 months in a French host family in order to improve their French. Then they integrate a French university in a DUT (University Technology Degree) program. Divided into groups according to their specializations, students are tutored during their first year in the DUT before they join the regular classes with French students for the 2nd year. Once they achieve their DUT, students can futher their studies in an engineering school. The scholarship covers students' expenses (tuition fees + living expenses) during the pre-university course and the studies in France.

conditions: Students who fail have to reimburse the scholarship. Students sponsored by JPA will have to accept the job offers from JPA once they graduate. If JPA hasn't proposed any job offers within 6 months of graduation, students are free to work in the company of their choice.

synthese: The Grenoble Alliance for Integrated Structural & Cell Biology (GRAL) funds Master 2 research scholarships. Laureates will attend the 2nd year of Master of Biology, Plant Biology, or Health Engineering at Université Grenoble Alpes, and do a research internship in one of the GRAL labs in Grenoble.
description: In the framework of the Chemistry Biology Health (CBH) Graduate School of Université Grenoble Alpes, the GRAL research programme funds MSc (Master 2) research scholarships. We seek motivated candidates planning to: - attend one of the following Master programmes (2nd year MSc / Master 2 / M2) at Université Grenoble Alpes (taught in English): - Master in Biology: - Structural Biology of Pathogens - Neurobiology, Neurosciences - Physiology, Epigenetics, Development, Cell Differentiation - Master in Plant Biology: PLANTA International - Master in Health Engineering: BioHealth Engineering - & do a research internship in Integrated & Structural Cell Biology at one of the labs associated with the GRAL programme in Grenoble: BGE, BioSanté, IBS, LCBM, and LPCV. funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies

conditions: 1. Do not hold a French baccalaureate (High School diploma), including a double baccalaureate (abibac, Bachibac, Esabac, etc.) 2. Grants for students in health and social care training who are on placement or for study purposes are awarded as part of the European ERASMUS+ 2021-2027 programme.

title: Chemistry Biology Health Graduate School Master Scholarships - Université Grenoble Alpes
synthese: The Chemistry Biology Health Graduate School funds scholarships for international students accepted into one of the Masters programmes in chemistry, biology, health or sport at Grenoble Alpes University. These scholarships are intended for students who are newcomers to France.
description: These scholarships are reserved for students who have already been accepted into one of the Masters programmes in chemistry, biology, health or sport at the Grenoble Alpes University. It is therefore essential as a first step to apply for one or several of CBH Graduate School's master programmes. These scholarships are intended for international students who have not studied in France before. They are research-oriented scholarships for one year of a Master's degree (either M1 or M2). Exceptionally, the one-year scholarship awarded in M1 can be renewed in M2.
montant: Amount of the scholarship : - 9 000 € for the M1 student - 5 500 € for the M2 student and approximately 3 500 € stipend paid by the laboratory for 6 months internship Support of scholarship holders (pre departure webinar, integration events, follow up throughout the year) and free French as a foreign language courses
duree: 1 year Conditionally renewable for M1 students
maitriseLangue: Minimum B2 level in English Minimum B2 level in French (if the program chosen is taught in French)
conditions: These schorlarships are intended for new comers students in France - Relevance of the academic (and professional) background - Academic level (excellence scholarship) - Language level
inscription: To qualify for our scholarships, you need to gain admission into one of the Masters in Chemistry, Biology and Health at UGA : http://grad-chembiohealth.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/en/main-menu/academics/master-s-degree-/master-s-degree--794529.kjsp?RH=19186312059171593 The procedure to follow to apply for a Master's degree is described on the university's website: https://www.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/formation/admissions-et-inscriptions/candidater-et-s-inscrire/etape-1-candidature/ We invite you to check the Campus France website of your country of residence to know the application calendar. If you are admitted into one of the CBH Graduate School's Masters degree, the head of the program will decide whether or not to nominate you for our scholarship on the basis of the application received via one of the recruitment platforms (competition with the other international students admitted).

synthese: ENAC, 1st aeronautical university & academy in Europe, grants through its foundation scholarships (from 2400 to 7000€) to the best international students applying to its Masters, advanced Masters and Ingénieur programmes.

Graduate applicants shall have applied first to one of these programmes before applying for the international scholarship programme. title: Université Côte d'Azur - Idex Scholarships for MSC Programs
synthese: Each year Université Côte d'Azur offers grants of excellence to support students who apply for MSc programs.
description: Université Côte d'Azur has brought together 17 major academic institutions around a historic university core to form one of the largest research-intensive public universities in France. It has recently developed state-accredited international MSc programs run entirely in English. These interdisciplinary degree courses prepare students for the jobs of the future. They involve the participation of leading experts from the academic and professional worlds and fully integrate innovative teaching methods. Our MSc programs fall under 5 broad areas: business, data science, education, environmental and natural science. For more information, visit https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/programs Each year Université Côte d'Azur awards 10 Idex grants to the best candidates.
montant: The recipients of these grants of excellence will be exempt from tuition fees and will receive a stipend of 5000 euros.
duree: 1 year.
maitriseLangue: The courses that are eligible for the Idex grant linked to the MSc programs are taught entirely in English. Fluency in French is not one of the selection criteria for this scholarship.
conditions: Before applying for this scholarship, students must first apply for one of the courses eligible for the MSc Programs Idex Scholarship via the "e-candidat" platform. Please check the list on https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/tuition-fees/are-you-an-international-student/academic-excellence-scholarships
inscription: Applications generally begin in mid-March. Candidates must have previously applied to one of the eligible "MSc" programs on the e-candidat platform : https://univ-cotedazur.eu/msc-programs/tuition-fees/are-you-an-international-student/academic-excellence-scholarships
pieces: Applicants must include their academic transcript from the previous year in their application.
selection: The transcripts provided must bear the official stamp of the issuing university.
levelNote: Candidates will be assessed based on the results obtained in their final year at university.

title: Excellence Grants - PSL Graduate Program in Mathematics and Applications
synthese: The Graduate Program in Mathematics and Applications of Université PSL offers scholarships to students of all nationalities admitted to the Master's in Mathematics and Applications based on their academic excellence.
description: The Graduate Program in Mathematics and Applications of Université PSL (PSL Research University) offers a comprehensive curriculum of advanced study and research, from the Master's to the Doctorate, in applied mathematics and fundamental mathematics. Through its association with PSL's laboratories in mathematics, the major PRAIRIE research program and the mathematics chairs at the Collège de France, the graduate program offers a Master's degree in which research plays a central role. Students may also choose elective courses designed to improve their transdisciplinary skills and broaden their curriculum. The PSL Graduate Program in Mathematics and Applications offers 1 or 2-year Master's scholarships for students of all nationalities . The scholarship consists of a fixed monthly allowance of 1200€ . The scholarship is based on a 10-month duration . Laureates are selected through an online application process based on academic excellence criteria . The scholarships are open to students applying for the following major/specializations in the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: - 1st year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: Advanced Mathematics Major - 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MATH specialization - 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MASH specialization - 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MASEF specialization CALL FOR APPLICATIONS: https://psl.eu/en/graduate-programs/mathematics-and-applications
montant: A fixed monthly allowance of 1200€. The tuition fees are covered by the scholarship and remain to be paid by the applicant in due time.
duree: 10-month duration each year (up to two years)
maitriseLangue: The teaching language of the Master's program in Mathematics and Applications is English.
conditions: Interruption of attendance will imply immediate termination of the scholarship payments following the university's rules & regulations. The scholarships cannot be combined with other grants, except for mutual programs with French Embassies or French Institutes abroad.
inscription: Online application. Candidates should apply for the scholarship at the same time as for admission to the Master's programs in Mathematics and Applications. Step 1 . Create your account Step 2 . Add an application Step 3 . Type “Graduate Program in Mathematics and Applications” in the search bar Step 4 . Click on the Apply button next to the program "Programme Gradué de Mathématiques et Applications - Bourses d'excellence" to start the application: -Chose which year of the Master's you wish to apply -Upload documents -Complete the contact information of your referees: The Université Paris Dauphine – PSL will send an email to your referee(s) containing a secure link for the submission of the letter. Please note that the recommendation letter(s) must be submitted before the closing date for application and you must notify your referee(s) in advance. -Submit your application
pieces: Apply for the 1st year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: Curriculum vitae (CV)* Academic transcripts and undergraduate diploma* French language proficiency certificate (DELF, DALF, etc...) Any other document attesting to the student's academic excellence such as rankings, competition results Cover letter* Letter(s) of reference* (Do not upload the letter(s). You only need to complete the contact details for your referee(s) on the application portal.) Any other document that might add to your record Apply for the 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: Curriculum vitae (CV)* Academic transcripts and undergraduate diploma* Academic transcripts and postgraduate diploma* Any other document attesting to the student's academic excellence such as rankings, competition results Cover letter* Letter(s) of reference* (Do not upload the letter(s). You only need to complete the contact details for your referee(s) on the application portal.) Any other document that might add to your record Notes: 1) Documents marked with an asterisk (*) are mandatory. 2) All the documents listed above should not exceed 10 MB max per file in PDF format and contain special characters.
domainNote: The grant is conditional to the student's effective enrollment in one of the major/specializations of the PSL Master's in Mathematics and Application listed below: 1st year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: Advanced Mathematics Major 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MATH specialization 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MASH specialization 2nd year of the Master's in Mathematics and Applications: MASEF specialization For more information on the Master's program in Mathematics and Applications: https://psl.eu/en/education/master-s-degree-mathematics-and-applications.
levelNote: The scholarships are open to students having successfully achieved an undergraduate program in mathematics (if applying for the 1st year of the master's) or a 1st-year master's program in mathematics (if applying for the 2nd year of the master's) or equivalent.

montant: Scholarship covers up to 40% of the tuition fees for the Bachelor in Management or BBA Big Data & Management program.

title: Executive Leaders Scholarship
synthese: Project-based scholarship demonstrating a commitment to one of the four concentrations in the programme
description: Audencia Business School is proud to announce a scholarship in support of students applying to the Full-Time MBA programme: The Executive Leaders Fellowship. The Executive Leaders Fellowship is an opportunity for applicants to demonstrate their commitment to a wide range of themes covered on the MBA programme: Entrepreneurship & Transformation, Innovation & New Product Development, Strategic CSR, Corporate Finance. Awardees will receive a tuition fee waiver of 10% to 30% of the total tuition fee. Why this scholarship? We support the entrepreneurial pursuits of our graduates. The Full-Time MBA programme is enriched by robust entrepreneurial research and development initiatives. We're offering this scholarship to learn more about what this means to you. Exercise your creativity and problem-solving skills to propose an innovative initiative or business plan that integrates at least one of the four themes: - Entrepreneurship & Transformation - Innovation & New Product Development - Strategic Corporate Social Responsibility - Corporate Finance
montant: Up to 30% of tuition fees.
duree: 12 months, i.e. the entire duration of the Full-Time MBA.
age: Minimum of 3 years of relevant post-graduation, full-time work experience
maitriseLangue: English test score (TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC). English test scores are not required for native speakers, applicants who have completed their undergraduate degrees in English.
conditions: Project-based scholarship demonstrating a commitment to one of the four concentrations in the programme See the guidelines to apply for this scholarship here: https://fr.calameo.com/read/000137206947c201929e3
inscription: Applications for the Full-Time MBA program are made online on the dedicated web page: https://apply.audencia.com/ The project for the scholarship can be downloaded with the registration file or sent to international@audencia.com
pieces: CV and cover letter in English Copies of diplomas and academic transcripts English test score (TOEFL, IELTS, TOEIC)* Copy of identity document (e.g., passport) Photo (jpeg, 346 x 366 pixels) Copy of your GMAT or GRE score – these can be provided at a later date. You can take the test any time before 1 September (before your programme start). There is a test centre in Nantes. To have your score sent to Audencia, use our institutional GMAT code (0674) or GRE code (5489). Project for the Executive Leadership Award (see the instructions here: https://fr.calameo.com/read/000137206947c201929e3)
selection: The files of candidates admitted to the program and wishing to apply for the scholarship will be selected by a jury as the projects are received.
levelNote: This MBA is accredited by the Association of MBAs; its participants therefore systematically have prior professional experience of at least 3 years (8 years on average). A university degree (in any field) is also required.

title: Excellence Grants - PSL Graduate Program in Life Sciences
synthese: The PSL Graduate Program Life Sciences offers two merit-based scholarships to students admitted to the 1st or 2nd year of the Master's in Life Sciences - Integrative physiopathology track for the 2024/25 academic year.
description: The Graduate Program in Life Sciences of Université PSL offers a comprehensive curriculum of advanced study and research, from the Master's to the Doctorate, in the life sciences. Through its association with PSL research laboratories, five Laboratories of Excellence (LabEx) and PSL's Q-LIFE Institute, the graduate program offers Master's degrees in which research plays a central role. Students may also choose elective courses designed to improve their transdisciplinary skills and broaden their curriculum. The PSL Graduate Program in Life Sciences offers two merit-based scholarships to students admitted to the 1st or 2nd year of the Master's in Life Sciences - Integrative physiopathology track for the 2024/25 academic year . The grant consists of 1 000 euros per month over 10 months . Selected candidates should conduct a 6-month research internship in one of the laboratories affiliated with the PG Life Sciences: https://psl.eu/en/graduate-programs/graduate-program-life-sciences (see 'Research' tab). CALL FOR APPLICATIONS: https://www.ephe.psl.eu/appel-candidatures-bourse-dexcellence-du-programme-gradue-psl-sciences-du-vivant
montant: 1000 euros per month
duree: 10 months (from October 2024 to July 2025)
maitriseLangue: The course of the Integrative physiopathology track in the Master's in Life Sciences are taught in French.
conditions: Applicants must have scientific interests that correspond to those of the PSl Graduate Program in Life Sciences: https://psl.eu/en/graduate-programs/graduate-program-life-sciences. By accepting the scholarship, the winners must :1) conduct a 6-month research internship in one of the laboratories affiliated with the PG Life Sciences as listed in the following link: https://psl.eu/en/graduate-programs/graduate-program-life-sciences (see 'Research' tab).2) not request an individualized development plan, except due to pathology impacting schooling.3) complete their school year.
inscription: The application file must be sent by email, in PDF format and in a single file, to the following addresses: isabelle.lagroye@ephe.psl.eu et sophie.thenet@ephe.psl.eu
pieces: A letter of application detailing how the applicant's scientific interests match those of the Graduate Program in Life Sciences and why the candidate would particularly need the scholarship to carry out his/her graduate studies. A detailed CV and transcripts from the previous year (transcripts of the last year of bachelor's if applying for the 1st year of the Master's in Life Sciences/ transcripts of the 1st year of the master's if applying to the 2nd year). An academic letter of recommendation. A letter of recommendation from a scientific tutor (internship supervisor) is mandatory if applying for the 2nd year of the Master's (optional for application for the 1st year of the Master's). Other scholarships or financial aid received by the candidate must be mentioned. Incomplete files will not be considered by the commission.
selection: The jury's decision will be announced in June 2024.
domainNote: The scholarships are open to students applying for the 1st or 2nd year of the Master's in Life Sciences - Integrative physiopathology track. More information on admissions to the Master's in Life Sciences: https://psl.eu/en/education/master-s-degree-life-sciences.
web1: PSL Graduate Program in Life Sciences

title: Master program scholarship - ITI HiFunMat
synthese: Scholarship of the Interdisciplinary Thematic Institute for hierarchiral and functional materials (ITI HiFunMat).
description: The ITI HiFunMat is a Graduate School (Master's and PhD continuum) which offers high level transversal and interdisciplinary training. In order to recruit high-potential students, regardless of their geographical origin or financial situation, ITI HiFunMat offers scholarships to support the students' living expenses in Strasbourg or Mulhous. Each year ITI HiFunMat offers 10 scholarships to M1 students, and 13 scholarships to M2 students. Students are selected on the basis of their academic performance, their motivation and the quality of their professional project. ITI HiFunMat offers a supplement to a Master's degree. The associated M1s are : Materials Science and Engineering - at Unistra and UHA Physical Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry and Materials Science - at Unistra Molecular, Green and Supramolecular Chemistrty - at Unistra and UHA Physics - at Unistra The associated M2s are : Materials and Nanosciences (IMN) - at Unistra Design of Materials and Innovative Surfaces (DSMI) - at Unistra Polymer Engineering (IP) - at Unistra Materials Formulation and Surface Functionalization (FMFS) - at Unistra Materials Science and Engineering - at UHA Physical Chemistry and Materials Science - at Unistra Molecular and Supramolecular Chemistry - at Unistra Molecular and Macromolecular Chemistry - at UHA Condensed Matter and Nanophysics - at Unistra Cell Physics - at Unistra The associated engineering schools are ECPM and ENSCMu
montant: The ITI HiFunMat scholarship is €600 per month. It represents a contribution to the students' living expenses (monthly living costs). Participation in HiFunMat summer schools is compulsory and free of charge.
duree: The scholarship is awarded for the period from September to June (10 months) during the first year of the Master program (M1), and from September to March (6 months) during the second year of the Master program (M2). During the M2 internship, students will receive an internship remuneration (6 months maximum).
maitriseLangue: English: all courses of ITI HiFunMat are taught in English. French: the majority of the associated Masters programs are in English, but some are in French (M1 Material science and engineering, M2 Material science and engineering, IMN, DSMI, IP, FMFS).
conditions: Applicants must register for one of the associated Master's programs, via the Unistra or UHA e-candidat web sites and on Campus France. The associated Master programs are (https://hifunmat.unistra.fr/graduate-school/what-is-the-iti-hifunmat-graduate-school/for-whom): Master of Chemistry (Faculty of Chemistry - Unistra, Faculty of Science & Technology - UHA, ECPM, ENSCMu) Master of Materials Science and Engineering (Faculty of Physics and Engineering - Unistra, Faculty of Science & Technology - UHA) Master of Physics (Faculty of Physics and Engineering - Unistra) Applicants should send their application to: iti-hifunmat@unistra.fr . 80% of the scholarship will be paid at the beginning of the academic year, and 20% at the end of the academic year. ITI HiFunMat reserves the right to ask for full (or partial) reimbursement of the scholarship if the ITI HiFunMat program is not completed by the student. The scholarship can be cumulated with the social criteria scholarships, but it cannot be cumulated with the following : Unistra international mobility scholarship (DRI) Erasmus+ MIC / Mundus / KA 103 except Erasmus+ Internship KA103 UFA Other financial support from IdEx funding for the same academic year.
inscription: Step 1. Visit our website to find out more about our application process : https://hifunmat.unistra.fr/graduate-school/apply/msc-students Step 2. Fill in our online application form : https://sondagesv3.unistra.fr/index.php/745385?lang=fr For more information please contact us: iti-hifunmat@unistra.fr
pieces: The application file should contain : Copy of passport/ID card A CV describing your academic and professional background and achievements Transcripts of grades A motivation letter (1 page) in pdf format. The letter should describe your scientific interests, your qualifications as an ITI HiFunMat student, a clear vision of your Master's program and your career plans The scholarship application letter If already available, your Bachelor degree A letter of recommendation (recommended)
selection: Application files will be reviewed by the ITI HiFunMat Graduate School Committee and the heads of the Master programs. An interview is then scheduled for eligible candidates. The admission criteria are: Quality of academic results Motivation Quality of professional career plans
domainNote: We are looking for students that, next to their domain of expertise (physics, chemitry, materials science), are interested in working at the interface of different research domains to push forward the development of the next generation of materials.
levelNote: Applicants must have a Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Physics or Materials Science.

title: “FRANCE EXCELLENCE EUROPA” SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM
synthese: The "France Excellence Europa" scholarship program is aimed at students from European Union member countries and allows them to finance a 12 to 24 month Master's degree program.
description: Developed by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and launched during the French Presidency of the European Union (January 1–June 30, 2022), the "France Excellence Europa" scholarship program allows students from 26 European Union countries to obtain scholarships to study at the Master's level in a French institution of higher education.
montant: Payment of a half-yearly allowance of €6,850 Payment of an installation allowance of €1,700 Exemption from registration fees for national diplomas in universities and public institutions under the supervision of the Ministry of Higher Education Priority assistance in finding accommodations in CROUS university residences (rent to be paid by the scholarship holder) Enrollment in an insurance plan during the first three months of your stay in France (pending enrollment in the general social security system) for non-European Health Insurance Card holders Enrollment in supplemental health insurance Exemption from the CVEC - Contribution de Vie Etudiante et de Campus Special discounts on cultural activities organized by Campus France.
duree: The scholarship is awarded for a period of: a maximum of 12 months when enrolling in M2 a maximum of 24 months when enrolling in
age: Being between 18 and 26 years old at the time of the beginning of your stay in France ;
conditions: Being admitted to a French higher education institution in Master's 1 or Master's 2 for the 2022-23 academic year ; Not being the holder of a French Higher education degree or not being currently registered in France for a Higher education degree ; Not be the recipient of an Erasmus +, AUF or other French ministry scholarship.
inscription: Candidates must send their applications electronically to the French Embassy in their country of nationality. The list of e-mail addresses by country is available below: https://www.campusfrance.org/en/france-excellence-europa-scholarship-program.
pieces: "France Excellence Europa Scholarship" application form, duly completed and signed CV (in French or English) Cover letter (in French or English) Copy of the most recent higher education diploma obtained or copy of the secondary school diploma if the applicant is in the process of higher education. The higher education diploma must be sent as soon as it is obtained. Copies of transcripts from the last two years of higher education Copy of an identity document (passport, ID card) Letter of admission to a Master's 1 or Master's 2 program at a French institute of higher education for the year 2023-24* *If the applicant is not yet in possession of a letter of admission for the 2023-24 academic year at the time of application, he/she is invited to attach a sworn statement, mentioning the name of the institution and the title of the anticipated program for 2023-24, and a copy of the communications with the institution attesting to the fact that the application for admission is being processed. The letter of admission must be sent as soon as possible, as soon as it is received by the candidate. Optional: Copies of diplomas or certifications of level of French (DELF, DALF, TCF, TEF) Copies of diplomas or certifications of level of English (TOEFL, TOEIC, IELTS) Letters of recommendation (in French or English)
selection: The "France Excellence Europa” scholarship is awarded on the basis of academic excellence and is in line with the strategic priorities of the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. Applications are pre-selected by the college relations teams at the French embassies. The applications are then evaluated within the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs by collaboration specialists from the eligible fields.
countryNote: Being a national of one of the following 26 European Union member states: Germany, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Croatia, Denmark, Spain, Estonia, Finland, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Czech Republic, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden. Students of French nationality, including bi-nationals, are not eligible for the program.
domainNote: Eligible areas of study : Culture & Heritage Education, Pedagogy French Language and Civilization, Foreign Languages and Civilizations and European Studies Law and political sciences Health Environmental Sciences Computer Science and Digital

title: Scholarship: CHORAL doctoral program in Cultural Heritage
synthese: In the framework of the UNITA alliance, 14 excellent doctoral candidates will enroll in the CHORAL program on cultural heritage.
description: Coordinated by the University of Pau and Pays de l'Adour, CHORAL (Cultural Heritage Outreach in RomAnce Languages) is a Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska Curie program co-funded by the European Union. It is linked to the Cultural Heritage Hub, an international research network within the Unita alliance, which structures its research ecosystem to address culture-related challenges. The winning candidates will complete a thesis under joint supervision which will require international mobility. CHORAL students will benefit from specific events and a doctoral training program.
montant: Fully funded thesis, starting fall 2024.
duree: 3 years
age: Any candidate in possession of the required diploma can apply regardless of the year of graduation.
maitriseLangue: Applicants whose first language is not English must provide evidence of proficiency in these required language skills, at least the Cambridge First Certificate or equivalent.
conditions: Mobility rule: Marie Curie Actions rule: Researchers must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting entity for more than 12 months during the 36 months preceding the date limit of the call. Compulsory national service, short stays such as vacations and time spent in a procedure for obtaining refugee status within the meaning of the Geneva Convention are not taken into account.
inscription: Applicants must register on the CHORAL application platform and submit a complete application file.
pieces: The application file must consist of: Detailed CV of the candidate Self-assessment of ethics and security issues Cover letter for participation in CHORAL and research topic Qualifications Career Development Goals Collaboration requested beyond the higher education sector for short stays Two reference letters, each with information regarding the candidate's previous research activities, research ability and work experience. Copies of university diploma certificates and transcripts obtained during Master's studies Copies of English language certificates Copy of a valid passport Sworn statement attesting that all the information declared is true.
selection: The selection process follows the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers. The CHORAL selection process consists of three parts: - Evaluation of eligibility criteria - Evaluation by experts: an examination committee composed of three external experts will evaluate the file - Candidate interviews: selected candidates will be interviewed by a selection committee.
domainNote: The candidate must hold a Master's degree to do a doctorate in Social Sciences, Arts, Architecture and Human Sciences applied to cultural heritage.
levelNote: The candidate must be a doctoral student, so not already in possession of a doctorate at the deadline of the call.

title: Excellence scholarship of the Graduate School in Mathematics & Computer Science
synthese: The Graduate School in Mathematics & Computer Science of the Sorbonne Paris Nord University (PNGS-M&CS) awards grants for Master studies in mathematics and computer science.
description: The PNGS-M&CS Graduate School is designed as an international, high-level curriculum in master and Phd. It builts upon three masters: Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering and Innovation in Images and Networks. Students enrolled in this graduate school will have the opportunity to attend classes from different masters, supplemented by specific classes. Three research laboratories of the Sorbonne Paris Nord University actively participate in this graduate school: LAGA, the laboratory of mathematics, LIPN, the laboratory of computer science, L2TI, the laboratory for visual information and network analysis and processing. These laboratories form the MathSTIC Research Federation that supports and encourages their interdisciplinary research, and gathers more than 170 professors and full-time researchers. The interactions and complementarity of mathematics and computer science are highlighted in the graduate school to promote interdisciplinary teaching and research. Students of the PNGS-M&CS school will be in close contact with current research through internships within the partner laboratories, and participation in seminars and conferences organized locally, doing short internships in the laboratories, and working on open problems. After their second year of master studies, students continuing with PhD studies within the PNGS-M&CS will join the Galileo Doctoral School.
funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies
montant: The student awarded a scholarship will receive a monthly grant up to 1000€ at maximum: 600€/month + a housing complement of 400€/month upon justification (rental lease). Students from abroad will have preferred access to student housing facilities (CROUS), and will be reimbursed a return trip from their home country to Paris (economic fares only).
duree: Students entering the program in the first master year (M1) are awarded the grant for 12 months, with a prolongation of 10 months for their second master year studies (M2) if they passed the first year. Students entering the program in the second master year (M2) are awarded the grant for 10 months. Students pursuing a thesis in a laboratory of the PNGS-M&CS perimeter will be funded by a 3-year doctoral contract and will join the Galileo Doctoral School. We ask students joining the PNGS-M&CS graduate school to arrive in Paris around September 1st.
age: Theses grants are open to both French and international students of any citizenship. The selection is based solely on criteria of academic excellence and motivation.
maitriseLangue: Lectures and/or documents are provided in English, and students must have a sufficient proficiency in English to follow. Non French speaking students are strongly advised to attend French courses.
conditions: The PNGS-M&CS graduate school will help the students in the administrative procedures related to moving to France and studying (applying for a visa, finding housing, insurance, banking, (pre-)registering into the master, etc). The PNGS-M&CS graduate school will also offer pedagogical and scientific support: each student will have a tutor from one of the participating laboratories, will have regular contacts with the head of the master and the graduate school, will participate in specific meeting for sharing information, and will be advised in his/her search for internships or advisers. Specific activities (welcome day, cultural activities, seminars) targeted at PNGS-M&CS students of all level of studies aim at easing the development of a social network.
inscription: Candidates to an PNGS-M&CS Master grant apply online on the PNGS-M&CS website. In parallel, they apply to one of the three masters of the PNGS-M&CS perimeter at the Galileo Institute of the Sorbonne Paris Nord University (also known as University Paris 13), either via the “Études en France” program for countries participating in it, or the E-candidat platform of the University Sorbonne Paris Nord.
pieces: - Curriculum Vitae - Transcripts of grades from the first university year on - E-mail address of two referee accepting to write a recommendation letter for the applicant - A letter of motivation, explaining also the project of studies and goals - Copy of an ID card or passport - Information on the proficiency in French and English (though generally taught in English, some chosen courses may be taught in French, with notes and textbooks provided in English). Once an account has been created, it is possible to complete the application in several steps. The candidate is responsible for ensuring that the application is completed by the closure date of the call. Application which remain incomplete beyond this date will not be considered.
selection: All applications will be reviewed. The selection is made on decision of the Scientific Committee of the PNGS-M&CS, upon criteria of academic excellence and motivation, taking into account the coherence of the curriculum and the project of studies. The PNGS-M&CS school has a policy of equal opportunity in the evaluation process of all applications. Female candidate are particularly encouraged to apply.
countryNote: The students from countries participating in the “Études en France” program are invited to also deposit a Campus France application.
levelNote: Candidates for M1+M2 grants: students applying for an admission into the program to enter the first year of master studies (M1) must have obtained a Bachelor degree or an equivalent qualification by August 31st of the current year of studies. Candidates for M2 grants: students applying for an admission into the program to enter the second year of master studies (M2) must have successfully completed a first year of master studies by August 31st of the current year of studies.

title: MathInParis2020 Cofund doctoral programme
synthese: The international Doctoral Training in Mathematical Sciences in Paris - MathInParis2020 - Cofunded by Marie Sklodowska-Curie Actions offers 40 PhD fellowships in mathematics and theoretical computer science.
description: The international Doctoral Training in Mathematical Sciences in Paris - MathInParis2020 - Cofunded by Marie Sklodowska-Curie Actions offers 40 PhD fellowships within the framework of the European Horizon 2020 program "Marie Sklodowska-Curie Co-funding of Regional, National and International Programmes". This project has received funding from the European Uninion's Seventh Framework Programme for research, technological development and demonstration under grant agreement n°945332 The main features of the program is to enhance the potential and future career perspective of young researchers by offering : 1- an extremely attractive place in FSMP network for international brilliant students planning to prepare a PhD in mathematics 2- a strengthened advising 3- a broadened support for career development.
duree: 36 months
age: Applicants may not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in France for more than 12 months in the three years immediately before the deadline of the co-funded program's call, i.e. from the 13/02/2019 to the 13/02/2022.Candidates must have a master's degree or an equivalent diploma at the time of their enrolment and must be in the first four years of their research careers. Moreover, they must not have been awarded a doctoral degree.

title: PhD program MathPhdInFrance
synthese: We offer up to 2 x 24 PhD fellowships in Mathematical Sciences in France, starting in fall 2024 and 2025. The first deadline for application is February 14th, 2024.
description: The main originality of the programme is the requirement that each PhD thesis is done in co-supervision between a university in the Paris region (Île-de-France) and one in a French region outside Île-de-France . Co-supervision between different regions is not new in the French mathematical landscape and has proven to be a great chance for doctoral candidates to benefit from two viewpoints and two environments. The novelty of MathPhDInFrance is to be fully dedicated to this form of supervision, on a large scale offering up to 2 x 24 fellowships in total, spread over 2 calls in 2023-24 & 2024-25. Here are the main features of the programme : Co-supervision : each fellow will have two PhD supervisors, one in the Paris region and the other elsewhere in France. 3-I secondments mobility : fellows are expected to spend 2 months of mobility (during the 3 years of the PhD).
funder: European Union, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies
montant: Full living allowance: fellows will receive a full living allowance slightly superior to the French normalized PhD salary (about 2300 euros gross, which is about 1850 euros per months net, including national health care) Travel expenses: travel to the co-supervision site will be reimbursed up to 350 euros per month.
duree: 36 months
age: Early-stage researchers : candidates must have a master's degree or an equivalent diploma at the time of their enrolment (beginning of the PhD) and must be in the first four years of their research careers. Moreover, they must not have been awarded a doctoral degree.
pieces: Step 1 (deadline February 14th, 2024): Motivation letter. Recommendation letters (maximum 3 letters). Curriculum vitae with complete track record. Master full grade certificate (all grades available at the date of submission) and/or diploma. A scientific document where applicants describe their research interests, and their ideas for PhD projects if they already have some (maximum 2 pages).
countryNote: Mobility rule : Applicants may not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in France for more than 12 months in the three years immediately before the deadline of the program's call (between February 14th, 2021, and February 14th, 2024).

description: Université Paris Cité is training future scientists and leading experts to thrive as academics or senior executives. synthese: The University of La Réunion (UR) is offering 9 excellence scholarships for students with a M1 or M2 degree from universities in the Indian Ocean who wish to follow one of the 25 Master 2 courses open to the programme and, if possible, pursue a doctoral thesis.
description: For the year 2024-2025, the University of La Réunion (UR) is offering 9 scholarships to study for a Master 2 and obtain the Master degree. These scholarships are intended for students from countries in the Indian Ocean region (South Africa, Australia, Comoros, Eswatini, Ethiopia, India, Kenya, Lesotho, Madagascar, Maldives, Mauritius, Mozambique, Pakistan, Seychelles, Sri Lanka, Tanzania), who have obtained a Master 1 or 2 degree from a university in one of the programme's partner countries, and who would like to study for their Master 2 degree at the University of Reunion and, if possible, to pursue a doctoral thesis there. The programme is proposed and managed by the UR's International Relations Department (DRI). 25 Masters degrees in 5 fields (Science and Technology; Human and Environmental Sciences; Law, Economics and Management; Humanities; Health) are accessible with this scholarship. Applicants from countries applying the CEF procedure (South Africa, Comoros, India, Kenya, Madagascar, Mauritius), must apply on the "Etudes en France" platform, respecting its procedure and calendar. Applicants from other countries must apply on the University of La Réunion website between 1st April and 3rd May ("e-candidat" procedure).

That is a total of 7.100€ per student, for one academic year With this grant the student will have to pay for - Airfare - Registration at the University - Accommodation - Other daily expenses (telephone subscription, clothes, food, books, outings, etc.) The French Embassies in some of the programme countries co-finance these scholarships by paying for airfare, social security coverage, and by granting BGF status.
