title: Robert de Sorbon Grant
synthese: This scholarship is intended for PhDs in medieval history who have defended their thesis abroad for a maximum of three years.
description: This grant will enable the winner to spend a month, from 1 to 31 March, at the Laboratoire de Médiévistique Occidentale de Paris. In addition, the laureate will obtain the status of associate member of the Laboratory for three years.
montant: The laboratory will pay for his or her travel to and from the campus, his or her accommodation on the Condorcet Campus and will pay a sum of 1000 euros to cover the running costs of the stay.
duree: One month, in March (but if the covid pandemic continues, reception can go up to and including May)
age: No age limit as long as the thesis has been defended for less than 3 years.
maitriseLangue: The candidate must be fluent in French: at the time of his/her reception by the team, he/she will present a one-hour communication followed by an exchange, all in French.
conditions: Candidates should provide specific references to archives and manuscripts that can be consulted in Paris repositories and libraries and are not accessible online.
inscription: Applications are open from 5 September to 15 October inclusive. Applications can be made online.
pieces: - Declaration of candidacy in PDF format - Curriculum vitae - Motivation letter in French, in which the candidate will present the axes of his/her research, the way in which these can be articulated with the fields and programmes of the Laboratory and the objectives of his/her stay. The desire to consult archives and/or manuscripts kept in Parisian repositories with precise references will be taken into account. - Report of the defence and/or a summary of the thesis - Two publications judged to be representative and published or to be published. The application procedure is dematerialised.
selection: The composition of the jury is reviewed each year by the Laboratory Council of the LaMOP. The jury is composed of 8 members: - a president, chosen from the LaMOP management group - a secretary, chosen from the LaMOP Laboratory Council - two members of the LaMOP, tenured or emeritus - two external researchers or teacher-researchers - a member of the heritage conservation community (French National Archives, French National Library, etc.). Each member studies all the applications submitted and proposes a ranking according to the criteria defined above. A meeting is held to select the winner. The results are sent to the candidates around 15 November.
domainNote: Candidates must have defended their medieval history thesis within a maximum of three years. Theses may include - in part - elements of art history or archaeology. The work of the candidates must be related to the axes of the Lamop.
levelNote: postdoc level

title: The KEDGE Business School scholarship
synthese: The KEDGE Business School scholarship is a social scholarship. It is open to all students enrolled at KEDGE Business School, in initial training, on a full-time basis.
description: The KEDGE Business School scholarship is a social scholarship The KEDGE scholarship: This is a financial aid awarded to the students in greatest difficulty. The grant is not automatic: after the student's application, the files are analysed and classified on the basis of household income, thus allowing the selection of students in the most precarious situations. This grant is also awarded to students who, during the current academic year, have had to deal with an unexpected event (loss of a parent's job, death, serious illness, etc.) that has caused a disruption in their daily lives and in the financing of their studies. The KEDGE social grant concerns all training programmes (except Executive Education). Students who have to pay (or who have already paid) the totality of their tuition fees in the year of application are eligible. The grant is paid out after all applications have been examined by the KEDGE Scholarship Commission, during the month of November.
montant: The amount of the social grant varies from 2500 to 3000€ depending on the situation.
duree: Grants are awarded annually: the social grant is paid after all applications have been examined by the KEDGE Scholarship Commission, in November. Payment is spread over the school year (a second payment is made in February and the last in April).
inscription: The KEDGE BS scholarship campaign begins as soon as the student registers at KEDGE Business School. The latter receives a call for applications by e-mail when he/she receives his/her student contract. They are then directed to a platform to complete an online questionnaire and submit supporting documents.
pieces: The documents to be provided are as follows: proof of income for year N-1 copy of family record book RIB any document justifying a change of situation

title: 6G Excellence Scholarships 2023
synthese: EURECOM and the OpenAirInterface Software Alliance, have combined their forces to jointly establish a new 6G Excellence scholarship program open to highly motivated students who wish to pursue a Master of Science in Intelligent Communication systems
description: EURECOM is a top-ranked research lab and graduate school within ICT area, located in Europe's premier high-tech park Sophia-Antipolis, in one of the world's attractions, the French Riviera. EURECOM is a joint-venture by some of Europe's leading Technical Universities and industry labs. Its Communication Systems department is known for its contributions to theory & practice, with a large number of EU projects participation, including several ERC and ITN Marie Curie projects. This department is also the creator and leader behind world's pioneering open-source 5G radio experimental platform OpenAirInterface Software Alliance (OAI). EURECOM proposes a Master of Science in Intelligent Communication Systems for talented students. The Master is fully taught in English. For our next 2023 fall intake (September 2023), EURECOM and the OpenAirInterface Software Alliance, have combined their forces to jointly establish a new 6G Excellence scholarship program open to highly motivated students who wish to pursue a Master of Science in Intelligent Communication systems and who can demonstrate their interest in the future intelligent networks (6G) and their potential in some of the following fields: Wireless Communications, Mobile Computing, Networking, Mobile Applications and Services, communication theory, Signal Processing and learning for networks. Candidate selection is based on excellence and motivation. Info here: https://www.eurecom.fr/en/teaching/master-science/6G-wireless-Excellence-Scholarships
montant: Up to two 6G Excellence scholarships with a monetary value of 5.000 euros. Paid upon arrival
duree: Scholarships are to be used for intake in academic year 2023/24 only. Not renewable for 2nd year of master
age: Candidate selection is based on excellence and motivation. Info here: https://www.eurecom.fr/en/teaching/master-science/6G-wireless-Excellence-Scholarships
maitriseLangue: B2 in english Some level in French is an asset (A2 at least)
conditions: Criteria: 1- holding a Bachelor's degree in a related field (Computer science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Engineering, etc) from a recognized top university : - must appear in one of the international ranking list: THE, QS, ARWU - or in Top 50 Chinese Universities according to ARWU , Top 50 Indian engineering colleges or universities (NIRF India) - Depending on the case, top universities of the country appearing in THE, QS, ARWU, CS Ranking, Scimago by subject : Computer Science and ICT; or Location: Asia or Latin America ranking or in QS BRICS, Asia, Latin America, Arab Region or EECA (Emerging Europe and Central Asia) ranking 2- Minimum Overall GPA score of 3.5/4 (Or CGPA of 7/10) or belonging to the top 10% of your graduating class (an official document issued by your university that proves you are among the top 10% of your graduating class, such as a statement signed and stamped by your University, a reference letter, a class ranking certificate, etc.) 3- Demonstrate a proven interest in future intelligent networks (6G) and some of the fields of specialization: Wireless Communications, Mobile Computing, Networking, Mobile Applications and Services, communication theory, Signal Processing and learning for networks (a short letter of explanation will be required). 4- Knowledge and willingness to work within the OpenAirInterface Alliance are very strong assets.
inscription: The application is done via the same online form as your application to a Master's program (https://admission.eurecom.fr/en/) It is however necessary to specify in your motivation letter that you also want to be considered for one of the 6G Excellence scholarships. title: "Vocation grants" from the Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet Foundation
synthese: The Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet Foundation awards 1-year grants of €10,000 to young Europeans living in France who meet difficulties in the pursuit of their vocation or calling.
description: The Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet Foundation is a private organization operating in the public interest. Its mission is to encourage vocations of all kinds and to assist young people who, for lack of support, are blocked in their efforts to succeed in their chosen field. “Vocation grants” are intended for young French men and women between the ages of 18 and 30, as well as foreign national of similar age and living in France, who have met difficulties in the pursuit of their vocation. The applicant's academic level is not important. The objective of the grants is to encourage and assist young people in their professional, scholarly, or artistic efforts. The Foundation remains in contact with its grantees in order to provide continuing guidance and other support that will encourage the full flowering of each grantee's vocation.
montant: €10,000 for 1 year
duree: 1 year
conditions: Candidates must be able to demonstrate that they have a vocation and that their vocation would bear fruit if specific difficulties blocking their progress could be overcome. The Foundation supports only professional and artistic proposals oriented toward the candidate's future work as an individual. Applicants seeking to create a business or to pursue political or religious goals are not eligible.
inscription: Curriculum vitae; Letter of interest explaining: The applicant's vocational history to date, with attention to problems encountered and resolved The applicant's personal plan Where the applicant stands in the realization of that plan Why the applicant needs the Foundation's assistance (in other words, challenges still to be met) What the realization of this project will bring you These two documents must be submitted to the Foundation in paper form. If they meet the Foundation's criteria, the candidate will be sent an application form. Once the completed form is returned, the applicant's candidacy will be in effect.
pieces: Curriculum vitae, a letter of interest, achievements when it comes to artistic vocations
selection: Applications are open from January 1 to January 31 of each year. You must register directly on the website www.fondationdelavocation.org by submitting a CV and a letter of interest. If the application is validated, the candidate will receive a file to complete.
countryNote: Grantees must be french citizens living or not in France or foreign national living in France.
domainNote: The grants relate to all areas except political and religious and do not relate to business creation.
levelNote: Ability to present your project and your motivations in French.

title: Sciences Po "Crous Complement" scholarship
synthese: Any students whose circumstances meet the social criteria defined by France's student finance administrator, the Crous, and have successfully completed their administrative and course registration at Sciences Po, are eligible to receive the Sciences Po "Crous Complement".
montant: A complete tuition fee exemption A living costs grant equivalent to 75% of the sum defined by the Crous. The sum is paid in 10 monthly instalments between September and June. Priority consideration for accommodation in student residences or with Sciences Po's other housing partners. We take into account three factors when determining whether students are eligible for the bursary and how much they are eligible for: Household income Number of children financially dependent on the household Distance of student's residence from their place of study
conditions: To be eligible for the bursary, students must meet each of the following criteria: They must be under 28 years of age on the 1 September of the academic year in which are they are submitting their first bursary application. They must be an EU national (or come from a country within the European Economic Area) . They must be enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree (excluding the one year Master's programmes) at Sciences Po.
inscription: Applicants must apply from January to May on the Crous website.

title: Sciences Po Europe scholarship
synthese: Any students whose circumstances meet the social criteria defined by France's student finance administrator, the Crous, and have successfully completed their administrative and course registration at Sciences Po, are eligible to receive the Sciences Po Europe Bursary during their first year of study.
montant: A complete tuition fee exemption A living costs grant equivalent to 175% of the sum defined by the Crous. That means a grant ranging between €1,824 and €10,038 in 2021/2022, depending on where you fall on the Crous' eligibility scale. The sum is paid in 10 monthly instalments between September and June. Priority consideration for accommodation in student residences or with Sciences Po's other housing partners. We take into account three factors when determining whether students are eligible for the bursary and how much they are eligible for: Household income Number of children financially dependent on the household Distance of student's residence from their place of study
duree: Students can receive the Sciences Po Europe Bursary during their first year of study in France. As of the second year, students apply directly to the Crous bursary. Should they become recipient of the Crous bursary, Sciences Po will top up with a grant worth 75% of their bursary, and they will benefit from complete tuition fee exemption.
conditions: To be eligible for the bursary, students must meet each of the following criteria: They must be under 28 years of age on the 1 September of the academic year in which are they are submitting their first bursary application. They must be an EU national (or come from a country within the European Economic Area) . They must be enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree (excluding the one year Master's programmes) at Sciences Po.
inscription: The Europe Bursary is allocated to all new students who meet the eligibility criteria and have successfully completed their Sciences Po administrative and course registration. As soon as you have received and accepted your offer of admission, you will be able to fill out a Sciences Po Europe Bursary application form via the application platform.

title: Healthtech Master fellowship - Mobil'ITI program
synthese: The Interdisciplinary Thematic Institute HealthTech offers an international Master-level graduate program, fully taught in English, with high-level interdisciplinary teaching units. Selected students will be awarded a full fellowship, covering most living costs for the academic year and travel expenses.
description: The Interdisciplinary Thematic Institute HealthTech offers an international Master-level graduate program, fully taught in English, in the field of information sciences and technology for healthcare. This high-level training program is interdisciplinary, covering topics ranging from medical imaging, robotics and artificial intelligence to economics, data science and medicine. The training program also includes a significant amount of time in research institutes. Outstanding students selected in the program will be awarded a significant fellowship, covering most living costs for the academic year, travel expenses and tuition fees. They will also benefit from a highly dynamic research environment known internationally for its excellence in the field of innovation in biomedical engineering. HealthTech allows for great opportunities for local and international students wishing to pursue in the field of assistance to medicine and surgery. HealthTech's Master training program at a glance: International graduate program fully taught in English High-level interdisciplinary training Fellowships for selected HealthTech fellows Early experience in a research laboratory Welcoming and networking events for international students A site of excellence in the center of Europe Career opportunities: Opportunities for PhD studies with public or private partners Emergence of innovative projects providing jobs with high added value for graduates Industrial contacts and support for the creation of start-up companies More information on our website: https://healthtech.unistra.fr
funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Research bodies
montant: The HealthTech fellowship, part of the Mobil'ITI program, includes: 950€ per month for 10 months (1st year Master fellows) or 5 months (2nd year Master fellows) Tuition fees to enroll at the University of Strasbourg (up to 500€ - refund on receipt) 500€ to cover relocating expenses for incoming students (upon arrival) 600€ to cover travel expenses for students living at less than 4.000km from Strasbourg (outside of the Grand Est / Upper Rhine region), or 1.000€ if distance is over 4000km (upon arrival) 80% of the fellowship will be delivered at the end of the registration process, while the remaining 20% will be delivered after reception of the academic transcripts of both semesters. HealthTech reserves the right to ask for full reimbursement of the fellowship in case the student ceases the training program before its term.
duree: First year Master students: the Mobil'ITI fellowship is attributed for 10 months (September to June) Second year Master students: the Mobil'ITI fellowship is attributed for 5 months (fall semester). The spring semester is dedicated to the end-of-studies internship in a HealthTech-affiliated research laboratory, during which students will receive an internship grant (approx. 600€/month) for a duration of 5 to 6 months.
maitriseLangue: Applicants must be proficient in English (B2 level or higher).
conditions: All necessary information relative to the admission procedure can be found on HealthTech's website: https://healthtech.unistra.fr/admission/master The Mobil'ITI fellowship cannot be combined with the following mobility support programs : Unistra international mobility support system (DRI) Erasmus+ MIC / Mundus / KA 103 except Erasmus+ Internship KA103 FMU Other financial support from IdEx funding for the same academic year.
inscription: On the eCandidat online platform, apply to Master IRIV, HealthTech track, as follows: Télécom Physique Strasbourg Master LMD Master 1ère année (or 2ème année ) Optique, image, vision, multimédia : HealthTech
pieces: You will be asked to provide the following documents: ID copy ID picture Transcript of results from your high school graduation and copy of the high school graduation diploma Copies of previous diplomas (after high school graduation) Academic transcripts of the past 2-4 years CV Motivation letter addressing your interest in the HealthTech program Proof of English proficiency. Filled fellowship application form (available for download on the eCandidat platform)
selection: Applications are evaluated by the pedagogical committee based on the quality of academic performance, interest for research and medical applications, motivation to join the graduate school program, relevance of the professional project and potential ability to contribute to the research projects developed by HealthTech. The fellowship is only accessible to applicants who were admitted to HealthTech's Master program based on the aforementioned excellence criteria. Only fully complete applications will be considered. Notification of application decision will be transmitted following the pedagogical committee board meeting, by the end of June at the latest.

synthese: The HEC PhD program is a national recognized Doctoral Program. The Program is taught 100% in English and offers 8 specializations.
description: The HEC Paris PhD in management is your gateway to a career in research and academia. Our five-year program, taught 100% in English , will provide you with in-depth knowledge of a particular field of management research, solid training in research methods, as well as hands-on experience in collecting and analyzing data, writing and presenting papers, academic networking, and publishing research. By joining our PhD Program, you do not only benefit from academic and financial support, you also join our vibrant community of top faculty researchers who are dedicated to pushing the frontier of knowledge through our think-teach-act approach. The HEC Paris PhD Program offers an integrated national recognized Master of Research (Master en Sciences du Management) and awards the national degree "Doctorat ès-sciences de gestion". PhD candidates in Law and Regulation will receive the national Doctorate Degree in Law. Every HEC PhD student benefits from: A five-year program fully taught in English with the first two years of intensive training in research domains and methods, as well as professional development courses Choice amongst 8 specializations : Accounting and Management Control - Economics and Decision Sciences - Finance - Law and Regulation - Management and Human Resources - Marketing - Information Systems and Operations Management - Strategy and Business Policy Close mentoring by research-driven HEC Paris Faculty Living stipend funded by HEC Paris and the HEC Foundation of 25.000€/year for up to 5 years 100% tuition waiver for up to 5 years Extra income opportunities through research or teaching assistantships Two national recognized degrees An exceptional campus close to Paris
montant: Each admitted student benefits from the below financing: Living stipend: 25.000€/year for up to 5 years* Tuition waiver: 100% for up to 5 years* *under the condition of annual proven progress.
duree: 5 years under the condition of proven progress.
maitriseLangue: The program is 100% taught in English. No French language required upon admission. Every student will be offered French language classes during their studies.
conditions: To apply for the program we require candidates to submit a management test score: GMAT or GRE a language test score: TOEFL, IELTS or Cambridge . English natives and candidates having studied their university degree(s) in English may apply for exemption.

title: EU Scholarship Programme for the Turkish Cypriot community
synthese: The EU Scholarship Programme for the Turkish Cypriot community is an educational programme that, since 2007, has provided study scholarships to members of the Turkish Cypriot community to study or train in the European Union.
description: The EU Scholarship Programme for the Turkish Cypriot community is an educational programme that, since 2007, has provided study scholarships to members of the Turkish Cypriot community to study or train in the European Union. To-date, 2000 scholarships have been attributed for study in the European Union. Beyond its educational value, it is also perceived as the most important confidence-building Programme with a view to facilitate the reunification of Cyprus. The EU Scholarship Programme offers scholarships to 140-160 scholars each year to pursue the following types of degrees: - full-year undergraduate (or pre-degree) studies; - full-year postgraduate studies; - short-term programmes (language, apprenticeship, professional training, research or post-doctoral studies). The EU Scholarship Programme for the Turkish Cypriot community is implemented by the Goethe-Institut. This Programme's objective is to provide the Turkish Cypriot community with broad education opportunities within the European Union and enhance the connection with the Programme's alumni and the EU while assisting the alumni with further professional development.

title: European Mobility for Higher Education: Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP) - Movetia
synthese: The Swiss Programme for Erasmus+ for higher education is called Swiss-European Mobility Programme SEMP. SEMP gives Swiss higher education institutions the possibility to support students as well as teaching and administrative staff doing a study-, training- or teaching-mobility with funding.
description: Who can participate? Students can complete a study visit at a partner higher education institution (HEI) abroad of up to 12 months per study cycle (Bachelor's, Master's, Doctorate). These visits are recognised for the studies at their own HEI. Students and graduates can complete a traineeship in a business enterprise or other suitable workplace abroad of up to 12 months per study cycle (Bachelor's, Master's, Doctorate). Lecturers have the opportunity to teach in another European country for up to two months. This is possible in any faculty. HEI staff can be supported in their professional development – through further staff training and job shadowing at a partner HEI or appropriate institution in another European country.
montant: Depending on your home institution in Switzerland
duree: 12 months for exchange semester and student internships 2 months max for teachers exchange
inscription: SEMP mobility projects are not submitted directly by students or HEI staff but by the Swiss higher education institutions to the National Agency Movetia. This also applies to incoming mobility.
pieces: - General obligations and quality principles SEMP-Charter - Application form Quality Certificate (SEMP Charter) (DE) - Accreditation Consortia - Mandate Template Documents available at this link : https://www.movetia.ch/en/programmes/international/swiss-programme-for-erasmus/higher-education/mobility/submit-an-application
selection: Higher education institutions can apply for funds for the mobility of students and higher education staff. All Swiss universities officially accredited by the SERI as well as colleges of higher education with federally recognised education and training programmes are eligible to apply. All institutions must also obtain one-time accreditation for participation in the SEMP prior to submitting their application.
countryNote: The Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP) supports mobility from Switzerland to Europe or from Europe to Switzerland, in particular to France.

synthese: ISTEC Scholarship
description: In addition to higher education scholarships awarded by the Ministry of National Education or other organizations, students of the Bachelor Program or 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th year of the Master Program, who are not on a professionalization contract or apprenticeship, can benefit from a solidarity grant granted by ISTEC. The scholarships are awarded: - depending on your personal situation and that of other applicants, - on condition of obtaining a general average in the 1st semester of the academic year of at least 12/20 and not to have problems of absenteeism and professional behavior.
montant: Deduction of tuition fees during the year. Amount defined according to the student's situation, as well as these results over these first months of the course.
duree: 1 year.
conditions: Not be on a professionalization or apprenticeship contract.
inscription: The scholarship application is made once the student is registered. The request is made through the student's intranet access.
pieces: - The completed file (available on the student's intranet) - Copy of the parents' last tax notice - Proof of other scholarships (if they have any) - Proof of address - ID
domainNote: "Grande Ecole" degree course Bachelor degree course
levelNote: Scholarships are awarded, - depending on your personal situation and that of other applicants, - on condition of obtaining a general average in the 1st semester of the academic year of at least 12/20 and not to have problems of absenteeism and professional behavior.

title: Q-Master scholarships, Quantum science & nanomaterials - ITI QMat
synthese: ITI EUR QMat offers scholarships for students on Master level (M1/2) in the field of Physics and Material Science.
description: Each year we offer typically 20 Q-Masters scholarships, for students entering at the M1 (first year master) and M2 (second year master) levels. Selection and awarding of Q-Master scholarships is primarily based on academic performance and motivation. The Q-Master scholarship covers a 10 months period in M1 (September-June) and a 6 months period in M2 (September-February), with an additional 4-6 months of salary supported by the hosting laboratories. Associated masters are the M1 Physics and the M2 Astrophysics, Subatomic Physics and Astroparticles, PRIDI, MCN (Condensed Matter and Nanophysics), Materials and nanoscience, IRIV, Cell physics.
montant: Prestigious “Q-Master” scholarships for MSc students around 500€/month to cover living costs. Additional assistance for international students: e.g. housing, visa applications, French language courses. Largely state subsidized tuition fees for all students.
duree: The Q-Master scholarship covers a 10 months period in M1 (September-June) and a 6 months period in M2 (September-February), with an additional 4-6 months of salary supported by the hosting laboratories.
maitriseLangue: Proof of English and/or French proficiency
conditions: Candidates must also register for a Master's degree on the Unistra e-candidate website and on Campus France. They must send their scholarship application file to the address indicated (https://qmat.unistra.fr/apply/). The scholarship is paid for 100% upon signature of the certificate of arrival. In addition, ITI QMat reserves the right to request a full refund of the support if the training is not completed by the student. The ITI scholarship is cumulative with the scholarships on social criteria, but it is not cumulative with the following supports : Unistra international mobility support system (DRI) Erasmus+ MIC / Mundus / KA 103 except Erasmus+ Stage KA103 UFA Other financial support from IdEx funding for the same academic year.
inscription: Applications should be done through QMat website https://qmat.unistra.fr/apply/
pieces: Your application should include pdf versions of your CV, transcripts of your results, recommendation letters (optional, but strongly recommended), and a letter of motivation (approximately 1 page of text). The motivation letter should describe: - Your research interests - Why are you an excellent candidate for QMat - A clear vision for your individual training (e.g. desired specialization, mentors, internship plans, etc.)
selection: The applications will be examined by a selection committee. The interview for preselected candidates will be organised by ITI QMat coordinators. You will receive the notification in April 2022 at the latest.
countryNote: Countries concerned by the “Studying in France” procedure Algeria, Argentina, Benin, Brazil, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Chad, Chile, China, Colombia, Comoros, Congo, Côte d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Djibouti, Egypt, Gabon, Guinea, Haiti, India, Indonesia, Iran, Japan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Madagascar, Mali, Mauritania, Mauritius, Mexico, Morocco, Niger, Nigeria, Peru, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Senegal, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Togo, Tunisia, Turkey, United States, Vietnam
domainNote: Physics
levelNote: Bachelor of Science in Physics or equivalent; Motivation to pursue a Masters and/or PhD in Strasbourg.

title: Joint scholarships - Sciences Po / Commission on Higher Education (CHED) of Philippines
synthese: Sciences Po and the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) of Philippines finance since 2017 10 joint scholarships per year within the "K to 12 Transition" program so as to support excellent Filipino students in pursuing a solid academic background and a rich academic experience.
montant: The scholarships covers : Full tuition fees sponsored by Sciences Po and CHED. Living expenses in France sponsored by CHED (monthly allowance updated by CHED every year). One return airfrance ticket (Philippines-France) sponsored by CHED. Visa application fees sponsored by CHED.
duree: Duration : full duration of studies at Sciences Po.
conditions: The scholarship is open to applicants who : - hold an undergraduate degree from a Filipino institution member of the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) - are Filipino nationals and admitted to one of Sciences Po's Master or PhD programs
inscription: These scholarships are not awarded automatically, only 10 Filipino students admitted to Sciences Po at the Master or PhD level will be selected every year. The selection process is done jointly by Sciences Po and CHED. Sciences Po contacts every year in June all Filipino students admitted to one of its Master or PhD programs and with their consent shares their information with CHED so as to open a scholarship application file. The 10 scholarships are co-financed by Sciences Po and CHED and are jointly selected by Sciences Po and CHED. These scholarships are awarded on merit base and within the criteria of the "K to 12 Transition" program. Financial need is also taken into account.
selection: The granting of this scholarship is not automatic, only 10 Filipino students admitted to a Masters or Doctorate at Sciences Po will be jointly selected each year by Sciences Po and the CHED.

title: Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan (LPDP) Scholarship - Government of Indonesia
synthese: The LPDP scholarship program application for the 2021 Education Endowment Fund (LPDP), a scholarship program organized by the Ministry of Finance.
description: The LPDP funds fully scholarship for Indonesian students selected from the best higher education institutions nationally and internationally. The LPDP is now the main and probably ultimately the only provider of Indonesian government scholarships.
montant: University Fees: Admission fees(at cost); Tuition fees, including non-language matriculation (at cost); Non-tuition fees, which can be used for financing books, thesis/dissertation, seminar, publications, graduation (package, annual, accumulative). Supporting Fees: Transportation fees from the region of origin to the target university and back (once for each trip, at cost), Health insurance (package), Visa (at cost), Living allowance (package), Family support (package), Settlement allowance (package), The incentive for the top university which fulfills the requisites of LPDP, Emergencies/force majeure agreed upon by LPDP.
duree: 3-4 years for bachelor 1-2 years for master 3-4 years for PhD
age: The maximum age of applicants on 31 December of the registration year is 35 years.
maitriseLangue: French or English, depending on the language of instruction of the chosen program, justified by the DELF / DALF / TCF / TEF or IELTS / TOEFL iBT diploma.
conditions: These excellence scholarships are only awarded to the best candidates already accepted in higher education institutions appearing on a list established by the LPDP on the basis of various international rankings. French institutions on the LPDP list: Paris Sciences et Lettres, Sorbonne Université, Université Paris Saclay, Institut Polytechnique de Paris, AgroParisTech, Université Aix-Marseille, ENSCI Les Ateliers, ENS Lyon, HEC, INSEAD, Institut Agro, Université Paul Sabatier Toulouse III, Université Paul Valéry Montpellier, Sciences Po, Université de Bretagne Occidentale, Université Paris Cité, Université Grenobles Alpes, Université Paris 1 Panthéon Sorbonne, Université de Montpellier, Université de Versailles St Quentin en Yvelines and Vatel.
inscription: Applicants for the LPDP scholarship program must meet the following conditions: Indonesian citizen Take a bachelor's degree Has a leadership role Participate in social, scientific, innovative, creative or cultural activities Write an essay (500 to 700 words) about “My contribution to Indonesia”. The maximum age of applicants on 31 December of the registration year is 35 years.
countryNote: Applicants must sign a letter stating that they will return to Indonesia after completing their studies. The letter should also state that they do not engage in illegal activities or join an organization that opposes the Pancasila ideology.
domainNote: The Indonesian Endowment Fund for Education Scholarship focuses on six priority scientific areas which includes Engineering Science Agriculture Accounting/finance Law Religion.

title: Chalhoub scholarship - Sciences Po
synthese: The Chalhoub scholarship allows students who wish to study at Sciences Po at the undergraduate level at the Sciences Po campus in Menton, Southern France.
montant: Successful undergraduate will receive a scholarship amounting to €14,600 per year for the duration of their 3-years undergraduate studies programme and amounting to €23,300 per year for the duration of the 2-years Masters programme (covering partial tuition) in the event that the student continues his or her studies at Sciences Po at the Masters level.
conditions: Candidates must be from one of the following countries: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Koweit, Bahrein, Lebanon, Syria, Qatar, Egypt, Yemen, Jordan, Oman, Iran, Iraq. Candidates must be accepted to Sciences Po's undergraduate studies programme (Menton campus).
inscription: Candidates must first of all apply to study at Sciences Po and indicate their selected programme of study. Applications must be made on Sciences Po's Admissions website including all supporting documents requested for the Emile Boutmy scholarship application. The deadline is the same as the deadline for Emile Boutmy scholarship applications. No other application specific to the Chalhoub scholarship needs to be made.

title: Geneviève McMillan-Reba Stewart Foundation - Sciences Po scholarship
synthese: The Geneviève McMillan-Reba Stewart Foundation was established in 2005 to realize the vision of its founder, Geneviève McMillan (1922-2008), and to commemorate the life and work of her friend, the artist Reba Stewart (1930-1971).
description: The scholarship celebrates McMillan's passion for the African continent. Since 2010, the McMillan-Stewart Foundation has partnered with the Sciences Po American Foundation to offer merit-based scholarships to give access to France's higher education system to meritorious African students from sub-Saharan African countries. This will be done specifically through the undergraduate Europe Africa program of Sciences Po.
montant: Successful students will receive a scholarship covering the full Sciences Po tuitions fees every year, for the duration of their undergraduate studies programme. As Social criteria are also taken into account, an additional grant may be awarded to cover living expenses.
conditions: The Geneviève McMillan-Reba Stewart Foundation scholarship is awarded on the basis of academic excellence, social criteria as well as the criteria as listed below: Candidates must be citizen of a sub-Saharan African country Candidates must have completed their high school education in a sub-Saharan African country and Candidates must be accepted to Sciences Po's undergraduate Europe-Africa programme
inscription: Candidates must first apply to study at Sciences Po undergraduate Europe Africa program. Applications should be completed on Sciences Po's Admissions website and include all supporting documents requested for the Emile Boutmy scholarship application. The deadline for the Geneviève McMillan-Reba Stewart Foundation Scholarship is the same as the deadline for Emile Boutmy scholarship applications.

title: Talents for Nuclear Foundation - Fondation de France
synthese: The Talents for Nuclear Foundation, under the leadership of the "Fondation de France", aims to develop, promote and support training to support the nuclear industry and the development of low-carbon, nuclear and renewable energy.
description: The Talents for Nuclear Foundation, sheltered by the "Fondation de France", aims to develop and promote education, and training to support the low carbon energy sector, including nuclear and renewables and nuclear applications in human health. The French Education and Training Institute for Nuclear Applications (INSTN) is administered by the French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA), and provides highly specialised Education and Training courses in nuclear science and technology in the fields of energy and health. Among its missions, the Talents for Nuclear Foundation brings value to Education and Training, and contributes to improve students' life conditions and the attractiveness of teaching programmes by granting scholarships and facilitating international mobility. The Talents for Nuclear Foundation has decided to help talented students to join an INSTN teaching programme. The Talents for Nuclear Foundation's scholarship can complement the “Charpak scholarship programme” (AME "Allocation mensuelle d'entretien" - the French Monthly Maintenance Allowance, or BCS "Bourse de Couverture Sociale" - the French Social Security Grant) granted by the French Embassy in India or any other financial contribution.
montant: 400 € per month, which can be complemented by any other contribution
duree: 1 year
maitriseLangue: Some teaching programmes are provided in English. With regard to teaching programmes given in French: level C1 of the Common European Framework, or other certification proving the mastering of French language is requested.
conditions: Being selected for an INSTN teaching programme, or a programme set up by the INSTN and a partner-school or university. Visit the website http://www-instn.cea.fr/en/ for further details.
inscription: Enrolment may vary according to different teaching programmes (terms and conditions, dates, etc.) Applicants are invited to check all the details on the following website: http://www-instn.cea.fr/en/ The applicant must be admissible for an INSTN teaching programme (or co-teaching programme) to be eligible for the Foundation's scholarship. The scholarship application form must be completed and sent with the requested documents by e-mail (contact@talentsfornuclear.org) or by post (Fondation Talents for Nuclear s/c Fondation de France, 40 avenue Hoche, 75008 PARIS, France).
pieces: - Application form (to be requested from contact@talentsfornuclear.org or downloaded from www.talentsfornuclear.org) - Registration letter / Eligibility letter for a teaching programme - Curriculum vitae - Cover letter - Letter of recommendation (a template is available in the file) - Copy of diplomas and certifications obtained - Academic transcript for the last 2 years - Proof of income - Copy of other contributions/assistance (loans, other scholarships) – obtained or requested - French Language certificate (if necessary, depending on the training chosen)
selection: Social criteria Academic criteria Exemplariness and motivation
countryNote: The scholarship is open to both French and foreign students. In both cases, the students must prove that they have completed a higher education program of at least Master I level, and that it is recognized in the nuclear field. For French students, the course can be done in France or abroad. For foreign students, the course must be completed in a French school/university.
domainNote: The Talents for Nuclear foundation awards an atomic engineering degree aimed at training general engineers in the nuclear sector, and a Qualification diploma in Radiological and Medical Physics (DQPRM), a post-graduate diploma accessible through a competitive exam. Thanks to accreditations or partnerships with universities and engineering schools, the Institute provides more than 30 diplomas or degrees (for research or professional purposes) in the nuclear field: energy – engineering – fusion sciences – modelling and simulation – separative chemistry – innovative materials – radiation protection – imaging – nanotechnology – nanoscience.
levelNote: Academic prerequisites and required levels differ according to diploma. Applicants are invited to check all the details on the website: http://www-instn.cea.fr/en/
web1: Institut National des Sciences et Techniques Nucléaires (INSTN)

title: Master scholarships - Ecole Universitaire de Recherche Mathématiques et INteractions (MINT)
synthese: Every year EUR MINT (Mathématiques et INteractions à Toulouse) offers 15 Masters scholarships in mathematics as part of its action program.
description: For the year 2023-2024, MINT offers 6 to 10 fellowships for the first master year M1ESR 9 to 15 fellowships for the second year of master M2RI
montant: The fellowship will cover the housing and living expenses: Master 1 : 1 000 €/month over 10 months, Master 2 : 1 200 €/month over 10 months, MINT will also cover for registration fees at university and travel expenses for foreign students.
duree: Master 1 : 1 000 €/month over 10 months from September to June Master 2 : 1 200 €/month over 10 months from September to June
age: Those fellowships are open, on a competitive basis, to French and foreign students and awarded on the basis of the quality of the academic records. 1st year (M1) applicants are required to have a Bachelor's degree (Licence). 2nd year (M2) applicants must have successfully completed the first year of a European Master's degree, or an American Bachelor's degree, or any equivalent level.
inscription: Applications must be submitted online only. Master 1 application form : https://forms.math.univ-toulouse.fr/survey/Master1maths/users/new Master 2 application form: https://forms.math.univ-toulouse.fr/survey/Master2maths/users/new
pieces: LIST OF REQUIRED DOCUMENTS : Curriculum Vitae (2 pages max.), Academic transcript since the first year of university, Details of the courses taken in 2022-2023, Two recommendation letters, A motivation letter, Copy of your passport or ID For M1ESR applicants, information about their current level of French and English language skills as some courses might be given in French, with English written support. The candidate is responsible for making sure his file is complete at the closing date. The application received after the closing date will not be considered.
selection: The applications will be reviewed by the Admission Comitee of the EUR MINT. The selection is based exclusively on academic excellence criteria. The EUR MINT applies an equal opportunity policy in the evaluation process. Important: MINT program of fellowships is designed to support students over a period of up to 5 years (Master+PhD) all the way to the completion of their thesis.
countryNote: Campus France application for foreign students only : please make sure to set up your Campus France account by December 15th at the latest.
levelNote: These grants are offered to all students, from France or from abroad. The selection is exclusively based on academic excellence criteria. 1st year of master application : candidates are required to have a Bachelor's degree (Licence). 2nd year of master application: candidates are required to have a validated first year of a master.

title: Programmes régionaux CLIMAT-AmSud, STIC-AmSud et MATH-AmSud
synthese: L'objectif est de promouvoir et de renforcer la collaboration et la création de réseaux de recherche-développement dans le domaine des sciences et technologies de l'information et de la communication, des mathématiques et du changement climatique et de la variabilité climatique par la réalisation de projets communs.
description: Les programmes régionaux CLIMAT-AmSud, STIC-AmSud et MATH-AmSud sont des programmes de coopération scientifique et technologique auxquels participent l'Argentine, le Brésil, le Chili, la Colombie, l'Équateur, le Paraguay, le Pérou, l'Uruguay, le Venezuela et la France. Le programme régional STIC-AmSud est une initiative de la coopération française et de ses homologues en Argentine, Bolivie, Chili, Colombie, Equateur, Paraguay, Pérou, Uruguay et Venezuela. Il est destiné à promouvoir et à renforcer la collaboration et la création de réseaux de recherche-développement dans le domaine des sciences et technologies de l'information et des communications (STIC), à travers la mobilité de chercheurs, pour la réalisation de projets de recherche conjoints. Le programme régional MATH-AmSud est une initiative de la coopération française et de ses homologues en Argentine, Bolivie, Brésil, Chili, Colombie, Equateur, Paraguay, Pérou, Uruguay et Venezuela. Il est destiné à promouvoir et à renforcer la collaboration et la création de réseaux de recherche-développement dans le domaine des mathématiques, à travers la mobilité de chercheurs, pour la réalisation de projets de recherche conjoints. Le programme régional CLIMAT-AmSud est une initiative de la coopération française et de ses partenaires en Argentine, Bolivie, Colombie, Chili, Paraguay, Pérou et Uruguay. Son objectif est de promouvoir et de renforcer la collaboration et la création de réseaux de recherche et de développement, et de financer des projets de recherche liés à la variabilité climatique et au changement climatique, par la mise en œuvre de projets de recherche conjoints.
funder: French government, Foreign governments, Foreign organisations, Research bodies
montant: La modalité de financement est la suivante : l'organisme qui envoie prend en charge les frais de billets d'avion et les frais de séjour de ses équipes. Les échanges ne peuvent se faire qu'entre les pays partenaires membres du programme. Les ressources seront fournies chaque année. Les financements alloués dépendent de la disponibilité budgétaire annuelle des différents organismes.
duree: 2 ans.
conditions: Activités finançables: Seules seront financées les missions d'une durée égale ou inférieure à 30 jours. La durée minimum recommandée des missions est de 7 jours. Il doit y avoir au moins une mobilité de la France vers l'Amérique du Sud et de l'Amérique du Sud vers la France, au cours du projet. Les conditions préalables des programmes restent les mêmes que les années précédentes : avoir une équipe de chercheurs français et au moins deux équipes de chercheurs de pays d'Amérique du Sud participant au programme.
inscription: Pour chaque appel d'offres, les formulaires de candidature sont téléchargeables sur le site des programmes.
selection: Les programmes STIC, MATH et CLIMAT Amsud s'appuient sur un comité scientifique et un comité de pilotage qui sont formés par des représentants des institutions participantes. Pour obtenir plus d'informations sur leur composition, et consulter le règlement : https://www.sticmathamsud.org/

title: Bourses d'excellence AVENIR
synthese: Le programme de bourses d'excellence AVENIR s'adresse aux étudiants espagnols ou franco-espagnols résidant en Espagne qui souhaitent réaliser des études en France en licence, master ou doctorat, dans le cadre d'une mobilité individuelle, d'un double-diplôme ou d'un accord ERASMUS +.
description: Le programme de bourses d'excellence AVENIR, mené en collaboration avec l'association d'amitié franco-espagnole Diálogo, existe depuis 12 ans. Il s'adresse aux étudiants espagnols ou franco-espagnols résidant en Espagne qui souhaitent réaliser des études en France. Les mobilités peuvent être individuelles (Licence, Master ou Doctorat), mais aussi s'inscrire dans le cadre d'un double diplôme franco-espagnol ou d'un programme d'échange Erasmus+. Pour l'année universitaire 2026-2027, l'ambassade de France en Espagne et ses partenaires proposent une centaine de bourses. Le montant des bourses allouées oscille entre 1000€ et 10000 €. Le montant de chaque bourse est fixé par le partenaire qui la finance. Depuis la création du programme, plus de 300 bourses ont été attribuées dans différentes disciplines telles que les sciences humaines et sociales, les sciences de la vie et de la terre, le commerce, les sciences politiques, les sciences de la santé, la gestion des entreprises, l'ingénierie ou encore les langues et cultures. L'objectif du programme des Bourses Avenir est de favoriser la mobilité internationale étudiante et l'insertion professionnelle des jeunes dans un contexte internationalisé.
funder: French government, Higher Education Institutions, Enterprises, banks and private bodies
duree: Un semestre ou une année universitaire
conditions: Pour les bourses AVENIR, deux procédures doivent être effectuées simultanément : - remplir le formulaire de candidature en ligne pour les Bourses AVENIR - Destination France sur le site Diálogo ; - soumettre votre/vos candidature(s) à l'école/aux écoles/université(s) qui vous intéresse(nt), en suivant la procédure d'admission. Critères requis pour les bourses : Nationalité espagnole ou franco-espagnole avec résidence en Espagne Inscription obligatoire dans l'établissement de destination, à titre individuel (sur leur site internet) Les bourses d'études seront attribuées après la présentation d'un justificatif d'inscription ou d'une lettre d'acceptation officielle, selon le cas, de l'établissement de destination en France Important : L'inscription auprès de l'établissement de destination et la gestion de l'hébergement en France seront à la charge de l'étudiant.
inscription: Procédure : Remplir entièrement le formulaire de candidature en ligne Fournir les pièces justificatives demandées, dans les délais impartis Passer un entretien (en présentiel ou vidéo conférence) pour les admissibles Consulter le site internet de Diálogo pour connaître la liste des candidats retenus
selection: Calendrier : 3 mars : ouverture des inscriptions 4 mai : fermeture des inscriptions Pendant les mois de mai et juin : sélection des candidats 23 juin : dernier jour pour présenter une lettre d'acceptation de l'établissement en France Dernière semaine de juin : publication de la liste des lauréats Début du mois de juillet : cérémonie de remise des bourses
domainNote: Ingénierie, Informatique, Energie, Sciences de la Vie, Sciences Humaines et Sociales, Economie et Gestion des entreprises, Sciences sociales...
levelNote: Licence, Master et Doctorat.

title: Appel à projets scientifiques - Bourses doctorales et post-doctorales
synthese: L'Ambassade de France en Espagne finance des bourses doctorales et post-doctorales d'une durée de deux semaines (925€) ou d'un mois (1850€), en fonction du budget disponible.
description: Le dossier de candidature et les documents requis doivent être envoyés à l'Ambassade de France en Espagne avant le 9 mars 2026. Les subventions sont destinées exclusivement à des doctorants ou post-doctorants inscrits dans un établissement espagnol (non-inscrits dans un établissement en France), pour financer une mobilité vers la France dans le cadre d'un séjour de recherche .
montant: Les aides attribuées sont gérées par l'agence Campus France. Celles-ci comprennent les avantages suivants pour tous les candidats sélectionnés : - Versement d'une allocation de 925€ pour un séjour de deux semaines et de 1850€ pour un séjour d'un mois. - Affiliation à un régime d'assurance maladie comprenant la responsabilité civile pendant toute la durée du séjour. - Possibilité d'hébergement à tarif préférentiel (dont le loyer ne dépassera pas le tiers du montant de l'allocation). - Acheminement vers le lieu d'accueil en train (2nde classe) depuis un aéroport international dans le cas où la ville d'études ne bénéficierait pas d'une liaison directe avec la ville d'origine du bénéficiaire. Les frais annexes de taxi, navette, bus, métro ne sont pas pris en charge. - Activités culturelles à tarifs préférentiels proposées par Campus France.
duree: Les bénéficiaires pourront réaliser leur séjour à partir du second semestre 2026 et devront effectuer leur mobilité avant le 31 décembre 2026. Les bénéficiaires auront jusqu'au 31 décembre 2026 pour transmettre à l'Ambassade de France en Espagne le rapport des activités scientifiques réalisées durant leur mobilité et le rapport financier .
conditions: - Être de nationalité espagnole ; - Être étudiant en doctorat ou avoir soutenu une thèse depuis moins de 5 ans ; - Avoir une invitation de l'organisme d'accueil français ; - Ne pas bénéficier d'une autre bourse (Erasmus/Gouvernement français etc.) pour la durée du séjour. Le boursier a les obligations suivantes : - Effectuer le séjour scientifique en France dans l'établissement et durant la période mentionnée dans le dossier de candidature. - Tenir informé Campus France, l'organisme chargé de la gestion des boursiers en France, de tout changement (adresse, absence, obtention d'une autre bourse, réorientation, etc.) - Tout projet sélectionné devra mentionner dans ses supports de communication (site web, documents visuels, publications, etc.) le soutien de l'Ambassade de France en Espagne. - Élaborer un rapport d'activités (en français ou en espagnol) et justifier de l'utilisation du financement octroyé à l'issue du séjour de recherche.
inscription: Les candidatures doivent être envoyées à l'adresse e-mail suivante : becas-sshn@institutfrancais.es Vous trouverez ci-dessous les annexes nécessaires à la préparation de votre dossier de candidature. Le dossier de candidature complet doit être transmis OBLIGATOIREMENT en UN SEUL FICHIER au format PDF (NOM_Prénom.pdf). Les dossiers de candidature incomplets ou soumis après la date de clôture de l'appel ne seront pas examinés.
pieces: Pour les doctorants : - Curriculum vitae abrégé en espagnol ou en français (2 pages maximum). - Copie recto/verso de la pièce d'identité (passeport espagnol ou DNI). - Certificat d'inscription dans un établissement d'enseignement supérieur ou un organisme de recherche espagnol. - Lettre d'invitation de l'établissement d'accueil en France mentionnant les dates du séjour. Celles-ci doivent correspondre aux dates de la bourse demandée. - Annexes jointes complétées : Annexe 1-Informations sur le candidat et le projet + Annexe 2- Présentation du projet (1 page maximum). Pour les chercheurs post-doctorants : - Curriculum vitae abrégé en espagnol ou en français (2 pages maximum). - Copie recto-verso de la pièce d'identité (passeport ou carte d'identité). - Contrat post-doctoral ou justificatif d'appartenance à un laboratoire ou centre de recherche espagnol valide au moment de la candidature. - Lettre d'invitation de l'établissement d'accueil en France, indiquant les dates du séjour. Celles-ci doivent correspondre aux dates de la subvention demandée. - Annexes jointes complétées : Annexe 1-Informations sur le candidat et le projet + Annexe 2- Présentation du projet (1 page maximum).
selection: 17 février 2026 : ouverture de l'appel, sur le site de l'Institut français. 9 mars 2026, 23 h 59 [heure de Paris] : clôture de l'appel. Les résultats seront publiés en mai 2026 sur le site : https://www.institutfrancais.es/programas-y-ayudas/investigadores/convocatorias-cientificas/
domainNote: Domaines de recherche éligibles : -Santé - Spatial - Quantique - Intelligence artificielle - Économie circulaire - Énergie - Climat - Électronique - Vieillissement - Lutte contre la désinformation - Sciences humaines et sociales, en lien avec les domaines précédents
levelNote: Les candidatures seront évaluées sur la base des critères suivants : - Excellence académique et scientifique des candidats - Qualité, pertinence et cohérence du projet de séjour en France - Intérêt du projet dans le cadre de la coopération scientifique franco-espagnole

title: Appel à projets scientifiques - Chercheurs confirmés
synthese: L'Ambassade de France en Espagne octroie plusieurs subventions pour des projets scientifiques s'inscrivant dans le cadre d'une collaboration franco-espagnole. Les subventions accordées sont de 1 000€ par projet (en fonction du budget disponible).
description: Le dossier de candidature et les documents requis doivent être envoyés à l'Ambassade de France en Espagne avant le 9 mars 2026.
duree: Les bénéficiaires auront jusqu'au 31 décembre 2026 pour faire usage de la subvention accordée et transmettre à l'Ambassade de France en Espagne le rapport sur les activités scientifiques réalisées et l'utilisation des fonds accordés .
age: Les candidats doivent être des chercheurs confirmés (diplôme de doctorat obtenu depuis plus de cinq ans).
conditions: Obligations des bénéficiaires : - Remettre un rapport des activités scientifiques réalisées (en français ou en espagnol). Ce document doit justifier l'utilisation de la subvention accordée. - Le soutien de l'Ambassade de France doit être mentionné dans les supports de communication des projets sélectionnés (site web, documents visuels, publications, etc.).
inscription: Les candidatures doivent être envoyées à l'adresse e-mail suivante : subvenciones-investigacion@institutfrancais.es Vous trouverez ci-dessous les annexes nécessaires à la constitution de votre dossier de demande de subvention. Le dossier de candidature complet doit être envoyé en UN SEUL FICHIER au format PDF ( NOM_Prénom.pdf ). Les candidatures incomplètes ou soumises après la date de clôture de l'appel ne seront pas évaluées.
pieces: Pour les personnes physiques : - Curriculum vitae abrégé en espagnol ou en français (5 pages maximum) et copie recto-verso de la pièce d'identité (passeport ou DNI). - RIB/IBAN (joindre l'attestation de propriété bancaire fournie par la banque). - Annexes jointes : Annexe 1 - Lettre de soutien du laboratoire d'appartenance ; Annexe 2 - Informations sur le projet et le candidat ; Annexe 3 - présentation du projet (1 page maximum). Pour les entités publiques : - Curriculum vitae abrégé en espagnol ou en français (3 pages maximum) et copie recto-verso de la d'identité (passeport ou DNI). - RIB/IBAN (joindre l'attestation de propriété fournie par la banque). - Le document de l'agence fiscale accréditant la création de l'entité (numéro d'identification fiscale/code d'identification fiscale). - Annexes jointes : Annexe 1 - Lettre de soutien du laboratoire d'appartenance + Annexe 2 - Informations sur le projet et le candidat ; Annexe 3 - présentation du projet (1 page maximum).
selection: 17 février 2026 : ouverture de l'appel, accessible sur le site de l'Institut Français. 9 mars 2026, 23:59 h [heure de Paris] : clôture de l'appel. Les résultats de l'appel seront publiés en mai 2026 sur le site : https://www.institutfrancais.es/programas-y-ayudas/investigadores/convocatorias-cientificas/
countryNote: - Tout chercheur de nationalité espagnole appartenant à une entité publique espagnole peut participer à l'appel. - Les subventions sont destinées aux activités scientifiques et ne peuvent être utilisées pour le fonctionnement de l'organisme demandeur. - Les projets doivent s'inscrire dans le cadre d'une collaboration franco-espagnole, sans exclure la participation de partenaires provenant d'autres pays.
domainNote: Domaines de recherche éligibles : - Santé - Spatial - Quantique - Intelligence artificielle - Économie circulaire - Énergie - Climat - Électronique - Vieillissement - Lutte contre la désinformation - Sciences humaines et sociales, en lien avec les domaines précédents Actions éligibles : - Aide à la publication d'articles scientifiques - Mobilité vers la France ou l'Espagne et séjour scientifique pour les chercheurs impliqués - Achat de matériel de recherche - Organisation ou participation à des manifestations scientifiques (conférences, séminaires, colloques, journées d'études etc.).
levelNote: Les candidatures seront évaluées sur la base des critères suivants : - Mérites académiques et scientifiques : l'excellence du parcours académique et scientifique jusqu'au moment de la soumission de la candidature (diplômes, postes occupés, publications etc.) ; - Intérêt, originalité et faisabilité du projet : la cohérence du sujet et de la méthodologie proposées, l'impact sur la discipline, ainsi que sa faisabilité et son adéquation aux orientations scientifiques de l'Ambassade de France en Espagne ; - Participation à des programmes et des projets nationaux et internationaux ; séjours de recherche effectués et expériences professionnelles dans des centres de recherche ou institutions étrangères, notamment en France ou en Europe.

title: Bourse Master CFI
synthese: El Consejo Federal de Inversiones (CFI) en colaboración con la Agencia Campus France y el Institut Français d'Argentine (Campus France Argentina) ofrece becas de Master (M2) en Francia a los ciudadanos argentinos de las 23 provincias (excepto CABA)
description: - Objetivo: obtener el título de Master en universidades de Francia (lo cual correspondería a postular al segundo año del Master - M2). - Áreas de estudio: las becas se otorgan en las áreas de estudio consideradas estratégicas para el CFI y los gobiernos provinciales, en especial: - Innovación tecnológica aplicada a los principales sectores productivos. - Sistemas de transporte y logística de cargas. - Energías renovables, ambiente y desarrollo sustentable. - Gestión de los recursos hídricos. - Gestión de gobierno. - Comercio Exterior y Relaciones Internacionales. - Industrias Culturales y Creativas. - Gestión Turística. - Duración: la beca es por un año académico dependiendo del rendimiento de la/el becaria/o. - Período de realización: los programas de estudios de Master corresponden al Ciclo Académico que comienza en septiembre de 2026.
montant: 1200 € par mois + billet d'avion + mutuelle complémentaire + frais d'inscription d'un maximum de 10000€
duree: 1 année maximum (M2)
maitriseLangue: B2 français ou anglais minimum (certifié)
conditions: Criterios de selección Las postulaciones que cumplan con los requisitos para participar de la convocatoria serán ponderadas y priorizadas en función de los siguientes criterios: a) Criterios de ponderación de postulaciones: - Antecedentes y desempeño académico. - Diversidad de áreas disciplinares. - Distribución federal de las becas. - Paridad en cuanto al género. - Consistencia y claridad en las motivaciones y justificación del proyecto académico. - Manejo del idioma francés - inglés (dependiendo del idioma de los Masters elegidos). b) Criterios de priorización de postulantes (no excluyente): - Desempeño del francés o inglés en la entrevista personal a organizar por el Comité de Evaluación. - Haber egresado de algún programa formativo de la Escuela Federal de Desarrollo del CFI. - Tener experiencia en gestión pública. - Probabilidades de reinserción y transmisión de los aprendizajes adquiridos en su provincia. - Referencias profesionales/académicas. - Experiencia docente y en investigación en universidades e instituciones públicas. Que el Master que desee realizar se vincule a campos académicos estratégicos y prioritarios para el CFI y su provincia de origen
inscription: Las/os candidatas/os que quieran solicitar becas Master deberán completar el siguiente formulario en línea: https://forms.gle/KzVQrtrWjevrHikL7 (hasta el 01/02/2026) D
pieces: - Un Currículum Vitae (CV) actualizado, en español. - Una carta de motivación en español, dirigida al Comité de Evaluación, por la cual explique los motivos para realizar estudios de Master en Francia. Detallar la justificación de su proyecto académico y la proyección de reinserción laboral/profesional a su regreso en Argentina, en términos de aplicar/implementar los conocimientos adquiridos con el Master al que desea postular (¿cuál es el proyecto?, ¿en qué institución, empresa u organización espera realizarlo?, etc.). No hay formato preestablecido. - Una carta de recomendación de una/un referente profesional o académico en español dirigida al Comité de Evaluación. No hay formato preestablecido. Puede ser más de una carta y pueden ser referencias académicas o profesionales/laborales. - Copia del título de grado (o certificado de título en trámite) y certificado analítico de los estudios universitarios. - En caso de tener título de posgrado, presentar copia. - El certificado de francés - inglés mencionado en la solicitud. - En caso de ser egresada/o de un programa formativo de la Escuela Federal de Desarrollo del CFI, presentar certificado o diploma que lo acredite. - Copia delreglamento firmado por el/la postulante en la página 5.
selection: Las solicitudes de becas serán evaluadas, en primera instancia, por un Comité de Evaluación compuesto por representantes del CFI y de CF-IFA. Quienes resulten preseleccionadas/os serán entrevistadas/os en día y horario prefijado por dicho Comité. La entrevista tendrá carácter obligatorio para quienes deseen continuar en el proceso de selección. Durante la entrevista, se evaluarán -entre otros requisitos- la capacidad de la persona para comunicarse en idioma francés o inglés (dependiendo el idioma en qué se dicte el Master elegido). Luego de las entrevistas, el CFI comunicará el resultado de la selección a todos los postulantes. - Quienes resulten seleccionados/as deberán postular a los Masters de su interés respetando los procedimientos y calendarios de cada universidad francesa. Para eso, el equipo de Campus France Argentina (Institut français d'Argentine) se pondrá a su disposición para otorgarles asesoramiento al respecto. Solo quienes sean aceptados/as por las universidades obtendrán finalmente la beca.
domainNote: - Innovación tecnológica aplicada a los principales sectores productivos. - Sistemas de transporte y logística de cargas. - Energías renovables, ambiente y desarrollo sustentable. - Gestión de los recursos hídricos. - Gestión de gobierno. - Comercio Exterior y Relaciones Internacionales. - Industrias Culturales y Creativas. - Gestión Turística.
levelNote: Diploma universitario de al menos 5 años

title: Projets scientifiques franco-cubains 2026
synthese: Le soutien aux projets scientifiques permet d'organiser des séminaires, des colloques et des séjours de recherche à Cuba ou en France.
description: Chaque année, l'Ambassade de France ouvre un appel à projets scientifiques franco-cubain. Le soutien aux projets scientifiques permet d'organiser des séminaires, des colloques et des séjours de recherche à Cuba ou en France. En 2025, 8 projets ont été réalisés grâce au fonds de l'Ambassade de France pour les projets de recherche scientifique. Pour être éligible le projet doit comporter une institution française et une institution cubaine Pour trouver un laboratoire français, un article de Campus France: https://www.campusfrance.org/fr/trouver-laboratoire-recherche-France Le répertoire national des structures de recherche (en français uniquement) : https://appliweb.dgri.education.fr/rnsr/ChoixCriteres.jsp?PUBLIC=OK L'annuaire des laboratoires de recherche du CNRS (en français uniquement) : https://annuaire.cnrs.fr/ Le répertoire scanR (pour les laboratoires de recherche publics et privés) : https://scanr.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/ L'appel à projets 2026 est ouvert du 03 novembre 2025 au 30 janvier 2026.
selection: - Budget prévisionnel - Lettre de demande d'appui de l'institution porteuse du projet Adresser la lettre au Conseiller de Coopération et d'Action culturelle de l'Ambassade de France à Cuba en précisant le montant de l'aide demandée. - Descriptif du projet Détaillant les aspects scientifiques, les différentes actions prévues et un chronogramme (point de départ, objectif du projet à la fin de sa réalisation, perspectives à moyen et à long terme). - Pour une demande de soutien pour la participation à un évènement, le télécharger.Préciser si une communication orale ou écrite est prévue. - Pour une demande de soutien à l'organisation d'un évènement, le télécharge.Préciser le type (chercheurs, étudiantes, autres) et nombre de participants attendus. - Pour les porteurs de projets ayant bénéficié d'un appui du SCAC en 2024 ou 2025, télécharger ici le bilan narratif et financier des actions réalisées

title: BOURSE D'ÉTUDES DU GOUVERNEMENT FRANÇAIS – AMBASSADE DE FRANCE AU COSTA RICA
synthese: Le SCAC (Service français de Coopération et d'Action Culturelle) de l'Ambassade de France au Costa Rica souhaite renforcer la stratégie de formation doctorale et de master en France pour les professeurs et étudiants universitaires costariciens, afin de contribuer efficacement à l'amélioration de la qualité académique.
description: Ce programme a pour objectifs : - Offrir l'opportunité aux professeurs et étudiants universitaires costariciens de réaliser un master ou un doctorat en France ; - Favoriser les thématiques de recherche prioritaires pour les universités et institutions du Costa Rica ; - Établir des relations entre les établissements d'enseignement supérieur des deux pays.
montant: Le SCAC prend en charge : - Le billet d'avion pour la France (aller-retour) ; - La couverture sociale annuelle obligatoire ; - Une allocation mensuelle d'environ 860 € pour les étudiants en master et 1 700 € pour les doctorants et post-doctorants. Les boursiers sont exemptés du paiement : - Des frais d'inscription dans les établissements relevant du ministère français de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation. Le SCAC ne couvre pas les éventuels frais pédagogiques supplémentaires ; - De la CVEC (Contribution Vie Étudiante et de Campus) ; - Des frais liés à la demande de visa.
duree: - Master : 2 ans - Doctorat : 3 ans
age: Il n'y a pas de limite d'âge pour postuler.
maitriseLangue: - Pour un master ou un doctorat en français : niveau exigé par l'université française (niveau B2 recommandé) ; - Pour un master ou un doctorat en anglais : niveau exigé par l'université française. Indiquer également le niveau de français (niveau A2 recommandé). - Certification officielle de niveau de langues : DELF, DALF, TOEIC, TOEFL, etc.
conditions: - La bourse ne peut pas être cumulée avec d'autres financements attribués par des ministères français, par l'agence Erasmus ou par l'Agence Universitaire de la Francophonie. - La bourse n'est pas compatible avec un contrat d'apprentissage, de professionnalisation ou tout autre contrat de travail lié à la formation du boursier, y compris les contrats doctoraux ou CIFRE. - Pour le master, les candidats doivent avoir été admis lors de la première phase de sélection sur la plateforme MonMaster.gouv.fr. Aucun candidat en attente de réponse pendant la phase complémentaire ne pourra être considéré. - Pour le postdoctorat, les candidats doivent être des professionnels venant se former (sans délivrance de diplôme) en France au sein d'un organisme accrédité.
inscription: Contact et envoi de documents : sanjose@campusfrance.org
pieces: - Curriculum vitae, de préférence au format Europass ; - Copies des relevés de notes et du diplôme de 1er cycle (pour un projet de master) et de licence + master (pour un projet de doctorat) ; - Lettre en français ou en espagnol expliquant le projet d'études (pour une candidature en master) ou le projet de recherche (pour une candidature en doctorat) ; - Certification officielle de niveau de langues : DELF, DALF, TOEIC, TOEFL, etc. - Copie de la lettre d'acceptation dans un programme de master (provenant de la plateforme MonMaster.gouv.fr), de doctorat ou de postdoctorat dans un établissement français d'enseignement supérieur, ou accord de principe signé par le coordinateur du master ou le futur directeur de thèse. À défaut, le candidat devra justifier l'avancement des démarches engagées (échanges de courriels, demande d'admission sur une plateforme, etc.). Si le candidat remplit toutes les autres conditions, la commission du SCAC pourra attendre la lettre d'acceptation définitive pour attribuer la bourse. Aucun dossier ne sera accepté s'il n'est pas complet.
selection: Les candidats présélectionnés seront convoqués à un entretien, en présentiel ou à distance.
countryNote: Les candidats doivent impérativement être de nationalité costaricienne. Les ressortissants français, y compris en cas de double nationalité, ne sont pas éligibles à ce dispositif.
domainNote: Tous les domaines d'études sont éligibles. La bourse couvre les frais d'inscription uniquement dans les établissements relevant du ministère français de l'Enseignement supérieur, de la Recherche et de l'Innovation.
levelNote: - Le parcours académique et les résultats obtenus ; - La qualité du projet d'études ou de recherche ; - Le niveau de langue en français correspondant à la formation choisie, et en anglais le cas échéant (une certification officielle constitue un atout supplémentaire pour la candidature).
web2: Ambassade de France au Costa Rica

title: Bourse "Generación del Bicentenario" - PRONABEC
synthese: La bourse du gouvernent péruvien est attribués aux étudiants péruviens titulaires d'un "bachiller" et ayant reçu une acceptation dans une université éligible au programme. La bourse est attribuée sur des critères d'excellence académique.
description: Destiné aux Péruviens qui ont terminé leurs études supérieures avec des performances académiques élevées et ont obtenu un "Bachiller" ou un diplôme professionnel ou un diplôme technique professionnel ou une maîtrise, qui prouvent des ressources économiques insuffisantes pour étudier un diplôme de troisième cycle et ont été admis dans une université étrangère éligible (liste des 400 meilleures universités du PRONABEC). Le Gouvernement Péruvien octroiera 135 bourses de Master et 15 bourses doctorales.
montant: La bourse "Generación del Bicentenario" prend en charge : - les frais relatifs à la demande de visa étudiant - les frais d'inscription à l'université - les frais de voyage Pérou-France - les frais de logement - les frais d'alimentation - les frais relatifs à la carte de transport mensuelle - les frais de mutuelle
duree: La bourse a la durée de la formation telle qu'indiquée par sa lettre d'acceptation.
conditions: - Une année d'expérience professionnelle - Bon état de santé physique et mentale - Ressources économiques insuffisantes
pieces: Les pièces à fournir sont déterminées par le PRONABEC dans leur site web.
selection: Les candidats sélectionnés sont déterminés par le PRONABEC.
levelNote: Excellence académique ("tercio superior" au minimum)
